title: Founder’s Associate – Operations & AI (all genders)
description:
Über TradeLink

TradeLink baut agentische Plattformen, die europäische Lieferketten auf ein neues Level bringen. Routineaufgaben werden dabei von intelligenten KI-Agenten übernommen, wichtige Entscheidungen und Priorisierungen bleiben in den Teams. Ein Netzwerk, das Unternehmen, Lieferanten und Spediteure verbindet, sorgt für maximale Transparenz, reduziert Zeitverluste und schafft einen sicheren und vertrauensvollen Prozess. Mit TradeLink hat man seine Logistik jederzeit im Griff, statt ihr hinterherzurennen.

Über die Rolle

Wir sind intern auf dem Weg zur AI-native Org. Unser Firmenwissen liegt in einem Git-Repo, aus dem AI schöpft und arbeitet und das sich über Feedback Loops selbst aktualisiert. Inbound-Anfragen, Pod-Reports, Support-Triage und Call-Recaps laufen über Agenten und Automationen, die wir selbst gebaut haben. Mehr als 20 davon sind in Produktion.

In dieser Rolle bist du für das Backbone von TradeLink zuständig: die Systeme und Abläufe in Operations, People, Finance und GTM, auf die sich alle Teams jeden Tag verlassen. Du treibst AI-Projekte in der ganzen Firma voran und machst unsere Abläufe schlanker, schneller und effizienter. Dabei bekommst du Einblick in alle Bereiche des Unternehmens, vom Vertrieb über Produkt und Kunden bis zu People und Finance.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem CEO und Gründer Tobias und mit Daniel, unserem Chief of Staff und AI Enablement Manager, zusammen und machst die Firma jede Woche ein Stück besser. Für dich ist die Rolle ein Sprungbrett: Von hier aus kannst du dich in jeden Unternehmensbereich weiterentwickeln, der zu dir passt.

Dein Verantwortungsbereich

  • People & Finance Operations AI-first umbauen: Du übernimmst unsere People- und Finance-Abläufe, verschlankst sie und automatisierst sie Schritt für Schritt. Das Ziel: Abläufe laufen pünktlich, haben einen Prüfschritt und finden Fehler, bevor sie beim Empfänger ankommen.

  • Operations schlank und kosteneffizient halten: Du behältst im Blick, wofür wir Geld und Zeit ausgeben, und sorgst dafür, dass wir effizient bleiben. Dafür prüfst du laufend Tools, Verträge und Abläufe, findest Doppelarbeit und Medienbrüche und managst Kündigungen, Nachverhandlungen, Implementierungen und Vereinfachungen

  • Arbeit an Agenten übergeben: Du betreibst laufende Automationen mit (Make, Claude, HubSpot, GitLab) und baust neue für wiederkehrende Arbeit in Vertrieb, Support, Reporting, People und Finance. Vor jedem Projekt legst du fest, woran wir den Erfolg messen, etwa gesparte Stunden, weniger Fehler oder erzeugte Pipeline.

  • GTM-Systeme und Customer Enablement: Du fährst Outbound-Kampagnen für unsere Zielaccounts und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass der Weg von der Anfrage bis zum ersten Gespräch schnell bleibt. Du baust das Reporting mit, über das unsere Teams ihre Accounts steuern. Außerdem arbeitest du am AI-native Self-Onboarding mit: Aus deinen Analysen leiten wir Builds ab, die Kundenanfragen und damit Tickets reduzieren.

  • Das Firmen-Gehirn weiterentwickeln: Du sorgst dafür, dass unser Firmenwissen (Positionierung, Personas, Plays, Account Maps) aktuell ist und genutzt wird. Du zeigst Teams, wie sie damit arbeiten, misst, ob sie es tun, und verbesserst es, wenn nicht.

Nach 90 Tagen

  • laufen unsere Standardprozesse in People, Finance und GTM spürbar runder, schlanker und mit mehr Automatisierung als heute,

  • kennst du die Firma in der ganzen Breite und weißt, wie die Bereiche zusammenhängen,

  • erkennst du, wo es hakt, kannst Abläufe und Ergebnisse kritisch prüfen und unterstützt das Management-Team so, dass es sich auf die wichtigen Entscheidungen konzentrieren kann

  • nutzt ein Team mindestens eine Lösung, die du gebaut hast, und spart dadurch jede Woche Zeit.

Nach 12 bis 18 Monaten verantwortest du einen Bereich selbst. Wohin es geht, entscheiden wir zusammen: GTM Engineering, Operations, AI Transformation Consultant beim Kunden, Product Builder oder der Weg in Richtung Chief of Staff.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mit AI oder Automationen etwas gebaut, das andere nutzen, und kannst es zeigen. Womit, ist egal: Make, n8n, Claude Code, ein Custom GPT mit eigenem Kontext, ein Python-Skript.

  • Erste Erfahrung in einem Startup, Scale-up, in der Beratung oder im VC. Praktika, Werkstudium oder eine eigene Gründung zählen.

  • Du prüfst AI-Output, bevor du ihn weitergibst, und kannst erklären, wo deine Tools versagen.

  • Du schreibst klar: kurze Memos und Anleitungen, mit denen jemand ohne dich weiterarbeiten kann.

  • Du bist sicher mit Zahlen und merkst, wenn eine Summe nicht stimmen kann.

  • Du gehst sorgfältig mit vertraulichen Informationen um.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau und gutes Englisch.

  • Du lernst jede Woche etwas Neues über AI und weißt genau, was du dir zuletzt selbst beigebracht hast

Pluspunkte: Erfahrung in Recruiting, People Operations, Billing oder Finance Operations, eine Outbound-Kampagne, die du schon selbst gefahren hast, Git und Markdown, etwas Python oder SQL, HubSpot.

Die Stelle passt nicht, wenn

  • du eine Assistenzrolle mit Kalender und Reiseplanung suchst,

  • du mit ChatGPT arbeitest, aber noch nichts gebaut hast, das jemand anderes nutzt,

  • du erst loslegst, wenn ein fertiges Briefing vorliegt,

  • du Strategie machen und die Umsetzung anderen überlassen willst.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Bauen ab Woche 1: Claude, ChatGPT und das Tool-Budget, das deine Builds brauchen, und eine Führungskraft, die selbst baut.

  • Breite, die es selten gibt: GTM, AI, Operations in einer Rolle, direkt mit dem Management.

  • Impact, Innovation & Ownership: Gestalte unser schnell wachsendes, AI-natives B2B-Startup in der Logistik mit. Wir arbeiten in kleinen, fokussierten Pods, in denen jede:r echte Ergebnisse verantwortet – nicht nur Aufgaben abarbeitet. Nimm Einfluss auf Produkt, Kundenlösungen, Wachstum und Marke. Wir denken groß, handeln schnell und lösen echte Probleme.

  • AI-Powered, Human-Led: Arbeite an vorderster Front einer Organisation, die AI-nativ aufgebaut ist. Du nutzt AI, um deinen Impact zu vervielfachen – während Urteilsvermögen, Kreativität und Ownership klar menschlich bleiben.

  • Schnell lernen und wachsen: Kontinuierliches Feedback, 360°-Reviews und ein eigenes Development-Budget, um genau die Skills aufzubauen, die du brauchst. Arbeite eng mit einem erfahrenen Managament Team zusammen, die Richtung vorgeben – statt deinen Alltag im Detail zu steuern.

  • Leidenschaftliches Team: Werde Teil eines motivierten, unterstützenden Teams, das Klarheit, Ownership und echten Impact schätzt. In unseren Pods arbeitest du in engen, eingespielten Teams – mit echter Zusammenarbeit statt nur geteilten Tools.

  • Kultur & Zugehörigkeit: Inklusiv, divers und mit Spaß an der Sache – von virtuellen Team-Events bis zu unvergesslichen Offsites schaffen wir überall ein starkes Gemeinschaftsgefühl, inklusive regelmäßigem gemeinsamem Co-Working in Berlin und München.

  • Am Erfolg beteiligt sein: Über unser VSOP-Programm hast du direkten Anteil am Wachstum des Unternehmens

Klingt nach einem Match?

Deine Ansprechpartnerin ist Mareike Buzzoni (Head of People and Culture)

Auch wenn du dir nicht zu 100 % sicher bist, ob du alle Kriterien erfüllst, möchten wir dich ausdrücklich ermutigen, dich trotzdem zu bewerben. Neugier, Begeisterung für digitale Innovation, Lernbereitschaft, Teamgeist und eine echte Growth-Mindset-Mentalität sind für uns am wichtigsten.

title: Demand Generation & Marketing Manager
description:
About REPLUG

REPLUG is a Mobile Revenue Growth partner that helps companies turn mobile into a measurable driver of revenue, customer value and long-term business growth.

From global app publishers to established brands looking to unlock more value from mobile, we partner with companies that want to grow more efficiently and build sustainable growth.

You’ll own the marketing plan, its execution and its performance. Working closely with the founders and Sales, you’ll decide where marketing should focus, challenge assumptions and connect marketing activity to qualified conversations, opportunities and pipeline value.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. You’ll combine commercial judgement with strong content and practical CRM skills, while ensuring our positioning and the experience prospects have with REPLUG remain consistent.

Success will be measured primarily through qualified opportunities generated, the quality and value of pipeline created, and marketing’s contribution to commercial growth.

What You’ll Do

Generate Demand from the Right Businesses

  • Plan and execute B2B campaigns around the problems, buying triggers and decision-makers within our priority customer profiles.

  • Choose and test the right mix of channels, including LinkedIn, email, partnerships, webinars and events, with a clear route from engagement to conversation.

  • Build campaign assets, landing pages and follow-up journeys. Work with Sales to improve targeting and lead quality using feedback from real conversations.

Own the Marketing Plan and Delivery

  • Translate business objectives into a clear marketing plan with priorities, campaigns, timelines, budgets and measures of success.

  • Make decisions about where to invest time and resources, explain your reasoning and challenge activities that lack a clear purpose.

  • Deliver core marketing activities yourself and coordinate contributions from founders, specialists and external partners. Keep delivery moving and identify where additional support is needed.

Own Content and Distribution

  • Coordinate founder and team LinkedIn activity, turning specialist insights and client results into relevant content for prospective buyers.

  • Create and commission case studies, website content and campaign materials. Own briefs, editorial quality, distribution and reuse across channels.

  • Develop partner activity that extends our reach into the right audiences. Keep messaging, tone and the prospect experience consistent across touchpoints.

Own CRM and Lead Nurturing

  • Own HubSpot marketing processes, including segmentation, forms, workflows, email nurturing, campaign tracking and data quality.

  • Build nurture journeys for contacts at different stages of interest, including those who fit our target profile but are not ready to buy.

Understand Performance and Improve It

  • Track how marketing contributes to qualified conversations and pipeline. Report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced opportunities separately.

  • Review conversion between stages with Sales, identify where prospects drop out and adjust campaigns, messaging or nurturing accordingly.

What We’re Looking For

We care about demonstrated impact and your personal contribution. You should be able to explain a campaign you owned, the decisions you made, and the commercial opportunities it generated.

  • 3 to 5 years of proven, hands-on B2B marketing experience, including campaigns designed to generate qualified demand for services or products through a considered sales process.

  • Practical HubSpot experience, including segmentation, workflows, nurturing and reporting. You can build and improve the setup yourself.

  • Experience owning a marketing plan and delivering it within limited resources, while coordinating colleagues and external contributors.

  • The confidence to challenge the founders constructively, make recommendations and take responsibility for the outcome.

  • Good brand judgement and the ability to balance immediate demand generation with long-term credibility.

Nice to Have

  • Experience marketing an agency, consultancy or other B2B services business.

  • Familiarity with mobile marketing, AdTech or the app growth ecosystem.

  • Experience building demand through founder visibility, expert content, partnerships or industry events.

  • Based in a location with convenient flight connections to Berlin, Germany.

What We Offer

  • Ownership of REPLUG’s marketing plan, with senior marketing guidance, direct access to the founders and influence over priorities.

  • The opportunity to shape how REPLUG reaches its next clients and demonstrate a clear contribution to business growth.

  • A EUR 1,000 annual educational budget

title: Engineering Fellowship
description:

The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of operators, unicorn early employees, ex-founders and people who walked away from degrees because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and n8n.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You’re a Fellow at Augustus, deployed to special projects across engineering, product, and the wider company. You own a project end to end: understand the problem, decide how to approach it, build the solution, and get it into use.

The work depends on where you can have the most impact. You could build background coding agents, create a frontend component library, or solve an operational problem with agents. The common thread is a meaningful problem, a clear outcome, and ownership of getting it done.

You’ll work closely with the team your project sits in. They provide context, technical guidance, and direct feedback. You bring the drive to turn an open-ended problem into something that works. As you deliver, the scope and difficulty of your projects grow.

Your First Months

Get context quickly, ship early, and take on harder problems as you prove yourself.

  • Month 1: Join a team, understand the problem, and take ownership of your first project. Talk to the people who will use what you build, agree on what success looks like, and ship an initial version.

  • Months 2–3: Drive the project through to adoption. Work through technical decisions, collect feedback, and improve the solution. You’re becoming more independent and developing better judgment about where to spend your time.

  • Months 4–6: Take on a larger project or a harder problem, potentially in another team. You can turn an ambiguous brief into a plan, make sound tradeoffs, and deliver with less guidance.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We care most about your trajectory, drive, and curiosity. You don’t need years of experience. You need evidence that you learn quickly, push yourself, and finish things.

  • Steep trajectory. You’re getting better fast. The problems you can solve today are meaningfully harder than those you could solve six months ago. You seek feedback and put it to work.

  • Drive. You make things happen. You find a way through unfamiliar problems, follow up without being chased, and stay with a project until it works.

  • Curiosity. You want to understand how things work and why. You dig into unfamiliar systems, ask precise questions, and look beyond the first plausible answer.

  • Ownership. You care about the outcome. You involve the right people, raise blockers early, and check that what you shipped actually solves the problem.

  • Low ego. You can defend an idea, change your mind, and commit to a team decision. You care more about getting it right than getting credit.

This fellowship is for you if:

  • You’ve built things outside a course or job because you wanted them to exist.

  • You want an ambitious problem and room to figure it out.

  • You enjoy moving between unfamiliar tools, systems, and domains.

  • You’re willing to do the less exciting work that makes a project useful: testing, documentation, rollout, and iteration.

  • You want direct feedback and responsibility that grows with your ability.

You’ll struggle here if:

  • You need a complete specification before you can start.

  • You’re more interested in starting projects than finishing them.

  • You wait for someone else to notice that you’re blocked.

  • You only want to work within a narrow, predefined remit.

Hard Requirements

  • Available for 3–6 months.

  • Based in Berlin or willing to relocate for an in-person fellowship.

  • Able to build working software, demonstrated through projects, open-source contributions, previous work, or something you can show us.

  • Able to explain your decisions, ask for help when needed, and follow through.

What We Offer

Mit dem Übergang der ALPINA Markenrechte an BMW beginnt jetzt für die Gruppe ein neues Kapitel. Die automobile Leidenschaft wird unter der eigenständigen Marke Bovensiepen mit neuer Ausrichtung weitergeführt. Sechs Sparten bilden dabei das Rückgrat der Unternehmensgruppe, die Transformation als Chance versteht.

Für den Ausbau unseres Gebrauchtwagengeschäfts suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende und handelnde Führungspersönlichkeit.

Sie verantworten das Kundenerlebnis für zwei Fahrzeugwelten: unsere Bovensiepen-Neufahrzeuge, die in unserer Manufaktur in Buchloe nach Kundenwunsch entstehen, und unsere Certified Cars, geprüfte und aufbereitete Premium-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge.

Ab der ersten Anfrage begleiten Sie den Kunden Hand in Hand mit unseren Verkaufsberatern und Handelspartnern: Der Vertrieb führt das Verkaufsgespräch, Sie machen den gesamten Weg bis zur Übergabe und die Zeit danach zu einem Erlebnis. Ihre Kunden erwarten, dass jedes Detail sitzt und schätzen jede Idee, die ihr Fahrzeug noch persönlicher macht.

Diese Rolle gibt es bei uns in dieser Form zum ersten Mal. Sie übernehmen keinen fertigen Prozess, Sie gestalten ihn: Welche Momente begeistern unsere Kunden? Wie sieht eine Übergabe aus, von der sie noch Jahre später erzählen? Wann ist der richtige Zeitpunkt für die passende Sonderausstattung? Ihre Antworten setzen Sie selbst um. 50 Meter neben Ihrem Schreibtisch entstehen die Fahrzeuge, die Sie betreuen.

Aufgaben

  • Konfiguration und Individualisierung: Sie beraten Kunden gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb zu Ausstattung, Materialien, Lackfarben und Interieur und übersetzen ihre Wünsche in verbindliche Fertigungs- und Aufbereitungsaufträge.

  • Zusatzgeschäft mit Fingerspitzengefühl: Sie bieten zum richtigen Zeitpunkt Sonderausstattung und Zusatzleistungen rund um Pflege und Service an, stets beratend, niemals drängend.

  • Auftragssteuerung: Sie verfolgen Termine, klären Detailfragen direkt mit Manufaktur, Werkstatt, Einkauf und Logistik und informieren den Kunden proaktiv über jeden Meilenstein. Damit sind Sie die zentrale Schnittstelle zu unseren Kunden.

  • Übergabe als Höhepunkt: Sie planen und gestalten die Fahrzeugübergabe in Buchloe, beim Handelspartner oder beim Kunden, nicht als Ende des Prozesses, sondern als den ersten Höhepunkt einer langfristigen Kundenbeziehung.

  • Nachbetreuung: Sie orchestrieren nach der Übergabe in Abstimmung mit Vertrieb und Handelspartnern den laufenden Kontakt, holen Feedback ein, lösen Anliegen schnell und erkennen Anlässe für Zubehör, Service oder das nächste Fahrzeug.

  • Customer Journey weiterentwickeln: Sie werten Kundenfeedback und Zufriedenheitswerte aus, verbessern die Kontaktpunkte laufend und bringen Ideen für Kundenevents, Manufakturbesuche und Übergabeformate ein.

  • Daten, die tragen: Sie pflegen Kunden- und Auftragsdaten in CRM und ERP so, dass Vertrieb und Geschäftsleitung darauf Entscheidungen bauen.

Diese Rolle ist nicht die Sachbearbeitung hinter dem Vertrieb. Sie ist das Gesicht von Bovensiepen zwischen erster Anfrage und Schlüsselübergabe, und auch weit darüber hinaus.

Was Sie in den ersten zwölf Monaten bewegen

  • Sie lernen Kunden, Handelspartner, Manufaktur und Fahrzeuge kennen und führen die ersten Aufträge eigenverantwortlich zur Übergabe.

  • Sie zeichnen die heutige Customer Journey auf und benennen die Momente, die begeistern – und die, die wir verbessern.

  • Sie entwickeln ein Übergabe- und Nachbetreuungskonzept, das unsere Kunden so noch nicht erlebt haben und das nachhaltig in Erinnerung bleibt.

  • Sie bauen ein Angebot aus Sonderausstattung, Zusatzleistungen und Erlebnis auf, das zum Kunden passt und machen seinen Erfolg messbar.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil – Gastfreundschaft und Kaufmannsverstand

Sie haben ein echtes Gespür für Menschen und Freude daran, sie zu begeistern. Sie begegnen anspruchsvollen Kunden auf Augenhöhe, sprechen mit dem Sattler über Nahtbilder und behalten zehn Aufträge parallel im Blick, ohne dass einer aus dem Raster fällt. Sie verkaufen gern, weil Sie wissen, dass das richtige Angebot zur richtigen Zeit für den Kunden ein Gewinn ist.

Was uns zusätzlich überzeugt

  • Erfahrung mit Individualisierungsprogrammen, Fahrzeugkonfiguration oder Kleinserien

  • Erfahrung mit Kundenevents, Clienteling oder Kennzahlen zur Kundenzufriedenheit (z. B. NPS)

  • Weitere Fremdsprache (Englisch, Französisch, Italienisch, Japanisch) für die Betreuung internationaler Kunden

Was uns wichtiger ist als jedes Zertifikat: der Instinkt für Menschen, der Wille, jeden Auftrag zu Ende zu denken, und die Freude daran, für einen Kunden mehr möglich zu machen, als er erwartet hat.

Dein Profil: Erfahrung, Haltung, Führung.

  • Du willst langfristig gestalten und bringst Dich vor Ort voll in die Klinik ein

Umsetzung statt Beratung.
Du trägst Verantwortung und setzt selbst um. Keine Folienschlachten, sondern Ergebnisse im Haus.

Ein Netzwerk aus Praktikern für Prozess, Personal, Controlling und IT, das den Krankenhausalltag kennt.

Perspektive.
Eine langfristige Aufgabe beim Kunden, kurze Entscheidungswege und Raum, Actura mit aufzubauen.

Dann bring Deine Erfahrung dort ein, wo sie gebraucht wird und dauerhaft wirkt. Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung.

Spread Group is a renowned global provider of customized apparel and lifestyle products, distinguished by our commitment to made-to-order technology. In the Platform Engineering team, you will build the next generation of the internal developer platform behind Spread Group's core services - a cloud-native platform on AWS, designed from the ground up. We see our platform as a product and our developers as our customers.

This is a greenfield build with real design freedom: you shape the architecture, the golden paths and the self-service capabilities - not just keep existing systems running. Your platform will serve roughly 175 services from 13 product teams in our European and North American regions. Today they run on more than a dozen Kubernetes clusters with around 280 nodes and 4,000 running pods - migrating them step by step onto the new platform while everything keeps running is a core part of the mission.

What You´ll Do 

  • Build the next-generation cloud-native platform on AWS - you own the architecture and design decisions from day one

  • Design and build platform services, APIs and self-service capabilities that let teams build, deploy and operate their core services end-to-end

  • Provide "golden paths": standardized templates, pipelines and building blocks that get teams to production quickly and safely

  • Build and evolve the AWS cloud infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code, including Kubernetes and managed services

  • Keep the platform secure, reliable and cost-efficient

  • Work closely with development teams to understand their needs and continuously improve the developer experience

  • Maintain the existing on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes landscape - keeping all services reliably running while the migration to AWS is underway

  • Guide the migration of roughly 175 existing services onto the new platform

What You´ll Bring

  • Several years of professional experience (mid-level to senior) in software engineering, ideally in platform engineering, SRE or DevOps - a computer science degree is welcome but not required

  • Solid experience with AWS and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)

  • Strong software engineering skills - you write production-grade code in a language such as Go, Python or TypeScript, building platform services and APIs, not just infrastructure scripts

  • Solid Git skills and knowledge of platform services such as CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI) and observability (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana)

  • A product mindset - you see developers as the customers of your work

  • Good communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with GitOps (e.g., Argo CD) and secrets management (e.g., Vault)

  • Experience with internal developer portals (e.g., Backstage)

  • Experience with messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)

title: Director of Cloud infrastructure and security
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role:

Vestiaire Collective runs a global marketplace on AWS and GCP — Kubernetes, Kafka, Terraform, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, a large PHP application under active modernisation, a series of microservices in different tech stacks (Goland, PHP, Node) and a fast-growing surface of AI-powered services. 

 

As Director of Cloud Infrastructure and Security, you will lead a small team of six senior individual contributors across Cloud Infrastructure (DevOps/SRE) and Security. This is a hands-on Director role: alongside setting the strategy and roadmap, you will work directly with the team on architecture, technical decisions, incidents and delivery. You will be accountable, alongside Product Development teams, for the reliability, cost-efficiency and security posture of everything we run in production.

What you will do:

Leadership across two teams

  • Directly lead, develop and retain a small team of six (6) experienced engineers across Cloud Infrastructure and Security. This is a player-coach role without multiple management layers, so you will remain close to the team’s technical work and day-to-day priorities.

  • Define a joint roadmap for both teams, aligned to business priorities and risk appetite, and make explicit calls on what we will not do.

  • Establish clear KPIs, SLOs and risk metrics, and report regularly to leadership on reliability, cost and security posture.

  • Set the operating model: what product teams self-serve behind guardrails versus what your teams own centrally. 

  • Foster a culture where reliability and security are shared accountabilities, not tickets thrown over a wall, including establishing a Security Champions model across engineering.

Cloud infrastructure, reliability and platform

  • Own our AWS and GCP footprint end to end: EKS, networking, secrets (Vault), data stores (RDS/Aurora, MSK, ElastiCache, MongoDB Atlas, OpenSearch) and the edge (Cloudflare).

  • Establish real reliability engineering practice: SLOs and error budgets, capacity planning, and a business continuity plan.

  • Drive infrastructure-as-code maturity: Automating Terraform change application, advancing our move to GitOps (ArgoCD), and enforcing guardrails at creation time with policy-as-code (Kyverno/OPA) so provisioning is safe, self-serve and reviewable.

  • Consolidate observability into a single source of truth for metrics, logs and traces.

  • Improve developer experience and delivery throughput: CI/CD (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), paved roads, test environments on demand, and delivery metrics that hold up.

  • Own FinOps: infrastructure cost per unit of business value, cost accountability pushed back to each team, and continued run-rate reduction. Cost discipline is a first-class objective.

  • Support the modernisation of our core platform: Tech migrations, runtime and framework upgrades, and continuous database and Kubernetes upgrades.

  • Attack toil systematically: automate the recurring requests, and hand safe self-service back to product teams rather than absorbing the work.

  • Grow the foundations for AI-augmented engineering and operations

Security

  • Own security strategy and posture across cloud, application, identity, detection and response, building and improving the governance: risk register, published roadmap, remediation SLAs, and a recurring reporting cadence for leadership.

  • Strengthen cloud security posture management (CNAPP) and secure-by-default configurations across all environments.

  • Improve Embedding security into the SDLC and CI/CD: establish full static-analysis and dependency-scanning coverage with clear criteria for when critical findings block a release.

  • Mature vulnerability management, penetration testing and our bug bounty program into one prioritised program with SLAs and aging reports that measurably reduce risk.

  • Advance identity and access management toward least privilege and zero trust: automated provisioning from groups, and periodic access reviews.

  • Mature logging, detection and incident response, closing SIEM coverage gaps

  • Set guardrails for safe AI adoption (shadow AI outside approved paths, data and prompt leakage, prompt injection, model abuse) and defend against AI-enabled fraud and phishing.

  • Ensure compliance with GDPR, PCI DSS v4, NIS2, and CIS v8, including a maintained, reusable evidence library rather than evidence gathered on request.

  • Collaboration with legal and finance teams on compliance and forensic investigation topics

  • Manage third-party and supply-chain risk with vendor tiering and a recurring review cadence.

  • Own the security-built services your team already runs (back-office authentication and ACL, banning/fraud tooling, phone verification) and decide what to keep, hand over or retire.

  • Own endpoint security and partner closely with Corporate IT on device and identity coverage.

  • Keep security awareness and training relevant to a threat landscape that now includes AI-enabled social engineering.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years with a Significant experience in Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, DevOps, SRE or Cloud Security, including experience leading engineers.

  • You may currently be an Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager or Head of who is ready to broaden your scope and step into a first Director role.

  • Strong practical experience with public cloud, ideally AWS, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code, with the willingness to remain close to architecture, incidents and technical delivery.

  • Track record establishing reliability practice at scale — SLOs, incident management, on-call, capacity planning, disaster recovery.

  • Demonstrable cloud cost optimisation / FinOps results at meaningful scale.

  • Strong grounding in cloud and application security fundamentals — IAM, network security, secrets management, CSPM, OWASP Top 10 — and the judgement to know when to hire the depth you don't have.

  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks (GDPR, DORA, PCI DSS, NIS2) and how to turn requirements into practical controls.

  • Experience leading through incidents and security events under pressure.

  • Excellent communication skills: able to make a technical trade-off legible to a CFO and a risk decision legible to an engineer.

  • Comfortable operating with a lean team — ruthless prioritisation, automation over headcount, pragmatism over perfection.

 

Our Tech Stack includes: 

  • AWS cloud (primary), GCP, Kubernetes, Vault, Cloudflare, Datadog, ArgoCD, Okta. Applications are built on top of PHP 8, Golang and Node.js, using MariaDB, MongoDB and Kafka.

What we offer 🎁

A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability
The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up
The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities

description:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity.

tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators.

We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale.

In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership.

We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide.

Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems.

At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception.

🚀 The Role

We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team.

tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive.

This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply.

  • Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution.

  • Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle.

  • Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked.

  • Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data.

🛠️ Responsibilities

  • Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries.

  • Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most.

  • Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions.

  • Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them.

  • Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust.

  • Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture.

  • Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold.

  • Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it.

  • Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions.

Must-Haves

  • You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality.

  • You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market.

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration.

title: Orbital Analyst
description:
Orbital Analyst

About us

Foundational is building the most precise picture of Earth and orbit, using lasers fired from the ground. We call it ground truth for orbit.

We design and run low-cost, autonomous satellite laser ranging stations. They measure the distance to satellites with extreme precision, day and night. Our data platform turns those measurements into tracking data and orbit products for satellite operators, space agencies and governments. We also build our own flight-proven laser retroreflector arrays, so any satellite can be tracked.

Our station network is expanding across Europe, South America, Africa and Australia. The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space.

Role Outcome

The Network Customer Support Engineer owns the customer support experience tied to the reliability, visibility, and operational health of Point One’s correction network.

This is a player-coach role. You will personally handle complex technical support cases while also leading the operational systems, monitoring, and processes that ensure the network performs reliably at scale.

Success in this role means:

  • Potential customer facing issues are identified and addressed before they impact customers.

  • When incidents do occur, they are resolved quickly with clear communication and strong root-cause analysis.

  • The organization has clear visibility into network health, operational trends, and customer friction.

  • A scalable network operations and support function is built as the company and network footprint grow.

Immediate Areas of Focus

Own the customer experience of our Network

  • Work with our Network Operations team to understand incidents that affect the customer experience

  • Identify emerging issues and collaborate with engineering and manufacturing teams to understand and support the resolution of those issues.

  • Understand available metrics and dashboards and contribute to the development of these tools to allow for the targeted resolution of customer questions.

Deliver High-Quality Technical Support

  • Liaison between Engineering, Network Operations and FAE and FDE team to support the customer.

  • Personally manage high-impact or technically complex support cases.

  • Partner closely with FAEs, Product, and Engineering to diagnose issues and close the loop with customers.

  • Ensure customers receive clear, confident communication during investigations and incidents.

  • Model best-in-class technical troubleshooting and customer engagement practices for the team.

Build the Foundation for a Scalable Operations & Support Function

  • Design and implement systems that enable both network operations and customer support to scale.

  • Define a support ticket taxonomy that reflects customer use cases, technical complexity, and operational impact.

  • Support Network Ops team on operational metrics such as:

    • Network uptime and availability

    • Incident response and resolution times

    • Support response and resolution times

    • Alert quality and monitoring coverage

    • Document operational procedures, escalation paths, and ownership models.

  • Develop automation and tooling to reduce manual work and improve operational efficiency.

Surface Operational and Customer Insights

  • Identify patterns across support tickets, network events, and operational data.

  • Translate operational signals into actionable insights for Product and Engineering.

  • Ensure recurring issues and infrastructure gaps are clearly surfaced and prioritized.

  • Create lightweight reporting that gives leadership visibility into network reliability, operational trends, and customer friction.

Establish Visibility Into Customer Experience

  • Define and implement the right metrics for understanding customer experience and operational impact.

  • Establish mechanisms to collect structured customer feedback without creating noise.

  • Use both operational data and customer feedback to drive continuous improvement.

Coach and Develop the Operations & Support Function

  • Act as a player-coach, leading through hands-on operational work while building the foundations of the team.

  • Train and mentor support engineers on troubleshooting methodology, operational awareness, and customer communication.

  • Establish clear expectations for technical depth, ownership, and responsiveness.

  • Continuously raise the operational and support bar as the team grows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in a two European languages in addition to English.

  • Experience in a player-coach technical operations or support role where you owned both hands-on troubleshooting and operational systems.

  • Strong technical background in GPS/GNSS, precise localization, geospatial infrastructure, or closely related domains (robotics, autonomy, embedded systems, positioning technologies).

  • Demonstrated ability to build or significantly improve monitoring, alerting, and operational processes.

  • Proven experience troubleshooting complex technical systems and working directly with customers.

  • Experience conducting incident response and root cause analysis.

  • Ability to define metrics, processes, and documentation without over-engineering.

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, and Go-To-Market teams in a fast-moving environment.

  • Bias toward ownership, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Our Cultural Foundation

At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.

This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.

That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.

We think about our culture in two dimensions:

How We Show Up Every Day

These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:

  • Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.

  • High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.

  • Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.

  • No Ego, One Team — Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.

  • Self Accountability — Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.

Operating Principles

Financial management and business support

  • Oversee budgeting, forecasting, cash flow planning and financial reporting, supported by internal finance resources and external partners.

Leadership and continuous improvement

  • Set priorities, allocate resources and ensure actions are completed.

  • Build trusted working relationships with managers and colleagues across the organisation.

  • Simplify processes and adapt corporate services as the business evolves.

You'll harden the platform so that classes of failure can't recur, build observability and SLOs to let us see problems before they surface, plan capacity ahead of relentless data growth, and automate away the toil of safely operating many production environments. You'll work across our deployment and infrastructure-as-code and partner closely with product engineering to feed reliability learnings back into the platform.   • Owning the availability, latency and performance of our production environments: large-scale search and retrieval services, ingestion and data stores on container-orchestrated infrastructure across multiple public and private clouds

  • Defining and instrumenting SLOs and error budgets and building the dashboards, metrics and alerting that make production observable and actionable

  • Reducing operational toil through automation and internal tooling written in Python and / or Go

  • Provisioning and standardizing new production environments to a defined reliability bar

  • Are strong at container-orchestration operations in production and comfortable on at least one major public cloud

  • Practice observability hands-on with metrics, logs and traces, and use it to root-cause live incidents

  • Work fluently with infrastructure-as-code and GitOps

  • Bring sound production judgment and document your work clearly for other engineers

  • Bonus: experience operating a large-scale search or distributed data system, database operations, dedicated / enterprise-deployed software, or AI / enterprise-search infrastructure in regulated domains

title: Senior Cosmetic Chemist
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior Cosmetic Chemist for our KEUNE Beauty Solutions team. You combine excellent formulation skills with the confidence to tackle development projects independently. You will remain closely involved in hands-on laboratory work while taking responsibility for assigned projects, guiding fellow medior and junior chemists, and working directly with clients and cross-functional teams to bring high-performing products to market.

At KEUNE, we develop and manufacture not only our own professional haircare products but also products for KEUNE Beauty Solutions (KBS), our private label division. Through KBS, we partner with beauty brands worldwide, offering end-to-end solutions from formulation development and manufacturing to the delivery of finished products.

MISSION

  • Lead assigned new product development projects from brief to commercialization, taking ownership of technical execution, deliverables, timelines, and follow-up in line with the NPD process.

  • Develop and optimize haircare, hairstyling, and hair color formulations through hands-on laboratory work, ensuring product performance, safety, quality, and regulatory compliance.

  • Act as technical reference for assigned projects: review client briefs, clarify requirements, identify risks, and translate expectations into a clear development plan.

  • Participate in and lead technical discussions with clients, working alongside Project Management and Commercial teams to align expectations, feasibility, and next steps.

  • Provide technical guidance to junior and mid-level chemists working on shared projects, while maintaining ownership for project outcomes.

  • Plan, organize, execute, document, and follow up on submissions, stability, safety, and performance testing, ensuring decisions and results are properly tracked.

  • Proactively identify potential delays or technical challenges, communicate them early, and drive practical solutions with the relevant stakeholders.

  • Support scale-up, first production runs, and troubleshooting in collaboration with Production and Quality Control.

  • Stay informed about market trends, emerging ingredients, and technologies, and turn insights into relevant innovation concepts and proposals for clients.

  • Apply appropriate instrumental and analytical methods to evaluate formulations, substantiate performance, and support technical decisions.

YOU

  • Master's degree in Chemistry, Cosmetic Science, or a related field.

  • At least 7 years of relevant cosmetic formulation and development experience, with strong expertise in hair products.

  • A proven track record of developing and successfully launching cosmetic products.

  • Strong hands-on formulation skills, paired with the ability to organize and tackle multiple development activities.

  • A proactive, independent, and accountable working style: you take initiative, follow through on commitments, and know when to escalate issues.

  • Confidence in leading technical client conversations, challenging or clarifying briefs constructively, and managing expectations together with cross-functional colleagues.

  • Ability to guide junior and mid-level chemists.

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Curiosity about innovation, new ingredients, and opportunities to improve products and ways of working.

  • Eligible to work in the Netherlands



OUR OFFER

  • A sustainably-conscious employer;

  • Travel allowance

  • 27 vacation days per year (based on full-time employment);

  • Relocation support

  • A good pension plan;

  • A competitive salary;

  • 8% holiday pay;

  • And never have a "bad hair day" again thanks to staff discounts on the entire Keune collection!

  • Attention to your mental well-being through unlimited access to OpenUp

  • Participation in group classes at Personal Fitness Soest

KEUNE

We are a family business with a long-term vision, where science is at the heart of everything we do. Our story begins in 1922, in Amsterdam. Today, KEUNE belongs to one of the fastest growing brands in professional hair care products. From our headquarters in Soest, KEUNE products are developed, produced and distributed worldwide to more than 85 countries. And we have no intention of slowing down! Every year we open a new site of our own. We produce in a sustainable and animal-friendly way and are B Corp-certified. Je zoekt actief kansen op, weet klant behoeften niet alleen te identificeren maar ook te sturen en laat je niet uit het veld slaan door een nee. Jouw werkzaamheden omvatten onder andere:

·       Je brengt de markt in kaart, kiest doelorganisaties en bouwt een gerichte pipeline op;

Wie jij bent

Je bent geen typische verkoper. Je bent een ondernemende verbinder: iemand die nieuwe kansen ziet, deuren durft te openen en mensen en organisaties oprecht wil begrijpen. Herken jij jezelf hierin?

·       Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

·       Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, laptop en telefoon;

·       Een rol met echte impact: jij opent de deuren waardoor Beter Healthcare kan groeien en de zorg kan verbeteren;

·       Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invloed op onze commerciële koers;

·       Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen, zowel commercieel als inhoudelijk;

·       Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

·       Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega's op inspirerende locaties;

·       Een hecht team van gedreven healthcare consultants dat altijd met je meedenkt;

·       Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen;

Over Beter Healthcare

  • Drive reliability improvements through asset health monitoring, KPI analysis, and predictive maintenance techniques

  • Lead Root Cause Analyses (RCA) and implement sustainable corrective actions

title: Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen
description:
Bij DeWarmte maken we slimme en betaalbare warmtepompen waarmee we woningen van het gas af helpen. We ontwerpen onze producten zelf, assembleren ze in Utrecht en zorgen samen met onze installatiepartners dat ze bij steeds meer mensen thuis komen te staan.

We groeien hard. Tot nu toe worden al onze warmtepompen geïnstalleerd door externe partners, maar daar komt verandering in. We gaan onze eigen installatieteams opbouwen en zoeken daarom een Hoofdmonteur Warmtepompen die hierin het voortouw neemt.

Je komt dus niet in een bestaand team terecht. Je helpt het team zelf opbouwen.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Hoofdmonteur ben je verantwoordelijk voor de installatie van onze warmtepompen bij klanten thuis. Je begint met het leiden van ons eerste interne installatieteam en helpt ons om de komende jaren onze eigen installatiecapaciteit verder uit te bouwen.

Je bouwt mee aan ons interne installatieteam

  • Je begeleidt en traint nieuwe monteurs en helpt hen om zelfstandig installaties uit te kunnen voeren.

Wie zoeken wij?

  • Je neemt initiatief, denkt in oplossingen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het eindresultaat.

Bij DeWarmte geloven we dat verduurzaming pas echt werkt als het voor iedereen bereikbaar en aantrekkelijk is. Daarom ontwikkelen we slimme, betaalbare warmtepompen die we zelf ontwerpen en assembleren.

Solliciteer en kom kennismaken. We vertellen je graag meer over DeWarmte, onze warmtepompen en onze plannen voor het interne installatieteam.

description:

Gain operates globally with offices in New York, London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, Warsaw, and Bangalore.


How we work

  • Predicting what isn't published. Many private companies publish little or no financial detail. Across a database of more than 5 million companies, we predict revenue and EBITDA from sparse labels, and we predict whether and when a company will be bought or sold, which is a time-to-event problem with censored data.

  • Agents on a messy web. Our agents search, navigate and extract company data points from sources that contradict each other, then decide which source to trust before committing to an answer.

  • Quality that holds while everything underneath moves. We're provider-agnostic. Model choices follow the evals, and we switch LLMs when the numbers say so. That only works if the evals are trusted.

What will you do?

The work is roughly half LLM agents and half custom ML, leaning slightly toward agents.

  • The design of our agent pipelines: architecture, tools, and which model for which task. You'll shape the technical direction with our AI Lead.

  • The evaluation behind agents and models: offline reference sets, live production evals, and the call on whether an improvement is real.

  • Our prediction models for financials and deals: features, validation, retraining, and knowing when a simpler model wins.

  • Getting work into production: trace where pipelines fail and fix the weakest links first, with compute, memory and model cost in view.

  • Raising the bar in the team through design reviews, pairing, and an eval-first habit that sticks.

In your first six months you'll own the evals for our agent pipelines, propose where we invest next, and ship measurable improvements to both the agents and the prediction models.

Who are you?

  • You've built and owned ML systems in production for years, typically 6+ in ML or software engineering.

  • In the last 1–2 years you've shipped LLM agents or pipelines that real users depend on, not demos.

  • You have modelling judgement. You've dealt with leakage, distribution shift and calibration on real data.

  • You measure before you claim. You can build an evaluation set and tell an honest improvement from a lucky one.

  • You care about the user outcome more than the technique. Ideas without a clear customer benefit don't get built here, however interesting.

  • Nice to have: time-to-event modelling, noisy or conflicting data sources, financial or private-company data. No finance background needed.

The team

You'll join our Data & AI team of six and report to Renan, our AI Lead who's been building production models for >10 years. Our engineering team runs the infrastructure, and you shape what runs on it.

The stack

  • Core: Python (async, fully typed with Pydantic) and FastAPI

  • LLMs: multiple providers behind our own provider-agnostic layer, with Pydantic AI for typed agents.

  • Evals and observability: Pydantic Evals and Logfire

  • Data: PostgreSQL with pgvector

  • Cloud: GCP (Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks), Docker, GitHub Actions

  • Attractive benefits including health & wellbeing allowance, work-from-home budget, learning & coaching benefits, etc.

title: Data Analist
description:
Zie jij snel welke data nodig is om een businessvraag te beantwoorden? Wat ga je doen

Je werkt vanuit het Data & AI Office binnen één of meerdere waardestromen van Univé. title: Senior Uitvoerder kabels & leidingen Railinfra
description:
Ambitie          
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen.

Als senior uitvoerder kabels & leidingen werk je aan ondergrondse infra rond het spoor en op stations door heel Nederland. Je stuurt uitvoerders, vakmensen en onderaannemers aan, houdt meerdere belangen bij elkaar en zorgt dat het werk doorgaat. Ook als de planning verandert of de situatie buiten anders blijkt dan gedacht. Je krijgt daarbij te maken met onder andere telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Werk waarbij veiligheid, goede afstemming en de juiste beslissing op het juiste moment het verschil maken.

Dit ga je doen 
Jij zorgt dat het buiten gebeurt. Veilig, volgens afspraak en met een team dat weet wat het moet doen. Als uitvoerder 3 kabels & leidingen stuur je medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers aan en houd je grip op planning, kwaliteit en kosten.

Je werkt aan ondergrondse infra binnen onze railprojecten, zoals telecom, data, elektriciteitsleidingen en glasvezel. Je stuurt één of meerdere projecten tegelijk aan en houdt het overzicht, ook als het anders loopt dan gepland. Je gaat:

  • je team aansturen en motiveren, met duidelijke afspraken en ruimte voor vakmanschap;

  • veiligheid vooropzetten en collega's stimuleren risico’s en verbeteringen te delen;

  • plannen en bijsturen, prioriteiten stellen en knopen doorhakken als dat nodig is;

  • kwaliteit en kosten bewaken, inclusief het meer- en minderwerk;

  • schakelen met betrokken partijen, van je team en collega's tot ProRail, OV-bedrijven en netbeheerders;

  • verbeteringen aanjagen door kritisch te kijken, te luisteren en goede ideeën om te zetten in actie.

Je hoeft niet overal zelf naast te staan. Maar als het erop aankomt, weet jij wat er buiten speelt, ben je er en neem je een besluit.


Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en langetermijnvisievormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Dit verwachten wij van jou
Je bent een ervaren uitvoerder die overzicht houdt en duidelijk communiceert. Je weet wanneer je ruimte kunt geven en wanneer jij degene bent die een beslissing moet nemen. Voor deze rol breng je mee:

  • relevante ervaring met het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van ondergrondse infraprojecten;

  • ervaring met het aansturen van medewerkers, specialisten en onderaannemers;

  • een technische basis, bijvoorbeeld vanuit civiele techniek, elektrotechniek of werktuigbouwkunde;

  • een scherpe blik op veiligheid, kwaliteit, planning en kosten;

  • het vermogen om rustig te blijven, prioriteiten te stellen en beslissingen te nemen;

  • de communicatieve kracht om verschillende partijen bij elkaar te brengen;

  • bereidheid om te werken wanneer het spoorwerk daarom vraagt, ook buiten reguliere werktijden.

We verwachten niet dat je ieder probleem zelf oplost. Wel dat je ervoor zorgt dat problemen op tafel komen, de juiste mensen betrokken zijn en er uiteindelijk een besluit wordt genomen.

Waarom Dura Vermeer Railinfra?      
Hier krijg je de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen én verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je organiseert je werk met veel zelfstandigheid en krijgt mogelijkheden om jezelf via opleidingen verder te ontwikkelen.

En je werkt niet zomaar aan kabels en leidingen. Jouw werk is onderdeel van railprojecten waarin verschillende technische disciplines samenkomen. Dat vraagt om samenwerken, vooruitkijken en beslissingen nemen als het buiten anders loopt dan gepland.

Veilig werken staat daarbij voorop. In hoe je het werk organiseert, je team aanstuurt en de keuzes die je buiten maakt.


Wij hebben oog voor jou

Dura Vermeer is een grote organisatie waarin je veel kunt leren en waarin je kansen hebt om je ambities vorm te geven. Daarbij hechten we veel waarde aan opleiding, ontwikkeling en eigen initiatief. We hebben goede arbeidsvoorwaarden conform CAO Railinfrastructuur (RIS). Dus bieden we je onder meer:

  • Een goed salaris afhankelijk van de meegebrachte kennis, niveau en werkervaring beginnend bij € 4.620,- tot € 5.775,- bruto per 4 weken en dus 13 maal per jaar!;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 18 ADV dagen (beide op fulltime basis)

  • Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een standaard verzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap.

  • Een goede werk-privébalans dankzij soepele regelingen voor arbeidsduur, werktijden en thuiswerken en moderne verlofvormen voor onder meer ouderschap, calamiteiten, mantelzorg of een sabbatical.

  • Voor verse vaders: 100% doorbetaling van je salaris tijdens je (aanvullende) geboorteverlof.

  • Een zeer goede beloning wanneer je de nachten of weekenden gaat werken

  • Veel aandacht voor jouw groei, met onze eigen Dura Vermeer academie en een vergoeding in tijd en geld voor zowel vak- als loopbaangerichte opleidingen.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget of een leaseauto met grote keuzevrijheid. Smartphone en een laptop of tablet van de zaak.

  • Een vitaliteitsprogramma en een individueel keuzebudget voor duurzame inzetbaarheid.

  • En last but not least: fijne collega’s die in een professionele omgeving zorgen voor een ongekend goede werksfeer.

title: Standortentwickler (m/w/d)
description:
„Jeden Tag einen Menschen in eine sinnstiftende Tätigkeit bringen.“

Eine Stadt. Ein leeres Blatt. Dein Name drunter.

Berlin hat rund 3,9 Millionen Menschen, zwölf Bezirke, zwölf Jobcenter, eine Agentur für Arbeit mit mehreren Standorten – und einen Arbeitsmarkt, der dringend Menschen braucht, die qualifiziert, gecoacht und vermittelt werden. Dafür suchen wir keinen Verwalter und keinen Vertriebler, der nach Feierabend abschaltet. Du bekommst dafür die Rückendeckung einer etablierten Gruppe – und du wirst am Gewinn beteiligt, den du selbst erwirtschaftest.

Wer wir sind

Die EuBiA (Europäische Bildungsakademie) ist als operative Tochtergesellschaft der IWQ Holding ein Bildungsträger mit Standorten in NRW, Schleswig-Holstein und Hamburg sowie in Marokko. Seit über 15 Jahren konzipieren und realisieren wir geförderte Bildungsmaßnahmen, Coachings, Sprach- und Integrationskurse und Weiterbildungen – AZAV-zertifiziert, für Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Selbstzahler, national und international.

Was uns ausmacht: Herzlichkeit, Kompetenz und Engagement. Wir entscheiden schnell, arbeiten nah am Markt und nah an den Menschen. Bei uns arbeiten Kolleginnen und Kollegen unterschiedlichster Herkunft zusammen, wir beraten und unterrichten in mehreren Sprachen. Diversity is für uns kein Schlagwort, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Deine Mission

Du baust das gesamte Geschäft der EuBiA in Berlin auf – vom ersten Gespräch mit einem Kostenträger bis zum laufenden Standort mit Team, Teilnehmenden und schwarzen Zahlen. In dieser Reihenfolge, ungefähr:

  • Markt und Netzwerk – Du gehst von Tag eins auf die Agentur für Arbeit, die Berliner Jobcenter, das BAMF, die Senatsverwaltungen, Kammern, Verbände und Unternehmen zu. Du findest heraus, welche Bedarfe in welchem Bezirk offen sind – und wo wir mit unserem Angebot sofort einen Unterschied machen.
  • Standort – Du suchst und bewertest Räume, verhandelst, richtest ein und sorgst dafür, dass der Standort die Anforderungen der Kostenträger und der Zertifizierung erfüllt.
  • Angebot – Du entscheidest mit, welche Maßnahmen Berlin zuerst braucht – Coaching und Vermittlung (AVGS, § 45 SGB III), Weiterbildung (FBW), Sprach- und Integrationskurse, Firmenschulungen, Ausschreibungen – und bringst sie mit unserem QM-Team durch die Zulassung.
  • Vertrieb – Du gewinnst Kostenträger, Firmenkunden und Kooperationspartner, bearbeitest Ausschreibungen und füllst die Maßnahmen mit Teilnehmenden. Du verkaufst nicht nur – du hältst, was du verkaufst.
  • Team – Du stellst Coaches, Dozentinnen und Dozenten und Verwaltung ein, baust die Mannschaft auf, führst sie und machst sie stark.
  • Betrieb und Zahlen – Du verantwortest Budget, Auslastung, Ergebnis. Du kennst deine Kennzahlen jede Woche – Teilnehmende, Verbleib, Deckungsbeitrag – und steuerst danach.
  • Hands-on – Am Anfang bist du alles gleichzeitig: Vertrieb, Coach, Verwaltung, Hausmeister. Das schreckt dich nicht, das reizt dich.

Was du mitbringst

  • Berlin – Du lebst in Berlin, kennst die Stadt, die Bezirke, die Akteure – und hast bereits ein belastbares Netzwerk zu Kostenträgern, Verwaltungen, Unternehmen oder Trägern. Du weißt, wer in Berlin was entscheidet.
  • Arbeitsmarktdienstleistungen – Du kennst das Geschäft aus eigener Praxis: SGB II und SGB III, AZAV, AVGS, FBW, § 45, Ausschreibungen der Kostenträger, Integrations- und Berufssprachkurse. Du weißt, wie Maßnahmen zugelassen, gefüllt, abgerechnet und geprüft werden.
  • Geschäftstüchtigkeit – Du denkst wie eine Unternehmerin oder ein Unternehmer: Du erkennst Chancen, rechnest sie durch, entscheidest schnell und bringst sie auf die Straße. Du hast schon einmal etwas aufgebaut – einen Standort, ein Geschäftsfeld, ein Team oder ein Unternehmen.
  • Vertriebsstärke – Du gehst auf Menschen zu, kommst ins Gespräch, überzeugst und schließt ab – bei Kostenträgern wie bei Geschäftsführungen.
  • Führung – Du hast Teams aufgebaut und geführt und weißt, wie man aus Einzelpersonen eine Mannschaft macht.
  • Zahlenverständnis – Budget, Deckungsbeitrag, Auslastung – du steuerst mit Kennzahlen und nicht nach Gefühl.
  • Qualifikation – Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung – betriebswirtschaftlich, pädagogisch, sozial oder etwas ganz anderes. Entscheidend ist, was du bewegt hast.
  • Persönlichkeit – Gründergeist, Ausdauer, Verbindlichkeit. Du hältst Unsicherheit aus, bleibst dran, wenn es zäh wird, und feierst, wenn der erste Teilnehmende einen Arbeitsvertrag unterschreibt.

Was wir dir geben

  • Gewinnbeteiligung – Du baust den Standort auf – und du bist am Gewinn beteiligt, den er erwirtschaftet. Die Details klären wir im Gespräch, offen und transparent.
  • Freiheit – Du entscheidest vor Ort. Wir geben dir Ziele, keine Mikro-Anweisungen. Entscheidungen fallen bei uns schnell – 70 Prozent Informationslage reichen.
  • Rückendeckung – Du startest nicht bei null: Zertifizierung und Qualitätsmanagement, erprobte Maßnahmenkonzepte, Verwaltung, Buchhaltung, Marketing und 15 Jahre Erfahrung im Ausschreibungsgeschäft stehen hinter dir.
  • Direkter Draht – Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung der Gruppe zusammen – kurze Wege, schnelle Antworten.
  • Perspektive – Wer Berlin aufbaut, leitet Berlin. Die Standortleitung ist der logische nächste Schritt.
  • Sinn – Jeder Mensch, den dein Standort in Arbeit bringt, ist dein Ergebnis. Das sieht man – jeden Tag.
  • Corporate Benefits und betriebliche Altersvorsorge – Weil wir auch an deine Zukunft denken.

Bewerbung & rechtlicher Hinweis

Klingt nach dir? Dann erzähl uns in deiner Bewerbung vor allem eins: Was hast du schon aufgebaut – und wie würdest du in Berlin anfangen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Diese Stelle wird zentral von der IWQ Holding GmbH ausgeschrieben. Die Anstellung erfolgt bei der für den Standort Berlin zuständigen operativen Tochtergesellschaft der EuBiA-Gruppe.

Bei uns zählt der Mensch: Bewerbungen sind unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, sexueller Identität oder einer Behinderung ausdrücklich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Full-Stack Engineer - ElevenMusic
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenMusic is a consumer music app where music is the core product: a place to listen, create, remix and stream. The team works in its own environment, separate from the main org, and is agent-first with fast CI, so ideas reach users within a day or two.

You’ll own features end to end, from spotting the problem to shipping the product and the backend behind it. Most of what you build is new, in a space where few companies are working with AI and music, so there’s no playbook. You’ll define the problem yourself, test ideas with real users, and work alongside research engineering to turn model capabilities into things people love using. What you ship goes live to a large audience within days.

You’re a builder with strong product taste who understands every layer of the system. You use AI to move fast, but you own and understand everything you ship. You care about music and the people who make it.

Requirements

  • Have shipped and owned a well-designed consumer product from zero to real users, across frontend and backend

  • Understand your systems deeply enough to spot immediately when a PR is wrong, insecure or needlessly complex

  • Show excellent product judgement: you know the most valuable thing to build, and what not to build

  • Work autonomously with minimal direction, and take responsibility for fixing problems as you find them

  • Have a real interest in music, or in the people who make it

Bonus: Open-source or GitHub track record, experience building music or audio products, or experience with recommendation systems or embeddings.

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Europe and the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT+1 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, Dublin, Amsterdam, and Warsaw.

title: Campaign & Account Manager DACH – Mandarin (all genders)
description:
