About Vexcash AG

VEXCASH AG is Germany’s leading online provider of short-term loans. We offer our customers a quick and straightforward solution to tide them over until their next payday. More than 800,000 customers already trust our service. Thanks to our innovative approach, they can secure financial liquidity without having to commit to a long-term arrangement.

Your responsibilities

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and motivated Quality & Assurance Manager to lead and continuously improve our quality management processes. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that our products, services, and operational processes consistently meet internal standards, customer expectations, and applicable regulatory requirements.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for improvement, manage quality risks, and promote a strong culture of quality and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain the company’s Quality Management System (QMS)

  • Ensure compliance with applicable quality standards, regulations, and customer requirements

  • Define and monitor quality objectives, KPIs, and performance indicators

  • Lead internal and external audits and coordinate corrective and preventive actions

  • Identify quality risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures

  • Investigate quality issues, customer complaints, and non-conformities and ensure effective root-cause analysis

  • Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA)

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across processes and operations

  • Work closely with all other departments

  • Provide guidance, training, and support to employees on quality-related topics

  • Prepare quality reports and present relevant findings and improvement measures to management

  • Ensure that quality documentation and records are maintained accurately and effectively

Qualifikation

Your Qualifications

Freelancers must meet the requirements for working on a freelance basis and include their proposed monthly rate in their application.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quality Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field

  • Several years of professional experience in quality management, quality assurance, or a comparable position

  • Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems and relevant quality standards

  • Experience with audits, root-cause analysis, CAPA, and continuous improvement methodologies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across departments

  • Structured, proactive, and results-oriented approach to work

  • Strong organizational and project management skills

  • Very good command of English; German language skills are an advantage

  • Experience with relevant standards is a plus

Benefits

  • A responsible and varied position with a high level of autonomy

  • The opportunity to actively shape and further develop our quality organization

  • A collaborative and international working environment

If you are motivated and excited about taking on this responsible role and becoming part of our success story, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Haus- und Veranstaltungstechniker (m/w/div.) in der Laeiszhalle
description:
Das Team von Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen

Haus- und Veranstaltungstechniker (m/w/div.) in der Laeiszhalle

in Vollzeit.

Die Stelle ist zunächst auf 6 Monate befristet. Eine Verlängerung sowie eine spätere Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Beschäftigungsverhältnis können sich gegebenenfalls anschließen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehört unter anderem:

  • Wartung, Pflege und Instandhaltung der Veranstaltungs- und Gebäudetechnik

  • Übernahme allgemeiner haustechnischer Tätigkeiten

  • Auf- und Abbau von Bühnenmobiliar

  • Steuerung der veranstaltungstechnischen Abläufe als technischer Inspizient

  • Übernahme von Aufgaben und Pflichten als Verantwortlicher für Veranstaltungstechnik gemäß §§ 38, 40 Hmbg. VStättVO

  • Bedienung der Veranstaltungstechnik entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung

  • Unterstützung bei der Implementierung neuer Gebäude- und Veranstaltungstechnik im Rahmen der laufenden Sanierung sowie Begleitung von Inbetriebnahmen und Erstkonfigurationen

Als fachliches Profil erwarten wir von dir:

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Fachkraft für Veranstaltungstechnik oder eine abgeschlossene handwerkliche Berufsausbildung (z. B. Elektroniker, Gebäudetechniker)

  • Fachrichtungsübergreifende Grundlagen in Licht-, Ton-, Video- und Netzwerktechnik

  • Gute EDV-Grundkenntnisse (z. B. MS Office, CAD-Programme)

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Gebäudetechnik wünschenswert

  • Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Deine persönlichen Voraussetzungen sind:

  • Flexibilität bei der Arbeit im Rahmen von Sanierungsmaßnahmen

  • Bereitschaft zur Tätigkeit in einem gemischten Haus- und Veranstaltungstechnikteam

  • Begeisterung für technische Anlagen sowie Konzertveranstaltungen aller Art

  • Hohes Maß an Organisations-, Kommunikations- und Teamfähigkeit sowie Belastbarkeit

  • Fähigkeit zum abteilungs- und gewerkübergreifenden Denken

  • Sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Wochenenden, Feiertagen und in den Abendstunden

Über uns:

Die Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle Betriebsgesellschaft mbH ist die Betreiberin der Elbphilharmonie sowie der über 100 Jahre alten Laeiszhalle. In beiden Häusern finden neben den hauseigenen »Elbphilharmonie Konzerten« auch Konzerte externer Konzertveranstalter statt, zusammen etwa 1.000 Veranstaltungen pro Jahr. Die Abteilung Technik ist dem Unternehmensziel der umfassenden serviceorientierten Dienstleistung verpflichtet. Als erster Anlaufpunkt in den Bereichen Veranstaltungs- und Hausbetriebstechnik ist sie in der Lage einen umfassenden Veranstaltungsservice auf dem neusten Stand der Technik anzubieten.

Arbeitsort:

Dein Arbeitsort ist überwiegend die Laeiszhalle. Die Arbeitswege sind leider nicht durchgehend rollstuhlgerecht und daher für Menschen mit Mobilitätseinschränkungen nur eingeschränkt oder gar nicht zu bewältigen. Die Arbeitsplätze sind nicht rollstuhlgerecht ausgestattet. Gerne informieren wir dich über die vorhandenen Barrieren.

Wir bieten:

  • Spannende Tätigkeit in einem modernen Konzertbetrieb

  • Kollegiale Atmosphäre in einem dynamischen Team

  • Vergütung nach dem Tarifvertrag der Arbeitsrechtlichen Vereinigung Hamburg e. V. (AVH) in Entgeltgruppe 6, mit Einstufung nach individueller Vorerfahrung

  • Attraktive Jahressonderzahlung

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge nach dem Hamburger Zusatzversorgungsgesetz sowie Arbeitgeberzuschuss zu einem privaten Altersvorsorge-Modell

  • Vergünstigungen bei Konzertkarten und Artikeln im Shop auf der Elbphilharmonie-Plaza

  • Deutschland-Ticket des HVV inkl. Arbeitgeberzuschuss und gute Anbindung an den ÖPNV

  • Dienstrad-Leasing

  • 6 Wochen Urlaub pro Kalenderjahr

  • Cafeteria mit Ausblick auf den Hamburger Hafen

  • Events für Mitarbeitende

Die Elbphilharmonie und Laeiszhalle Betriebsgesellschaft mbH verfolgt offensiv das Ziel der beruflichen Gleichstellung von Frauen und Männern und der Diversität. Wir sind bestrebt, die Vielfalt unserer Gesellschaft in unserer Organisation abzubilden und arbeiten an einem diskriminierungssensiblen Arbeitsumfeld. Wir glauben an die Stärke divers aufgestellter Teams und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Personen, die uns durch andere Perspektiven und Erfahrungshorizonte ergänzen. Bewerbungen von BIPoC und Menschen mit Migrationshintergrund sind eindeutig erwünscht.

In dem Bereich, für den diese Stelle ausgeschrieben wird, sind Frauen im Sinne des Hamburgischen Gleichstellungsgesetzes unterrepräsentiert. Bewerbungen von Frauen werden daher ausdrücklich begrüßt. Sie werden bei gleicher Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung vorrangig berücksichtigt. Bewerbungen schwerbehinderter beziehungsweise gleichgestellter Menschen im Sinne des SGB IX sind eindeutig erwünscht. Sie werden bei gleicher Eignung besonders berücksichtigt.

Wir haben dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit aussagekräftigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse) ausschließlich über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular. Die Bewerbungsfrist endet am 29.10.2026.

title: Senior Projektsteuerer (m/w/d)
description:
Sie möchten Quartiere mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert entwickeln und der „gerechten Sache“ statt der bloßen Rendite dienen? Dann gestalten Sie als Senior Projektsteuerer die Zukunft des Bauens aktiv mit – inklusive Firmenwagen, großer Gestaltungsfreiheit und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Sie wünschen sich Projekte, bei denen Mensch, Natur und Gebäude im Einklang stehen und Sie nicht nur ausführen, sondern frühzeitig steuern? Sie suchen ein Umfeld ohne starre Konzernstrukturen, in dem Sie eine ganz neue Abteilung maßgeblich mit aufbauen und eigene Ideen einbringen können? Zudem ist Ihnen eine vertrauensvolle Kultur wichtig, die Fehler als Lernchance für Innovationen begreift? Dann erwartet Sie hier ein Arbeitsplatz, der genau diese Werte lebt.

Ihr zukünftiger Arbeitgeber ist eine junge, eigentümergeführte Aktiengesellschaft mit Sitz in Münster, die sich auf die Entwicklung, Planung und den langfristigen Betrieb nachhaltiger Quartiere spezialisiert hat. Ein starkes, interdisziplinäres Team arbeitet hier mit dem klaren Anspruch, soziale, ökologische und wirtschaftliche Qualität zu lebenswerten Räumen zu verbinden. Flache Hierarchien, Innovationsfreude und eine vertrauensvolle Teamkultur prägen den Arbeitsalltag dieses wachsenden Unternehmens.

Bewerben Sie sich jetzt auf diese unbefristete Stelle als

Senior Projektsteuerer (m/w/d) | 85.000-100.000 € + Firmenwagen

  • Bauen mit Sinn & Nachhaltigkeit: Hier steht die „gerechte Sache“ im Fokus. Sie arbeiten an Quartieren, die die Zukunft gestalten, durch regeneratives, ressourcenschonendes und zirkuläres Bauen.

  • Echte Wirksamkeit & Aufbauarbeit: Als Pionier im Unternehmen prägen Sie die Prozesse und bauen Ihren eigenen Bereich aktiv mit auf – ganz ohne festgefahrene Konzernstrukturen.

  • Work-Life-Balance & Flexibilität: Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2-3 Tagen Home-Office, Vertrauensarbeitszeit sowie 30 Urlaubstagen bietet Ihnen maximale zeitliche Flexibilität.

  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Neben einem Firmenwagen zur Privatnutzung erwarten Sie modernstes Equipment (Apple oder Lenovo) und hervorragende persönliche Entwicklungsperspektiven bis hin zur Leitungsfunktion.

  • Sie übernehmen die technische Steuerung anspruchsvoller Quartiersentwicklungen in der Planungs- und Realisierungsphase.

  • Sie entwickeln Realisierungsstrategien in enger und vertrauensvoller Zusammenarbeit mit der Projektentwicklung.

  • Sie verantworten die Gesamtbaukosten und stellen die konsequente Einhaltung von Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätszielen sicher.

  • Sie organisieren, verhandeln und vergeben Bauleistungen an potenzielle Realisierungspartner (GU- und Einzelvergaben).

  • Sie übernehmen das souveräne Stakeholdermanagement mit Nutzern, Planern, Investoren und Behörden während der Ausführungsphase.

  • Sie integrieren regenerative und ressourcenschonende Bauweisen aktiv in den Realisierungsprozess.

  • Sie wenden Vertragsrecht, HOAI, VOB, AHO sowie einschlägige DIN-Normen rechtssicher an.

  • Sie bauen die neue technische Abteilung proaktiv auf und entwickeln Prozesse sowie Werkzeuge für Ihr Team.

Ihr Profil

  • Studienabschluss in Architektur oder Bauingenieurwesen oder Projektmanagement

  • Alternativ eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, beispielsweise als Handwerksmeister:in mit entsprechenden Referenzen

  • Mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung als Projektsteuerer, Projektleiter oder Bauleiter in der Bau- und Immobilienwirtschaft.

  • Einschlägige Projekterfahrung im Hochbau oder Schlüsselfertigbau

  • Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse im Tiefbau

  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der eigenverantwortlichen Abwicklung von Bauprojekten

  • Sichere Anwenderkenntnisse in HOAI, VOB, AHO und gängigem Vertragsrecht

  • Affinität zu regenerativen und ressourcenschonenden Bauweisen

  • Deutsch: C1

  • Intrinsische Motivation für nachhaltiges Bauen und ausgeprägtes Interesse an Brancheninnovationen

  • Gültiger Pkw-Führerschein

  • Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Präsenz vor Ort in Münster (hybrides Modell)

Der Bewerbungsprozess ist schlank gehalten: In der Regel findet nur ein einziges Gespräch direkt mit der Fachabteilung und der Geschäftsführung statt.

title: People Analytics Manager (m/f/d)
Engineering Lead – AI Enablement (m/f/d)
Account Executive, Commercial
Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions |  Germany | Remote
Senior Software Engineer, Security Assurance | Germany | Remote
AI Transformation Architect EMEA
Staff Software Engineer - AI
description:
tl;dr

  • After 14 years in construction tech, Lea & Jonas are building the AI foundation for the construction industry

  • 6 of Europe's 20 largest construction companies already rely on Kuro, with leading construction enterprises representing over €40bn in combined annual construction volume using the platform every day

  • Construction has some of the most complex, unstructured data you can throw at an LLM. At Kuro, you can tackle some of the hardest problems in applied AI every day

  • Curious about the bigger engineering challenge? Explore the vision and open problems at kuro.build.

About us

Lea and Jonas scaled two of Europe's leading construction tech companies - Capmo and alcemy - and saw firsthand the challenges holding the industry back. Now they're tackling the root cause: the 50% of construction work still lost to manual data handling.

Kuro is building the AI foundation for construction. We're reimagining how construction professionals get work done and make decisions by leveraging AI to augment back-office workflows and make core data accessible. We are not pursuing marginal improvements, but a step change for construction.

After one year on the market, leading construction enterprises with a combined annual construction volume of >€40 billion use Kuro every day to automate workflows and make faster, better decisions. Backed by an €10 million seed round, we already process more than 1 million pages every month and expect that volume to grow 10x over the next six months.

We are 15 people based in Berlin. You will join a group of technical ex-founders and builders who are ambitious and kind.

Learn more: Join Kuro - Berlin

What You'll Do

Set the technical direction

  • Own the architecture decisions for the platform, from document ingestion to the chat UI

  • Write and review RFCs. The technical roadmap for the next two to three quarters is yours.

  • Make the build-or-buy decisions: which models we use, and which retrieval and orchestration stack we build on.

  • Turn a vague customer request (“show me where the bid deviates from the BoQ”) into a scoped plan with the risks named.

Raise the bar for the team

  • Mentor engineers: Review their designs and their code.

  • Define the engineering standards. Find what slows the team down, in tooling or in the CI/CD pipeline, and fix it.

  • Interview and hire engineers.

  • You have no direct reports. You change decisions in product and in other teams with a written argument.

Build and own end-to-end (AI) features

  • Design and implement new features to solve a specific user problem, such as document versioning or our agentic Chat.

  • From concept to DB schema, to optimizing LLMs, to UI. Own the full development lifecycle of customer-facing features.

  • Manage evaluations and scoring, and perform error analysis on new and shipped AI features.

Build the platform that abstracts workflow building

  • Contribute to the workflow harness, decision-trace standard, and eval tooling so a new use case ships in ~1 month

  • Build reusable human review & approval surfaces where trust in AI output is earned

Work on the construction ontology & project graph

  • Help model and evolve canonical entities of our customers

  • Contribute to entity resolution across sources: recognizing the same requirement, position, or price across BoQs, contracts, drawings, and bids

  • Build features so answers are evidence-linked and auditable, and decisions flow back into the graph

Contribute to scalable data pipelines & integrations

  • Extend our multi-modal ingestion of unstructured documents - PDFs, scans, drawings, and 3D models - orchestrated and cost-efficient at scale

  • Build read/write integrations with customer systems (document management, ERP/AVA), so workflows complete work end-to-end

Projects you would be involved in

Current & Past projects

  • Project & document versioning guaranteeing data lineage in construction projects

  • German tokenizer for construction-specific search

  • Document pipeline ingesting 10,000s of PDFs per day

  • Native BIM/DWG file support: ingesting and processing 3D models

  • Design the ontology v1 + graph schema: core construction entities, evidence links, and per-customer extension model

  • Build out our workflow harness to run agentic workflows for customers

Current Tech Stack

It is still day 0 for Kuro. Therefore, we are highly pragmatic with our tool choices. We believe in keeping it simple and moving quickly. You significantly help shape our tech stack decisions.

  • Web-App: Typescript

  • Database / Vector DB and File Storage: AWS RDS / Trubopuffer / AWS S3

  • Backend: Fastify API + Prisma ORM

  • Workflow Orchestrator: Prefect (Python)

  • Hosting: AWS Elastic Beanstalk

  • AI: Azure / OpenAI, Gemini, Cohere, AWS

  • Obsv., Eval. & Tracking: Langfuse, Datadog

Your profile

This is the perfect role for an experienced engineer who wants to join an early stage company that builds a high impact applied AI product

  • Bring 6+ years of experience as a Staff (full-stack) software engineer or Technical Lead, in a fast-paced environment

  • Have proven experience delivering production-grade applied AI features to customers

  • Take full ownership of solving customer problems by designing and implementing AI features

  • Thrive in a small, accountable team with a high degree of ownership and a drive to make an impact

  • Communicate fluently in both spoken and written English

  • Enjoy working onsite with the team at our office in Factory Berlin Mitte every day

Bonus Points

  • You’ve started a company before or worked at a very early stage startup

  • You built side projects in the past - we’re excited to hear about these!

  • German-speaking (definitely not a must, we’re fully international)

Why Kuro

You’ll join at a point when customer demand is proven, but our product and platform are still yours to shape. You’ll own customer-facing features end to end while building the foundations beneath them, from ingestion pipelines and workflow infrastructure to our construction ontology and project graph.

As Kuro grows, you can grow with it, whether as a leading individual contributor, technical leader or people manager.

 

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Call – Intro, motivation, logistics & fit (30 min)

  • Impact Interview – Deep dive into your experience, ownership & impact (60 min)

  • On-site Day

    • System Design – Designing under ambiguity & LLM craft (45 min)

    • AI-Native Coding – Hands-on coding with AI (45 min)

    • Final Culture Interview (approx. 60 min)

  • Reference calls

  • Decision

title: Founding Enterprise Account Executive, DACH
description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Be Omnea's first Enterprise Account Executive in DACH, as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies expands globally.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion and hiring Enterprise Account Executives to lead it in each region. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What's missing is the person who takes them into DACH.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Open DACH from Frankfurt or Munich: build pipeline, run complex enterprise cycles and close our first wave of local customers

  • Run multi-stakeholder new business deals across Finance, Procurement, Legal, Security and IT, from first meeting to signature

  • Shape how Omnea goes to market in DACH: messaging, target verticals, partners and events

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and engineering, and see it shipped

  • Lay the foundations for the team that follows you

Who this is for

  • 3 to 7 years in B2B SaaS sales, with a record of closing enterprise new business in DACH

  • Fluent German and English

  • Consistently at or near the top of the leaderboard

  • Comfortable building pipeline from zero, before there's a local team around you

  • At home in long, complex cycles and the stakeholders that come with them

  • Bonus: you've been an early hire, a founding rep or a founder before

Where this goes

We run as a meritocracy, and the trajectory scales with the market you build. As DACH grows, there's a clear path into bigger accounts and leading the team that follows you. We've also signed the Future Founder Promise, so if you want to start your own company one day, we'll back that too.

How you'll work

This role is remote while we build our presence in DACH.

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

description:

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

title: AI Builder — Working Student
description:
EggAI Labs · Working Student · In Person (Tübingen, Germany)

Designing lifecycle evaluation for nondeterministic domain-specific AI systems.

EggAI Labs

We're opening the EggAI Labs in Tübingen. The Labs purpose is to test new AI capabilities, identify what works, how they'd improve delivery, and then build assets to support teams and clients. EggAI's mission cannot be achieved through one-off client projects alone and the Labs is the way to adapt and scale.

As part of the first cohort, you will join a small peer group and work directly with EggAI's CAIO, a Tübingen alumnus. You will also collaborate with our engineering, product, and project leads, who will bring you insights from client problems, help you understand their context and challenge your solutions for them. Your fellow AI Builders will be deliberately chosen to span different passions and strenghts. You will have room to explore and be expected to turn that exploration into something useful. This is not a client-facing role.

The problem: EvalOps

How do we prove an AI system acts as expected under various conditions?

We will explore EvalOps: the methods and tools used to check whether domain-specific AI systems meet their behavioral requirements. Among the key challenges for operating AI systems are nondeterminism, ground-truth curation, evaluation metric-design, latency and costs. EvalOps need to overcome all of them in a disciplined way.

These questions will guide the initial work:

  • Regression suites: How can domain experts turn traces, code, and prompts into useful evals in a way that scales?

  • Coverage estimation: How can we quantify the gaps between an eval suite and the range of expected agent behaviors?

  • Live monitoring: Is it possible to detect anomalous behaviour in production with a similar precision to regression evals?

  • Eval analysis: How much evidence is enough to act (e.g., deploy, debug, roll back a feature, choose a different model)? You will help refine them, test approaches, create assets, and pose new questions.

The role

As an AI Builder, you will take an open EvalOps problem from investigation to a working prototype, ready to be tested. Whatever your focus, you will be expected to take a problem through to a useful result. Here is what that means in practice:

  • Research emerging AI and evaluation capabilities and distinguish substance from hype.

  • Understand the user, workflow, domain, and organisational problem around the work.

  • Evaluate usefulness, quality, safety, and reliability with appropriate evidence.

  • Communicate decisions and learning clearly.

  • Create assets that other people can understand, use, and improve.

  • Code and build end to end.

This shared foundation leaves room for different strengths and interests. Each AI Builder will then develop greater depth in one of three pillars.

Three pillars, different passions

Pillar

Driving question

Possible EvalOps focus

Product

What should we build?

Workflows and interfaces that help domain experts create evals, inspect traces, understand results, and make decisions.

Engineering

How should we build it?

Dependable and scalable evaluation infrastructure, trace processing, monitoring, and governance tooling.

Data Science

How do we know it works?

Coverage measures, sampling strategies, scoring methods, statistical tests, anomaly detection, and reasoning under uncertainty.

We expect every AI Builder to develop a practical foundation across all three pillars and to pursue greater depth in the one that most strongly matches their passion.

What we value

  • Problem obsession. A difficult question captures your curiosity. You keep returning to it, pursue ideas without waiting for instructions, and care deeply about finding an answer that works.

  • Initiative and follow-through. You turn uncertainty into something you can investigate, test, and improve—and stay resourceful when the first approach fails.

  • Evidence of making things work. Show us something you created, the decisions you made, and what you learned along the way.

  • Independent judgment. You test new capabilities yourself, distinguish evidence from enthusiasm, and change your mind when the findings warrant it.

  • Generosity in collaboration. You explain your thinking, seek candid feedback, act on it, and help others make progress. 

What is required

  • You are pursuing a Master’s degree.

  • You can write code and turn an idea into working, tested software.

  • You can work from Tübingen and communicate fluently in English, our company language.

Relevant fields include Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Physics, Bioinformatics, Computational Neuroscience, Medical Informatics, Quantitative Data Science, Cognitive Science. We also welcome candidates from other disciplines who can demonstrate strong problem-solving and practical technical ability.

What you will gain

  • Industry insight. Learn what works and what breaks in real enterprise AI systems, with access to problems from EggAI’s client work

  • Meaningful ownership. Take an EvalOps problem from investigation to a working, evaluated solution, with freedom to shape the approach.

  • Close mentorship. Work directly with EggAI’s Chief AI Officer and sharpen your judgment through feedback from engineering, product, and project leads.

  • Room to develop. Deepen your strengths, learn from peers with complementary perspectives, and use modern AI-development tools on unresolved problems.

  • A say in the Lab’s direction. Help establish its working practices, propose new questions, and influence what it pursues next.

  • Competitive compensation, including recognition for exceptional contributions, and a potential path to a full-time EggAI role after graduation.

How to apply

A short cover letter is required.

Your CV tells us what you have done so far, but we're also interested in the why. Use the letter to explain why you made those choices, what drives you, and why the AI Builder role at EggAI Labs feels like the right next step in your career. 

We are looking for exceptional students, and excellence takes many forms, e.g., academic results, research or ambitious projects. Whatever form yours takes, show us the appropriate evidence, be it grades, publications, something you've built or other evidence of impact.

This is an in-person role in Tübingen. We can only consider candidates who live within commuting distance.

    Du wählst passende Bilder oder erstellt diese selbst. Denk an: Beitragsbilder für Blog- oder Newsbeiträge.

Uns ist egal, welche Zertifikate du hast oder wo du studiert hast. Was uns interessiert: Was kannst du wirklich?     Du hast ein ausgeprägtes Gespür für Ästhetik, Typografie, Abstände und Struktur und gleichzeitig ein Verständnis dafür, wie Nutzer:innen online denken und navigieren.
  • Sicher im Umgang mit Design-Tools
    Du nutzt Figma (oder vergleichbare Tools wie Sketch oder Adobe XD), um Wireframes, Prototypen und finalen UI-Designs umzusetzen. Du arbeitest visuell klar, strukturiert und gerne kollaborativ.
  • Detailverliebt mit Blick fürs Ganze
    Du achtest auf jedes Pixel, auf Abstände und Micro-Details, behältst aber trotzdem die größere User Journey und das strategische Ziel der Seite im Blick.
  • Routine im Responsive Design
    Desktop, Tablet, Mobile – für dich sind das keine Extras, sondern ein selbstverständlicher Teil jedes Projekts. Du kannst Layouts für verschiedene Breakpoints sauber aufeinander abstimmen.
  • Erfahrung im Webdesign
    Du hast bereits mit WordPress, Elementor, Figma oder HTML/CSS gearbeitet und fühlst dich in dieser Welt wohl.
  • Keine formellen Voraussetzungen
    Du musst kein Studium oder 30 Weiterbildungen haben. Wir wollen Talente und fähige neue Kollegen finden. Selbst wenn du nicht alle Punkte hier erfüllst - wir sind auf der Suche nach erfahrenen und verantwortungsbewussten Kollegen, idealerweise bist du schon viele Jahre in dem Bereich aktiv und konntest viele Learnings mitnehmen. Denn genau daran sind wir interessiert: saubere, langfristig robuste Problemlösungen. Und die hat man meist erst, nachdem man es einige Zeit auf die harte Tour lernen musste.
  • Einfache Kommunikation
    Du bist kommunikativ und offen. Eigentlich wollen wir hier keine generischen Sachen schreiben, aber dieser Punkt ist wichtig. Gute Zusammenarbeit schlägt oft reines Know-how. Ein Kollege, mit dem die Zusammenarbeit angenehm und reibungslos ist, kann im Alltag wertvoller sein als jemand mit mehr Know-how, mit dem die Kommunikation aber eher schleppend ist.
  • Deutsch oder Englisch
    Du sprichst Deutsch oder Englisch oder am besten beides (ca. B2-Level). Keine Angst, wir wollen keinen Sprachnachweis sehen.

title: Signal Processing & Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

Limatica measures what batteries whisper. We turn the tiny voltage noise of battery cells into a quality verdict, far faster than conventional tests, and help cell manufacturers cut scrap.

Our measurement stations produce several hundred GB of high-resolution voltage data per hour. You own the step from raw signal to reliable answer.

  • Work with novel cell noise data: Derive features from raw time series that make physical sense that hold up in production
  • Build for streaming: Design feature computations that work in streaming mode, at a throughput of up to 10,000 measurements per hour.
  • Make throughput a design decision: Build modular, parameterizable nodes for our distributed processing pipeline and help bring them into our Rust-based production environment.

  • Data at scale: You think in throughput: data formats, intermediate results, distributed and cached processing.
  • Clean engineering: Python, Git, tests and CI/CD as a matter of course. No Rust expertise needed, but the will to learn it.
  • Customer confidence: Fluent German and English, written and spoken. You explain results clearly to engineers and managers alike.

Why Limatica

  • Real ownership: Your own part of the pipeline and your first customer project within months. As we grow, this role can grow into technical lead.
  • Learn what few get to learn: Electrochemistry, Rust in production and data engineering at scale, with real cells and international manufacturers.

  • Invest in yourself: Additional holiday for personal learning
  • Flexibility & wellbeing: Flexible hours, hybrid work, further benefits via Guud Card and free beverages

What it's like here: You get a lot of trust and a lot of room to shape things. We look for people who stay with a problem until it's solved and who enjoy the moments when a customer launch needs the whole team. Those are the moments where people here grow fastest. This role is intentionally a towards-senior position. You will take on increasing responsibility for pipeline modules and customer projects. Those who help shape the architecture and lead projects independently grow into a senior role with us.

Sales Development Representative (SDR)

If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

 

Role Summary:

AI is changing how organisations research new technologies, evaluate ideas, understand competitors and decide where to invest. At Patsnap, we’re helping to lead that change.

We’re looking for an ambitious Sales Development Representative to join our High Tech division and help drive the next stage of our growth.

As an SDR, you’ll be the first point of contact for prospective customers across a diverse range of industries. You’ll introduce senior R&D, Innovation, Engineering and Intellectual Property professionals to Patsnap’s AI-powered platform, start meaningful commercial conversations and create qualified opportunities for our Account Executives.

This is a proactive, high-activity outbound sales role. You’ll research potential customers, make cold calls, deliver personalised outreach and learn how to capture the attention of busy senior decision-makers. It takes confidence, resilience and consistency, but it also gives you the opportunity to develop valuable commercial skills quickly and see the direct impact of your work.

You don’t need previous sales experience to succeed here. We’re looking for curious, ambitious people who are eager to learn and prepared to put in the work. Through structured onboarding, regular coaching and close partnership with experienced Account Executives, you’ll build the skills and confidence needed to become a successful SaaS sales professional.

For someone who is competitive, motivated by personal growth and achievement who wants to build a career with that offers uncapped earning potential and a clear development path towards becoming an Account Executive and beyond, this could be the perfect opportunity.

With significant investment in AI, ambitious growth plans and a clear progression path, there's never been a better time to join Patsnap.

This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with the flexibility to work either hybrid (Monday, Tuesday and Thursday in the office) or fully office-based if you prefer.

 

Why This Opportunity?

Starting your sales career is about more than getting your first title. It is about finding the right environment to learn, build confidence and prove what you can achieve. At Patsnap, you’ll sell a sophisticated AI platform with a clear purpose and strong credibility in the market. You’ll receive structured training, practical coaching and daily exposure to experienced sales professionals who want to help you improve.

You’ll learn how to research accounts, communicate with senior stakeholders, handle rejection, uncover business challenges and create genuine commercial opportunities. As your capability grows, so will your responsibility, earning potential and opportunity to progress. You’ll also join a high-performing but low-ego team that shares ideas, supports one another and celebrates success properly.

Who are we?

Patsnap is a global, Series E, unicorn SaaS platform that transforms the way organizations harness their Intellectual Property and Research & Development productivity. Our user-friendly platform revolutionizes how IP and R&D teams collaborate across the entire innovation lifecycle — using industry-leading, domain-specific AI to generate and validate ideas and bring innovative products to market faster, better, and cheaper. More than 12,000 R&D and IP teams worldwide use and trust PatSnap to innovate and commercialize new products.

 

We have a vibrant and diverse team with offices in London, Toronto, Shanghai, and Singapore. Our hyper-growth trajectory is powered by our people, and we are extremely proud of our company-wide vision, work ethic, and entrepreneurial spirit. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where talent thrives and ideas bloom.

What You'll Be Doing:

As an SDR, you'll be on the front line of Patsnap's growth, helping us connect with leading innovative organisations. This is a true business development role where you'll learn how to identify opportunities, build relationships and create commercial value. Sales isn't about having all the answers, it's about asking great questions. Your curiosity will help you understand customer challenges, while we'll teach you the commercial skills to build a successful career in SaaS sales.

You will:

  • Develop a hunter mindset, proactively identifying and engaging new prospects through phone, email and LinkedIn.

  • Use your scientific background to build credibility with senior R&D, innovation and scientific leaders.

  • Create and qualify new sales opportunities, turning cold prospects into valuable commercial conversations.

  • Build resilience by handling rejection positively and consistently achieving ambitious activity and pipeline targets.

  • Work closely with experienced Account Executives, helping convert qualified opportunities into revenue while learning every stage of the sales process.

  • Develop the commercial skills needed to progress into a closing role, including influencing, negotiation and relationship building.

  • Using your incredible communication skills to build brand new relationships between Patsnap and potential clients 

  • Working closely with an Account Executive, who will mentor and help to develop your sales skills, while you support their activity by creating sales leads and booking their product demonstrations 

  • Owning your territory and choosing which companies to call and will have the autonomy to be creative with how you introduce Patsnap to prospects 

  • Learning the necessary tools to be able to succeed in the role; what we ask of you is a can-do attitude and an open mind to learning 

  • Researching using varied and creative techniques to identify business opportunities (sales leads)


What We'd Love From You

You don't need previous sales experience – we're looking for people with the attitude, curiosity and ambition to build a successful career in tech sales. You could be starting your professional career, moving into sales from another sector or bringing some initial B2B sales or lead-generation experience.

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A recent graduate (or early career professional) or has B2B sales or lead generation experience, ideally within the software industry (desirable) 

  • Ambitious and motivated by success, with the drive to excel in an uncapped commission environment.

  • Confident and proactive, comfortable starting conversations and building relationships with new people.

  • Resilient and determined, with the mindset to overcome challenges and thrive in a target-driven environment.

  • Naturally competitive, with a strong desire to achieve goals and progress quickly in your career.

  • An excellent communicator, able to explain complex scientific concepts in a simple, engaging way.

  • Curious, coachable and eager to learn, always looking for ways to improve.

  • Organised and self-motivated, with the ability to manage your time and priorities effectively.

  • Passionate about technology, AI and innovation, and excited by the impact they have on R&D and scientific discovery.

  • A natural problem solver who enjoys understanding customers' challenges and helping them find solutions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, collaborative environment where no two days are the same.

Benefits & Perks:

A genuinely strong sales culture we’re really proud of. High-performing but low ego, social, and dynamic. It’s a team that supports each other, shares best practice, raises standards, and celebrates wins properly together. Alongside a great product, it’s one of the best parts of working here.

title: CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager
description:
Better Collective is looking for an experienced CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager to establish and lead a group-wide approach to customer relationship management across our portfolio of global sports media brands.

This is a senior role combining CRM strategy, customer lifecycle management, technology, data, commercial thinking and operational leadership.

The successful candidate will move CRM beyond campaign execution and develop it as a strategic capability that helps Better Collective build deeper, more valuable relationships with its audiences.

Working across Product, Audience, Data, Commercial, Editorial, Technology and local brand teams, the CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will create the frameworks, programmes and operating model required to turn first- and zero-party audience data into personalised customer experiences and measurable business value.

The Opportunity

Better Collective reaches millions of sports fans across a diverse portfolio of digital brands.

The next stage of our audience strategy is to develop stronger direct relationships with those users — moving from anonymous audiences → known users → understood customers → engaged and valuable relationships.

CRM will be central to that transformation.

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will establish the strategy, capabilities and standards that allow Better Collective brands to acquire, activate, engage, retain and monetise audiences across the customer lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

CRM Strategy & Leadership

  • Develop Better Collective's group-wide CRM and lifecycle strategy.

  • Establish CRM principles, standards and best practices across brands.

  • Create a scalable operating model balancing central CRM expertise with local brand execution.

  • Identify where CRM can deliver the greatest audience and commercial impact.

  • Build CRM roadmaps for priority Better Collective brands.

  • Act as the senior CRM subject-matter expert across the organisation.

Customer Lifecycle Management

Design lifecycle strategies covering:

Acquisition → Registration → Onboarding → Engagement → Conversion → Retention → Reactivation

Develop automated programmes including:

  • Welcome and onboarding journeys

  • Profile completion

  • Content discovery

  • Personalised sports and player updates

  • Newsletter engagement

  • Subscription conversion

  • Premium product promotion

  • Renewal

  • Retention

  • Churn prevention

  • Lapsed-user reactivation

  • Win-back programmes

The objective is to create relevant, personalised experiences rather than simply increase communication volume.

First & Zero-Party Data Activation

Work closely with Audience, Product and Data teams to translate Better Collective's growing first- and zero-party data capabilities into meaningful customer experiences.

Use behavioural, declared and transactional data to improve:

  • Audience segmentation

  • Personalisation

  • Content recommendations

  • Lifecycle triggers

  • Subscription propensity

  • Retention

  • Cross-sell opportunities

  • Audience insight

Help establish the connection between data capture, customer understanding and CRM activation.

Multi-Channel CRM

Develop a coordinated CRM approach across:

  • Email

  • Newsletters

  • App push

  • Web push

  • In-app messaging

  • On-site messaging

  • Emerging direct audience channels

Establish channel roles, contact strategies, frequency management and customer communication principles.

Ensure customers receive coordinated experiences rather than disconnected messages from individual channels.

CRM Technology & Automation

Partner with Product and Technology teams to maximise Better Collective's CRM technology stack.

Responsibilities include:

  • Marketing automation

  • Journey orchestration

  • Audience segmentation

  • Triggered communications

  • Dynamic content

  • Personalisation

  • CRM/CDP integration

  • Data flows

  • Preference management

  • Testing frameworks

  • Reporting requirements

Help translate business and customer requirements into practical technology capabilities.

Measurement & Optimisation

Create a consistent CRM measurement framework across Better Collective.

Core metrics should include:

  • Known-user growth

  • Registration conversion

  • Newsletter acquisition

  • Email engagement

  • Push engagement

  • Active-user frequency

  • Subscription conversion

  • Renewal

  • Retention

  • Reactivation

  • Revenue per known user

  • Customer lifetime value

Move CRM measurement beyond opens and clicks toward customer behaviour and commercial outcomes.

Experimentation

Establish a structured CRM experimentation programme covering:

  • A/B testing

  • Send frequency

  • Timing

  • Content

  • Segmentation

  • Personalisation

  • Offers

  • Lifecycle triggers

  • Channel combinations

Create mechanisms for successful experiments to be documented and scaled across Better Collective brands.

Stakeholder Leadership

CRM at Better Collective sits across multiple disciplines.

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will therefore work closely with:

Audience — audience strategy, segmentation and zero/first-party data

Product — registration, logged-in experiences and product journeys

Data & BI — customer data, segmentation and measurement

Technology — CRM platforms, integrations and automation

Editorial — content propositions and newsletters

Commercial — monetisation and customer value

Subscription Teams — acquisition, renewal and retention

Compliance — consent, GDPR, PECR and data governance

Strong stakeholder leadership will be critical to the success of the role.


We are looking for an experienced CRM leader who combines strategic thinking with the ability to turn strategy into operational programmes.

The successful candidate will ideally have:

  • Significant experience leading CRM, lifecycle or customer engagement programmes.

  • Strong knowledge of email marketing and marketing automation.

  • Experience developing sophisticated customer lifecycle strategies.

  • Strong understanding of customer segmentation and personalisation.

  • Experience working with large customer databases.

  • Experience using behavioural and transactional data to improve communications.

  • Strong understanding of CRM technology and platform capabilities.

  • Experience working across Product, Data, Technology, Marketing and Commercial teams.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills.

  • Experience managing CRM teams, agencies or specialist partners.

  • Strong analytical and commercial mindset.

  • Demonstrable experience connecting CRM activity to measurable business outcomes.

Experience within digital media, subscriptions, publishing, sports, gaming or high-frequency digital consumer products would be particularly valuable.

Leadership Profile

The role requires someone who can operate at both strategic and practical levels.

You should be comfortable moving between:

Strategy ↔ Execution

Customer ↔ Commercial

Data ↔ Communications

Technology ↔ Marketing

Central Strategy ↔ Local Brand Requirements

You will need to influence senior stakeholders while also being comfortable working directly with teams responsible for delivering CRM programmes.

  • Establish baseline CRM KPIs.

  • Map existing lifecycle communications.

  • Identify immediate optimisation opportunities.

  • Define the group CRM strategy and operating principles.

Better Collective has a scalable CRM capability connecting:

Audience Data → Customer Insight → Segmentation → Personalisation → Activation → Measurement → Commercial Value

CRM becomes a measurable growth engine supporting:

Audience Engagement | Registration | Subscription | Retention | Revenue | Customer Lifetime Value

The CRM & Lifecycle Senior Manager will be central to making that transition happen.

title: People & Workplace Experience Manager
description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The role

Dust is growing fast, and we want every person who joins us to feel welcome, supported, connected and able to do their best work. As our People Experience Manager, you'll shape how people experience Dust, from their first day and the moments that bring us together to the way our offices in Paris, London, New York and San Francisco support the team.

We're looking for someone who is operationally excellent and creatively ambitious. You'll handle the details carefully, and you'll also look for ways to make the employee experience much better. One day you might be redesigning part of onboarding, the next planning a company offsite, acting on survey feedback, or working with a site lead to improve one of our offices.

This role works as a partner across the company. You'll work most closely with People Operations, who lead on the core people processes. Together, you'll make sure the employee experience is well run behind the scenes and thoughtful in how people actually experience it. In Paris, you'll also work closely with our Office Manager, who runs our HQ on site and leads much of our day-to-day office life and events. In London, New York and San Francisco, you'll coordinate with local site leads. You'll also work with IT, Finance, Legal, Marketing, leadership and outside partners. Your guiding principle: consistency where it matters, local adaptation where it creates a better experience.

What you will do:

Own the employee journey

  • Own the onboarding experience end to end, working closely with our People Ops Specialist, from pre-boarding and equipment to first-day logistics and the first few weeks, so new joiners can contribute from day one in every location.

  • Work with People Ops, IT, Finance, hiring managers, our Paris Office Manager and site leads so every handoff in the employee journey is smooth.

  • Partner with People Ops and IT on offboarding, so people leave with the same care they got when they joined.

  • Be a trusted point of contact for everyday employee questions and needs, and know when to bring in People Ops.

Build culture and community

  • Run and improve our team rituals, including weekly lunches, team drinks, dinners and company gatherings.

  • Organise one or two company offsites or retreats each year.

  • Create moments that help people connect, celebrate progress and feel they belong, across offices and time zones.

  • Pay attention to the details that make experiences feel personal and inclusive, such as dietary needs, accessibility, preferences and team milestones.

  • Partner with People and Marketing on selected external and brand-building events.

Listen and turn feedback into action

  • Build feedback loops (surveys, conversations, informal check-ins) to understand how people experience Dust.

  • Turn what people tell us into concrete recommendations and visible improvements.

  • Define and track simple, useful measures of employee and workplace experience.

  • Communicate clearly and consistently about updates, events, practical information and team norms. Be assertive when needed.

Shape our workplaces

  • Make sure our offices are safe, welcoming, functional and ergonomic, and that they reflect how we want people to feel at Dust.

  • Work with our office manager on day-to-day operations: supplies, maintenance, access, equipment and services.

  • Manage workplace vendors, contracts and budget, and look for efficient ways to improve the experience.

  • Spot operational needs early and fix issues before they disrupt anyone.

Scale the experience as Dust grows

  • Help shape how our physical, hybrid and digital environments evolve as the company grows.

  • Set up simple, scalable processes and clear ownership across People, IT, Finance and Legal topics.

  • Keep the employee experience personal and high quality without making it bureaucratic.


What success looks like

After your first 100 days, you will have:

  • Built a smooth, consistent onboarding experience for every new joiner, in every location.

  • Delivered team rituals, events and offsites that strengthen connection and culture.

  • Set up feedback loops and a practical set of metrics that guide People Experience decisions.

  • Created well-run, welcoming offices where operational issues are handled quickly and proactively.

  • Established clear processes and ownership across People, workplace, IT, Finance and Legal.

  • Helped Dust grow its employee experience without it becoming bureaucratic or impersonal.

What we are looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in People Operations, People Experience, Workplace Experience in a fast growing, globally distributed environment

  • A proactive generalist who can handle many kinds of work at once without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • Real ideas, sound judgement and the confidence to improve how things work today.

  • Strong operational ownership, project management skills and attention to detail.

  • Warmth, empathy and a genuine interest in helping people feel comfortable and connected.

  • Clear, direct, thoughtful communication, and discretion with sensitive situations.

  • Confidence working with vendors, budgets and outside partners.

  • The ability to build simple processes that scale, and to keep a high bar for quality while staying pragmatic.

  • Comfort with a fast-moving environment where priorities can change, working on your own while collaborating across the company.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

  • Dust: Gabriel Hubert on Enterprise AI, Gabriel Hubert, Nasdaq, published May 7, 2026. On Dust’s approach to enterprise AI and building the company in Europe.

Il garantit la bonne exécution des projets dans le respect des engagements contractuels, des budgets, des délais, des exigences de qualité, de sécurité, de performance énergétique et de disponibilité des infrastructures.

title: Associate Team Lead - Customer Support (T2)
description:
Résumé

Nous recherchons un(e) Associate Team Lead Support N2 / Chef(fe) d’équipe Support N2 pour rejoindre l’équipe Support Niveau 2 de Pennylane, au service des dirigeants d’entreprise et des cabinets comptables.

Pennylane est une plateforme de gestion financière et comptable qui accompagne les dirigeants d’entreprise et les cabinets d’expertise comptable dans leur quotidien. L’équipe Support Niveau 2 intervient sur les demandes les plus complexes ou nécessitant une expertise métier et produit approfondie, en lien avec les équipes Support Niveau 1, Support Technique, Produit et Tech.

Ce rôle est un poste de management de proximité : tu seras le relais opérationnel du Team Lead Support N2 et accompagneras une équipe de 6 à 12 agents au quotidien pour leur permettre de répondre aux utilisateurs avec efficacité, qualité et empathie. Tu contribueras également au pilotage de l’activité, à l’amélioration continue du support et à des projets transverses.

Notre culture

Au sein du Support, nous valorisons la transparence, la bonne ambiance, l’entraide et la résilience.

Nous restons proches de la réalité de nos utilisateurs, notamment des dirigeants d’entreprise et des professionnels de la comptabilité, afin de traiter chaque demande avec expertise métier, maîtrise du produit et empathie. Cette approche s’inscrit dans la culture Pennylane de Supporting SMEs et de proximité avec les utilisateurs.

Nous encourageons le feedback dans les deux sens, le développement de chacun et la prise d’initiative. Nous accordons de l’importance à l’autonomie, à la responsabilité et à la confiance, dans l’esprit de Community of Builders et de Radical Trust.

Concrètement, ton quotidien ressemblera à ça

  • Animer les points d’équipe et suivre la charge quotidienne.

  • Accompagner les agents sur leurs tickets, leurs priorités et leurs situations complexes.

  • Réaliser des écoutes ou analyses de conversations pour donner du feedback constructif.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de performance et de qualité de l’équipe, comme le temps de première réponse, le temps de résolution, la satisfaction client et le volume de tickets traités.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage opérationnel : suivi de la charge, priorisation des demandes, identification des alertes et coordination avec les autres équipes Support.

  • Remonter les irritants utilisateurs aux équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

  • Contribuer à améliorer les process, la documentation et les outils internes.

Responsabilités

  • Manager une équipe de 6 à 12 agents sous la supervision du Team Lead Support N2, en les accompagnant dans leur activité quotidienne, leur progression et leur épanouissement professionnel.

  • Donner des feedbacks clairs, réguliers et transparents, réaliser des écoutes et analyses de conversations, suivre les bilans et plans d’accompagnement individuels, proposer des coachings et identifier les besoins de formation.

  • Suivre les indicateurs de l’équipe et contribuer à la qualité du support, notamment le temps de première réponse, la satisfaction client, le temps de résolution, le volume traité, la prise en charge des nouveaux tickets et le suivi des tickets en cours.

  • Participer aux rituels de pilotage et à la gestion des files de demandes communes, notamment lors des rotations de permanence, en identifiant les alertes et en remontant les besoins de renfort ou d’arbitrage.

  • Être force de proposition pour optimiser les process, les outils, la documentation et les modes de fonctionnement du Support.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes support de niveau 1, l’équipe technique, les équipes opérationnelles ainsi que les équipes produit et tech, faire remonter les irritants utilisateurs et contribuer aux projets transverses.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques avec les autres Associate Team Leads et contribuer à maintenir une communication fluide au sein du Support.

  • Prendre ponctuellement en charge des demandes internes urgentes ou des situations complexes nécessitant l’expertise du Support Niveau 2, en sachant orienter ou escalader lorsque cela est nécessaire.

Ce poste est fait pour toi si

  • Tu aimes accompagner une équipe et faire progresser les autres.

  • Tu sais garder du recul dans des situations opérationnelles parfois urgentes.

  • Tu es à l’aise avec les indicateurs, tout en gardant toujours en tête la qualité de l’expérience utilisateur.

  • Tu sais communiquer avec clarté, même quand les sujets sont complexes.

  • Tu as envie de contribuer à structurer une équipe Support dans un environnement en forte évolution.

Qualifications

  • Diplôme Bac+2 ou Bac+3 minimum en comptabilité, management ou dans un domaine équivalent.

  • Expérience d’au moins 1 an en management ou en accompagnement d’équipe, idéalement dans le secteur du support.

  • Bonne capacité à analyser une situation, prendre une décision mesurée et proposer des solutions concrètes.

  • Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration, avec assertivité et diplomatie.

  • Goût pour le feedback, la pédagogie et l’accompagnement individuel.

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques, notamment les outils de ticketing et de documentation comme Intercom, Zendesk ou Notion.

  • Capacité à s’adapter à un environnement en évolution rapide.

  • Sens du service et attention portée à l’expérience utilisateur.

Les nice to have

Ces éléments sont un plus, mais ne sont pas indispensables si tu as une forte appétence pour le support, le management de proximité et l’apprentissage produit/métier.

  • Connaissances en comptabilité.

  • Expérience préalable en tant que contributeur individuel au sein d’une équipe Support.

  • Expérience dans un environnement SaaS ou start-up.

  • Expérience dans le management d’une équipe principalement à distance.

  • Expérience de collaboration avec des équipes Produit, Tech ou Ops.

  • Anglais niveau B1 minimum.

  • Utilisation de l’IA pour optimiser ses tâches.

Modalités pratiques

  • Tu reporteras au Team Lead Support N2.

  • Le rôle combine management de proximité, pilotage opérationnel et contribution ponctuelle sur des situations complexes ou urgentes.

  • L’équipe collabore principalement en français, avec des interactions possibles en anglais selon les sujets et les équipes.

3 premiers mois :

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte.   • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau

  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

As the Senior Documentation Specialist, you ensure the effective management, quality, completeness, and inspection readiness of essential clinical trial documentation for assigned studies, programmes or documentation activities, including the sponsor TMF and oversight of CRO and laboratory TMFs. Your tasks:

  • Demonstrated experience in TMF quality control, risk-based TMF reviews and CRO or vendor oversight.

  • Demonstrated experience leading TMF inspection-readiness activities and managing documentation-related findings and corrective and preventive actions.

  • Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to provide clear guidance, influence without direct authority and build effective working relationships across functions.

  • You will coordinate with our firmware & GNSS team to ensure the SoC Architecture supports efficient execution of software, including drivers, operating systems and applications.

  • You will define and implement security features to protect the SoC from vulnerabilities.

  • You will keep up with the advances in the semiconductor industry and make sure the SoC architecture remains scalable and adaptable for future generations of products.

Requirements

  • Solid understanding of chip packaging.

  • Knowledge of low-power design techniques, including clock gating, power gating, and multi-voltage domains (UPF/CPF).

Als Senior Electrical Engineer binnen onze Datacenter-afdeling ben je verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerp, de engineering en de technische coördinatie van complexe elektrotechnische installaties. Vanaf de eerste conceptfase denk je mee over technische strategieën en ontwerpkeuzes die aansluiten op schaalbaarheid, energie‑efficiëntie, beschikbaarheidsnormen (Tier III/IV) en steeds strengere duurzaamheidsdoelstellingen. Je werkt intensief samen met disciplines zoals werktuigbouwkunde, bouwkunde en security en bewaakt de technische samenhang van het integrale ontwerp. Dankzij jouw senioriteit fungeer je als inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor klanten, ontwerpteams en leveranciers. Je stuurt waar nodig bij, begeleidt junior en medior engineers en draagt actief bij aan kennisontwikkeling binnen het datacenterteam.

We hebben meegewerkt aan de bouw van diverse nieuwe datacenters in o.a. Milaan, Amsterdam. We hebben ondersteuning geboden bij het ontwerp van de mechanische, elektrische en sanitaire installaties voor de bouw. Deerns heeft ook ondersteuning geboden bij de bouw om een Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED)-certificering te behalen. Het team 

Je maakt onderdeel uit van een team met circa 16 collega’s, binnen de bredere organisatie waarin je meer dan 750 collega's in verschillende sectoren zal hebben. Het Data Center team is een hecht team dat bestaat uit projectmanagers, adviseurs, mechanical- en electrical engineers. De projecten waar je trots op kunt zijn

  • We werken aan het verduurzamen van Terminal 1 & 2 van Schiphol, zo’n 40% van de gehele terminal: De huidige installaties die zorgen voor een aangenaam binnenklimaat, maken gebruik van fossiele brandstoffen. Wij werken aan het ontwerp van de nieuwe installatie, die warmte en koude opslag combineert met warmtepompen zodat Schiphol energieneutraal de toekomst tegemoet kan. GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a usable answer. This is done with agents: specialised AI components that each take on part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can’t just sound convincing. It has to be correct, and you need to be able to see which source it comes from. This isn’t a pilot: the platform is in production and used heavily every day.

As a senior, you build alongside the team, but you also keep the bigger picture in view. You know the different parts of the platform and how they affect one another. You help prioritise, spot obstacles early and make sure we’re heading in the right direction, both in how we work and technically. You look ahead: where could we go, and what do we need to know to get there? And you help medior colleagues grow by seeing exactly where they’re stuck, without taking the work off their hands.

  • You give direction to the agent architecture of GenIA-L: which specialised agents are needed and how they work together.

  • You break down legal processes and translate them into technical solutions. You decide how the components are best connected.

  • You make sure our knowledge packages and the pipelines behind them can scale and stay up to date. A knowledge package is an expert-reviewed set of commentary, case law, legislative history and practical guidance for each article of law.

  • You build the way we measure quality. Using evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability are genuinely improving. Not based on gut feeling, but on evidence.

  • You help prioritise the team’s work and flag technical or process risks early.

  • You explore new developments, test ideas in practice and turn them into proposals that make the product sharper or faster.

  • You coach medior engineers and work directly with editors and subject-matter experts.

You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You follow new AI developments closely, but you don’t just follow the herd: you stay critical and aren’t afraid to say so. You can break a complex problem down into smaller pieces and keep oversight of a system with many moving parts.   • You’ve made the quality of LLM systems measurable with evaluation sets and observability, and can give concrete examples. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus.

  • Strong backend experience, including REST APIs and Postgres databases.

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience in the legal, tax or another knowledge-intensive domain is a plus.

description:
