title: Product Frontend Engineer
description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.

One platform means one frontend. One experience means it looks and behaves like quinn whether you are in Zurich or in London, a household or a company. In this strategy that is not a nice-to-have. It is the strategy.

Which is why the surface matters more than anything else. Everything quinn does is designed to disappear. The interface is the only part the customer ever sees, and it is the whole proof that the complexity behind it is really handled.

Why this role exists

Today, quinn runs on several separate web apps: one per product and market, each with its own frontend, grown over the years as the company grew. Our backend engineers built them alongside everything else, plus an internal admin tool that grew the same way. They all work: thousands of employers run payroll through them every month. But nobody was ever tasked with owning the frontend development, so each one got built the way frontend is built by Backend Developers, seen as a hassle rather than the main aspect users interactive with.

What comes next is one frontend that replaces all of them, built from scratch: one quinn app for employers, employees and our own support team, in the browser first, then in the App Store and Google Play from the same work. Alongside it, the frontend of Maestro, the internal tool that replaces the old admin for batch processes. The phone app is the surface that matters most, so everything is built for it from the first screen rather than adapted to it afterwards.

That is the opening.

How we work

We are AI-native, and we mean it operationally rather than as a slogan. AI is how the work gets done here. It is why a small team ships like a large one, and it is a large part of how one person will be able to hold the standard we are describing.

We expect you to be at the front of that. Not to have heard of the tools, to live in them, and to build your own leverage with them: scaffolding, visual regression checks, design-token pipelines, whatever takes manual work out of the way.

And we expect the judgement that has to come with it. AI writes code that looks right and is subtly wrong: structure that doesn't scale, patterns that fall apart three screens later, components that work once and never again. You take the speed and throw away the rest. AI never lowers the bar here. It is the reason the bar can be this high.

Tasks

What you will own

Everything on the screen:

  • The frontend of the quinn app and the web app. App first. One app for everyone who uses quinn: the employer, the employee, and our own support team working inside the customer's account.
  • The frontend of Maestro, our internal batch tool. Desktop and dense: queues, runs, tables, filters, multi-select, keyboard shortcuts. A different discipline from the app, built on the same components.
  • The component library across quinn Home and quinn Business: one frontend, one experience, every market and every device.
  • Whether the app feels native: response, scrolling, gestures, transitions, biometric login, push. Nothing that gives away it isn't native.
  • The quality of what you ship. Nothing leaves your hands half-finished.

Where design ends, engineering begins.

We have a design team, and they own how quinn looks and behaves: the flows, the visual design, the tokens, the component specs. You don't design. You own everything from there: how it is built, and everything a design file cannot reasonably specify, such as gestures, keyboard, safe areas, what happens between the drawn breakpoints, the loading, offline, pending and failed states, what a three-line German label does to a layout that was designed for English. You are in the room before design starts, saying what already exists in the library and what a new pattern costs. Not at the end, receiving a handover. When you and design disagree, they decide how it looks and behaves and you decide how it is built. Nothing enters the component library without both of you.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You care about interfaces more than anyone else in the room. You see the two-pixel misalignment without being told, and it bothers you until it is fixed.

You build and maintain UI components and design systems, not one-off screens. You can build a mobile app that feels like one. And you can also build a desktop tool full of tables, filters and keyboard shortcuts, because Maestro is one. You understand UX and how people actually behave, not only how a screen looks. And you write code other people can take over: scalable, structured, documented. Not something that only works while you are in the building.

You are independent and decisive. Nobody will spec every detail for you and nobody will review your pixels.

You are fluent in English, no other language is required. And if you have a portfolio, a live product, or anything you have shipped that you are proud of, show it to us. Not a requirement, but it tells us more than a CV does.

Most importantly: you want this one. Not a frontend role at a company where the frontend is a chore. This one, the app nobody has built yet, the standard nobody has set yet, and a company where getting it right actually decides whether the strategy works.

The Team

We are a small, fast, direct team. We do not have a lot of process or a lot of hierarchy. We do have a clear strategy, an ambitious plan, and five values we actually mean: Be open, Own it, Speak up, Keep it simple, Bias for action.

This is one of the most important hires we will make this year. We are not rushing it and we are not filling a seat. We are looking for the person who reads this and thinks: finally.

title: Cloud Operations Lead
description:
Welcome to Xelon – where technology meets innovation and customer centricity. As we continue to grow our Platform team, we are looking for a

Cloud Operations Lead (80-100%)

to join our team. In this role, you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incidents, recovery, and the service desk that customers reach first. When something has to keep running at Xelon, you make it run.

At Xelon, we deliver secure, scalable, and automated Swiss cloud infrastructure for the next generation of digital services. From IaaS to SaaS, our platform powers workloads in regulated industries like technology, finance, insurance, and public services. Our solutions - Xelon Cloud, Xelon Secure+ and Xelon HQ combine reliability, automation, sovereignty, and simplicity in one ecosystem.

We are on a mission to become the #1 Swiss Cloud Enabler, and we are growing a team of people who want to shape the future of cloud infrastructure and software operations.

Tasks

Your Mission

As Cloud Operations Lead you own the daily operation of our cloud platform: availability, incident response, monitoring, backup and recovery, and the infrastructure underneath. The service desk is part of your team, so you also own what customers experience every time they contact us. You lead a team of four to six people, and you are the person the business relies on when something has to keep running.

Xelon is building a new platform over the coming years. VMware carries the production estate through that transition and stays in place for at least the next two years, alongside other hypervisors. You run that environment, you keep it stable and auditable, and you make sure the transition never happens at the expense of the customers on it.

Platform strategy, target architecture and the technology roadmap sit with the Head of Platform & Technology. You are a close partner in those decisions and you own their operational reality.

What You Own in the First 12 Months

  • Availability and customer satisfaction. You hit the agreed availability targets and hold them, and customers experience both the platform and the service desk as dependable, with incidents resolved quickly and communicated clearly.
  • ISO 27001 and audit readiness. Operational evidence, documentation and patch compliance stay audit-ready throughout the year instead of being assembled in the weeks before each audit.
  • Team depth. No critical part of the platform depends on one person, and every engineer in the team has a development path they can name.

Responsibilities

  • Operations and multi-hypervisor environment: Operate and optimise the production estate across a multi-hypervisor environment, with VMware as the primary platform. Keep availability, performance and capacity ahead of demand as the customer base grows. Own hardware lifecycle, capacity planning and datacenter operations together with our partners.
  • Networking, storage and datacenter: Own the operational side of network and storage: segmentation, routing, firewalling, DNS, load balancing, and the storage layer underneath the platform. Raise the level of networking knowledge and practice across the team.
  • Monitoring, incident response and recovery: Run and improve monitoring, alerting and logging so that problems surface before customers report them. Own backup and disaster recovery, including proving that restores actually work.
  • Service desk and customer support: Lead the service desk: intake, triage, ticket quality and response times against agreed service levels. Own what customers experience when they contact us, from the first response through to clear communication during an incident. Act as escalation point for 1st and 2nd level support incidents. Turn recurring tickets into fixes together with the engineering side of the team, rather than absorbing them as routine.
  • Team leadership: Lead, coach and develop a team of four to six people across cloud operations and the service desk. Build development plans and remove single points of knowledge. Set on-call, shift and service desk coverage the team can sustain.
  • Automation and process: Move recurring manual operations into Infrastructure as Code and scripting. Improve the operational toolchain and the handover points with DevOps, Support and Product. Apply service management practice where it reduces friction, not as an end in itself.
  • Compliance and audit readiness: Keep operations aligned with ISO 27001, ISAE and Swiss data sovereignty requirements. Work with Dev- and SecOps on hardening, patch compliance and audit evidence. Maintain operational documentation that holds up in an audit.
  • Budget, vendors and procurement: Co-own the operational CAPEX and OPEX budget with the Head of Platform & Technology. Manage vendor relationships, licenses and procurement for the operations estate.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for an operations leader, not an architect. Technical depth matters, and so does the ability to run a team through a platform transition without dropping the service underneath it.

  • You keep the service running while the ground moves. A platform transition does not become the customer's problem.
  • You lead through presence and clarity, not authority. Your team knows what good looks like.
  • You are calm in an incident and precise afterwards. The postmortem produces a fix, not a narrative.
  • You treat the service desk as part of the product, not as a queue to be absorbed.
  • You tell your manager what is broken and what you need to fix it.

Must Haves

  • Leadership: 5+ years leading IT operations, in a cloud, hosting or service provider environment.
  • VMware: hands-on experience in production. You have operated it yourself, not only overseen it.
  • Infrastructure: practical working knowledge of networking, storage and datacenter operations.
  • German and English: you communicate confidently in both, spoken and written.
  • Work authorisation: Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit.

Nice to Haves

  • Networking at provider scale — a strong plus: segmentation, routing, firewalling, load balancing and DNS.
  • Experience with other hypervisors alongside VMware, and with hypervisor migrations.
  • Hands-on Infrastructure as Code, e.g. Terraform or Ansible.
  • Monitoring and logging at scale, e.g. Prometheus, Grafana or a similar stack.
  • Operating experience in a regulated environment: ISO 27001, ISAE or SOC 2.
  • Running operations through a platform migration or a consolidation.

Benefits

What Xelon Offers

  • A leadership role with real ownership in a Swiss cloud provider, not a coordination layer.
  • A platform in transition, which means your operational decisions change something visible.
  • Office in Zug with a hybrid working model, 80 to 100 percent.
  • Direct collaboration with the Head of Platform & Technology and cross-functional teams.
  • A team small enough that you know what everyone is working on.
  • Competitive salary, modern tooling and a product-driven environment with clarity and ownership.

Join Our Mission

Do you feel like you are the person that would complete our team? Are you ready for a new challenge? Then apply now. We look forward to hearing from you.

The Xelon Team

title: iOS Software Engineer
description:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

 

Role

As an iOS Software Engineer, you own the iOS client experience, how AI feels, responds, and performs in users’ hands. This is not a thin integration role. You will build a production-grade iOS application where AI interactions are central to product experience, and performance, reliability, and user trust are critical.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain iOS applications using Swift and SwiftUI.

  • Integrate AI-powered features through backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including loading states, streaming responses, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency.

  • Capture user signals and feedback to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API design and system behavior.

  • Maintain high App Store quality, stability, and production reliability.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of iOS development experience using Swift.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI-powered features into mobile apps.

  • Strong understanding of async/await, concurrency, and background tasks.

  • Solid iOS performance and memory optimization skills.

  • Experience shipping and maintaining production iOS apps.

  • Comfort designing for latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic AI behavior.

  • Exposure to CoreML or light on-device ML.

  • Familiarity with feature flags or remote configuration systems.

  • Strong intuition for AI UX patterns and user trust considerations.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use iOS applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

 

Tech Stack

  • Swift

  • SPM

  • SwiftUI

  • SQL / noSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

How We Work

The best products today in the world were built by small, world class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively, move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high quality work and learning. Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently. Our goal is to put in hands of our users a truly magical product

 

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

The Flight Software Architect plays a key role in defining and maintaining the software architecture for our spacecraft flight software. The role ensures that the flight software architecture meets mission needs, system-level requirements, and safety and reliability objectives, while remaining scalable, maintainable, and suitable for the evolving needs of our spacecraft platforms. Working closely with Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and other functional disciplines, the Flight Software Architect drives architectural decisions, technical consistency, and the integration of software across the spacecraft.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as Flight Software Architect, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

What we would love to see from you

  1. Software architecture & design — Define, develop, and maintain the overall flight software architecture, including software components, interfaces, data flows, and execution models, ensuring alignment with spacecraft system architecture and mission objectives.

  2. Technical leadership & architectural decisions — Drive key architectural decisions and establish design principles, technical standards, and best practices for flight software development. Provide technical guidance to software engineers and ensure consistency across software components and development activities.

  3. System integration & interfaces — Define and coordinate software interfaces with avionics, onboard computers, sensors, actuators, GNC, communication systems, and other spacecraft subsystems. Ensure robust integration across functional disciplines and support the resolution of cross-system technical challenges.

  4. Requirements & traceability — Translate mission and system-level requirements into software architectural requirements, design constraints, and interface specifications. Ensure traceability between requirements, architecture, implementation, and verification, working closely with Systems Engineering and functional chain owners.

  5. Reliability, safety & performance — Ensure that architectural decisions address fault tolerance, robustness, timing constraints, resource utilization, failure detection and recovery, and overall spacecraft reliability. Contribute to safety analyses, failure management strategies, and the definition of appropriate software verification and validation approaches.

  6. Verification, validation & technical risk management — Identify and mitigate architectural risks, assess technical trade-offs, and support design reviews, integration campaigns, and verification activities. Ensure that the architecture is validated against mission requirements and that critical technical assumptions are verified early in the development lifecycle.

  7. Cross-functional collaboration & technical communication — Act as a technical reference for flight software architecture, facilitating alignment between Flight Software, Systems Engineering, Avionics, GNC, Mission Operations, and external partners, including ESA where applicable. Communicate architectural decisions, constraints, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and project stakeholders.

PlaytestCloud’s Player Insights Platform™ helps game studios improve their games through feedback from real players. Over 60% of the top-grossing game studios have tested their games with PlaytestCloud.

🏆 Premier provider for games. We help game studios worldwide make the best games they possibly can.

🏆 Independent and established. We are bootstrapped and profitable, with more than 400 paying game studios and over one million playtesters.

Our player community

PlaytestCloud runs one of the largest proprietary player panels in games: a large, growing, global community of players who take part because they care about making the games they play better. 

This isn't a role where you're building a panel from scratch. You'll be advising a mature Research Operations team that's already investing in the long-term health, quality, and strategic development of that community. 

Our goal is simple: help game studios make better decisions through real player insight. You'll play a central role in keeping that community trusted, representative, engaged, and ready for what game developers need next.

About the role

We're hiring an experienced, analytical Panel Manager (f/m/d) to shape the next stage of PlaytestCloud's proprietary player panel. Your job: figure out what makes a panel strong and scalable, then turn that understanding into measurable action. You'll identify the metrics that matter most, find opportunities to improve panel quality and availability, and build a practical framework that helps us serve studios better as we grow. This is a freelance contract (3–6 months) with a clear mission: build a stronger foundation for how we measure, manage, and grow our player panel.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Panel strategy and ownership. Take ownership of the health and growth of PlaytestCloud's global player panel.

  • Metrics and insight. Define and track the metrics that connect panel performance, player experience, studio needs, and business growth.

  • Opportunity identification. Analyze panel data to find the highest-impact opportunities, constraints, and risks.

  • Actionable improvements. Turn insight into practical recommendations, and work with the right teams to implement and measure them.

  • Cross-functional collaboration. Partner closely with Research Operations, Product, and GTM to make sure the panel supports great outcomes for our studios.

  • Sustainable foundations. Set up a reporting rhythm, performance framework, and roadmap the team can keep using after the contract ends.


Your profile

Must-have:

  • Panel experience. Recent hands-on experience managing, running, growing, or optimizing a large participant panel, research-participant community, or gaming community — including participant supply, retention, quality, segmentation, and/or incentive strategy. 

  • Commercial and analytical mindset. You know how to find the few metrics that actually matter, connect them to customer and business outcomes, and use data to make good calls. 

  • Tool competency. Comfortable querying databases in SQL, and familiar with agentic AI tools like Claude or Codex. 

  • Ownership. You're a self-starter who likes taking on an ambiguous challenge, building structure around it, and driving it forward on your own. 

  • Practical problem-solving. You turn analysis into clear priorities and action, not insight for its own sake. 

  • Strong communication. You can explain complex findings clearly to technical and non-technical people alike. 

  • Strong English. Comfortable communicating in written and spoken English on a remote, international team.

Great to have:

  • Qualitative research experience. Experience supporting or working closely with qualitative user research, including participant recruitment, study operations, interviews, usability testing, or research synthesis.

  • Games and player research. Interest in games, player research, or the gaming industry. Direct games-recruitment experience is not required.

description:
At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?

As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.

This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.

Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.

What You'll Work On

You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:

  • Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events
  • Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them
  • Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading
  • Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise
  • Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible
  • Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales
  • Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models
  • Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper
  • Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems
  • Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge

No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. Great research understands why they exist.

What Success Looks Like

Successful researchers at Graviton discover new sources of alpha and turn them into robust trading strategies, build models that hold up under real market conditions and not only in backtests, develop a deep understanding of market behaviour, create research frameworks and tools that make the broader team more effective, work with technologists to take ideas from research into production, and communicate complex quantitative ideas clearly and rigorously. Your impact isn't measured by how many models you build. It's measured by the quality of the ideas you discover and what those ideas enable.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for exceptional problem solvers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious.

  • Degree in a quantitative discipline such as mathematics, physics, computer science, statistics, operations research or machine learning
  • No active backlogs
  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or C++
  • Solid grounding in probability, statistics, linear algebra and optimization, with experience in machine learning, statistical modelling or data analysis, whether through coursework, research or personal projects
  • Comfort working with large, complex datasets, and strong analytical thinking
  • A passion for applying quantitative thinking and rigorous research to solve open-ended problems in markets
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex ideas clearly

Prior exposure to quantitative research, algorithmic trading, market microstructure, competitive mathematics or machine learning is valuable, but we care more about how you think than whether you've worked in finance before.

Our Culture

More than specific tools or techniques, we care how you think. We look for people who are curious enough to keep asking why, analytical enough to separate signal from noise, persistent enough to pursue difficult problems, intellectually honest enough to abandon an idea when the evidence says so, and humble enough to keep learning.

At Graviton, researchers sit alongside technologists on specialized trading teams that operate with significant autonomy. You'll have meaningful ownership of research problems from day one: forming your own hypotheses, challenging existing approaches and following the evidence wherever it leads, with the infrastructure and datasets to test ideas at scale, competitive compensation, and a culture where the best idea wins regardless of who proposed it.

Markets are among the most complex systems humans have ever created, and they never stop changing. Neither should our thinking. Every day, someone asks a better question and finds an answer nobody had. That someone could be you.

We are looking for a Senior Valve Engineer (Technical Authority) based in Toulouse.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on valve expert who will serve as Pangea’s company-wide technical authority for valves. The mission is to build the internal capability to specify, design, analyse, source, test, qualify, industrialise, and continuously improve critical valves for our propulsion systems.

The first priority will be to assess and internalise selected valves used on Nereus, starting where technically and commercially justified with HTP-compatible valves. · Define the valve internalisation strategy and prioritise candidates using performance, safety, development risk, recurring cost, lead time, supplier dependence, and manufacturing scalability.

· Lead the initial Nereus workstream for HTP-compatible solenoid valves: capture requirements and interfaces; benchmark make-versus-buy options; select concepts; and define the development and qualification plan.

· Own the full product lifecycle—from requirements, architecture, trade-offs, detailed design, analysis, materials and sealing selection through prototyping, testing, qualification, production release, and in-service improvement.

· Develop or approve valve sizing and dynamic models covering flow capacity and pressure drop, actuation force and margin, response time, leakage, thermal effects, friction, hysteresis, fatigue, wear, contamination sensitivity, and lifetime.

· Establish verification logic, acceptance criteria, instrumentation, test matrices, and qualification evidence for nominal, off-nominal, proof, endurance, environmental, and compatibility testing.

· Ensure compatibility with HTP and, as applicable, cryogenic, high-pressure, hot, reactive, or hazardous fluids through disciplined materials, cleanliness, sealing, lubrication, and contamination-control choices.

· Resolve difficult hardware problems through structured failure investigation, test-data interpretation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and design iteration.

· Lead technical engagement with valve, actuator, coil, seal, and manufacturing suppliers; review proposals, drawings, analyses, process controls, inspection plans, qualification evidence, deviations, and non-conformances.

· Create reusable internal standards, design rules, calculation methods, test procedures, lessons learned, and product architectures, while mentoring engineers and raising valve competence across the company.

Initial Mandate

Build a credible make-versus-buy and development plan for Nereus HTP-compatible solenoid valves, close the highest-risk knowledge gaps with analysis and testing, and leave behind a repeatable internal valve-development capability.

What you need to be successful

Education

· Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechatronics, Fluid Mechanics, or a closely related engineering discipline.

· Additional specialization in fluid systems, cryogenics, mechanical design, tribology, sealing technology, materials, or control systems would be advantageous.

Experience

· 8 to 10 years or more of relevant engineering experience, with substantial direct ownership of valve or closely related fluid-control hardware.

· Demonstrated hands-on delivery of hardware from requirements and concept selection through detailed design, test, qualification, and production support.

· Deep experience with solenoid, pilot-operated, pneumatic, electro-mechanical, or comparable valves for demanding applications.

· Experience with high-pressure, reactive, hazardous, cryogenic, or high-temperature fluid systems; liquid rocket propulsion or space hardware experience is strongly preferred.

· Evidence of solving real valve failure modes and working directly with manufacturing, suppliers, inspection teams, test facilities, and non-conformance processes.

Technical expertise

· Strong command of valve architecture, fluid mechanics, actuation, sealing, tribology, tolerancing, material selection, cleanliness, and design for manufacture and assembly.

· Ability to size and analyse valves using appropriate analytical and numerical methods, and to correlate models with component and system test data.

· Proven capability investigating leakage, friction, hysteresis, pressure drop, response time, actuation margin, contamination, wear, fatigue, thermal effects, and lifetime.

· Working knowledge of qualification logic, reliability, FMEA, fracture and fatigue considerations, configuration control, and technical documentation for safety-critical hardware.

· Knowledge of HTP compatibility, decomposition hazards, compatible materials and seals, cleanliness, and safe test practices is highly valuable.

Leadership

· Strong technical ownership: comfortable making and documenting difficult decisions, while actively seeking challenge and evidence.

· System-level thinking, with the ability to connect valve behaviour to engine, propulsion-system, test-bench, and vehicle performance.

· Pragmatic judgement that balances technical excellence with safety, schedule, cost, manufacturability, maintainability, and qualification effort.

· Clear communication across disciplines and with suppliers, including the ability to turn ambiguous problems into structured plans and crisp technical requirements.

· Builder’s mindset: equally willing to work at a whiteboard, review a drawing, analyse data, inspect hardware, and support a test campaign.

Additional assets

Vous aimez ouvrir de nouvelles opportunités, comprendre les enjeux de vos interlocuteurs et construire des solutions qui ont une véritable utilité ?

Chez UrbanThink, nous développons UrbanThink Platform®, un écosystème de solutions numériques permettant aux acteurs publics et privés de mieux exploiter leurs données environnementales, énergétiques et climatiques.

Nos solutions associent données, géolocalisation, jumeaux numériques et outils d’aide à la décision pour accompagner le pilotage des bâtiments, des sites et des organisations.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons un ou une Business Developer B2B capable de conduire une vente consultative, de développer de nouveaux comptes et de construire des relations commerciales durables.

Prise de poste : Décembre 2026 – Janvier 2027

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Rattaché·e directement à la direction, vous intégrez une équipe commerciale et participer au développement commercial de l’entreprise, depuis l’identification d’une opportunité jusqu’à la signature du contrat.

Vous collaborez quotidiennement avec les équipes commerciales, data, géomatiques, énergie et développement afin de construire des propositions adaptées aux enjeux de chaque prospect.

Vos principales missions seront les suivantes :

  • identifier et prospecter de nouveaux comptes sur nos marchés prioritaires ;
  • obtenir et conduire des rendez-vous de découverte ;
  • comprendre les enjeux métiers, techniques, réglementaires et environnementaux des prospects ;
  • qualifier les besoins, les acteurs impliqués, le budget, le calendrier et le processus de décision ;
  • présenter et démontrer la valeur des solutions UrbanThink Platform® ;
  • construire les offres commerciales avec les experts internes ;
  • piloter des cycles de vente parfois longs et impliquant plusieurs décideurs ;
  • assurer les relances et sécuriser chaque prochaine étape du processus commercial ;
  • négocier et conclure les contrats ;
  • renseigner avec rigueur les opportunités et les prévisions commerciales dans le CRM ;
  • contribuer à la veille, à la qualification et aux réponses aux appels d’offres ;
  • représenter UrbanThink lors de salons, conférences et événements professionnels ;
  • participer à l’amélioration continue de notre stratégie et de nos outils commerciaux.

Vos premières priorités

Au cours de vos premiers mois, vous devrez notamment :

  • maîtriser le positionnement et la proposition de valeur d’UrbanThink Platform® ;
  • comprendre les principaux cas d’usage de nos clients ;
  • prendre en main le portefeuille de prospects et les outils commerciaux ;
  • construire un pipeline d’opportunités qualifiées ;
  • conduire progressivement vos rendez-vous commerciaux en autonomie ;
  • formuler des propositions adaptées avec l’appui des équipes techniques ;
  • faire progresser chaque opportunité vers une décision clairement identifiée ;
  • conclure vos premières affaires.

Vos compétences

Le profil que nous recherchons

Vous disposez d’au moins trois années d’expérience en développement commercial B2B, idéalement dans la vente de solutions SaaS, data, numériques ou techniques.

Vous savez à la fois prospecter et piloter des cycles de vente consultatifs impliquant plusieurs niveaux hiérarchiques d’interlocuteurs.

Pour réussir dans ce poste, vous devez notamment savoir :

  • créer des opportunités commerciales et ne pas dépendre uniquement de demandes entrantes ;
  • conduire un entretien de découverte structuré ;
  • écouter, questionner et reformuler un besoin ;
  • identifier les décideurs et comprendre un processus d’achat ;
  • vulgariser des sujets techniques ou complexes ;
  • défendre la valeur d’une solution au-delà de son seul prix ;
  • organiser vos actions et gérer plusieurs opportunités simultanément ;
  • relancer avec méthode, constance et discernement ;
  • prendre des initiatives et proposer des actions concrètes ;
  • travailler de façon autonome tout en sollicitant l’équipe au bon moment ;
  • communiquer avec assurance auprès de directions, d’experts techniques et d’interlocuteurs métiers.

Nous recherchons une personne curieuse, structurée, persévérante et orientée résultats, capable de transformer un échange commercial en plan d’action précis.

Les compétences appréciées

Une connaissance ou une sensibilité particulière aux domaines suivants constituera un avantage :

  • transition environnementale, énergie ou climat ;
  • solutions SaaS ou plateformes data ;
  • géodata, SIG, jumeaux numériques ou datavisualisation ;
  • immobilier, tourisme, industrie, ports, aéroports ou secteur public ;
  • marchés publics et réponses aux appels d’offres.

Ces connaissances ne sont pas toutes indispensables. Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement de nouveaux sujets et à les traduire en bénéfices clients sera déterminante.

Pourquoi rejoindre UrbanThink ?

En nous rejoignant, vous bénéficierez :

  • d’un poste ayant un impact direct sur le développement de l’entreprise ;
  • d’une réelle autonomie dans l’organisation de votre activité ;
  • d’un accès direct à la direction et aux experts qui conçoivent nos solutions ;
  • de projets associant innovation numérique et transition environnementale ;
  • des produits numériques à vendre porteurs de sens vis-à-vis des questions énergétiques et environnementales ;
  • d’une vente fondée sur la compréhension du besoin et la création de valeur ;
  • d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, accessible et engagée ;
  • d’un environnement dans lequel les propositions et les prises d’initiatives sont encouragées ;
  • d’un accompagnement à la prise en main de nos solutions et de nos marchés.

Notre processus de recrutement

1. Premier échange en visio

Un entretien de 20 à 30 minutes nous permettra de découvrir votre parcours, vos motivations et vos attentes, et de vous présenter plus précisément le poste.

2. Évaluation commerciale OMG en ligne

Vous serez invité·e à réaliser l’évaluation Objective Management Group. Elle nous permet d’approfondir certains éléments relatifs à la vente consultative et à la conduite de cycles commerciaux complexes.

Cette évaluation constitue un outil complémentaire : elle n’est jamais analysée indépendamment de votre parcours, de vos entretiens et de la mise en situation.

  1. Entretien avec la direction en présentiel

Nous échangerons plus précisément sur vos expériences, votre manière de prospecter, votre organisation et votre capacité à faire progresser une opportunité commerciale.

  1. Mise en situation en ligne ou en présentiel

Une situation commerciale courte vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer votre capacité à découvrir un besoin, structurer votre réflexion, prendre des initiatives et proposer une prochaine étape.

5. Décision et proposition

Nous vous communiquerons rapidement notre décision et, en cas d’accord mutuel, les modalités de votre arrivée et de votre parcours d’intégration.

Vous vous reconnaissez ?

Vous souhaitez vendre une solution utile, travailler sur des projets à forts enjeux et participer directement au développement d’une entreprise innovante ?

Adressez-nous votre CV ainsi que quelques lignes expliquant ce qui vous attire dans ce poste et la manière dont vous abordez le développement d’un nouveau compte.

title: CDI - Facility Manager (F/H)
description:
Gemmyo est une Maison de joaillerie indépendante qui développe une nouvelle vision du luxe, ancrée dans son époque. Les créations sont conçues et fabriquées en France à la commande et proposées dans une vaste sélection de pierres et de métaux précieux. La marque se distingue par une expérience client personnalisée, un modèle largement digital, une distribution 100% intégrée, et des prix toujours respectueux.

50% des ventes sont réalisées sur le site internet Gemmyo et 50% à travers les 9 boutiques de la marque, situées à Paris (2 boutiques), Lyon, Aix-en-Provence, Bordeaux, Toulouse, Genève, Bruxelles et Tokyo. La Maison est également présente via une Résidence (boutique éphémère) à Zurich depuis juillet 2024.

La Maison d’environ 100 collaborateurs est aujourd’hui référente pour une clientèle française exigeante.

Contexte de recrutement

L’entreprise est autofinancée et rentable depuis 2019. Après les années Covid de très forte croissance, la marque souhaite continuer à accélérer son développement en France et prendre un fort tournant international.

Aujourd’hui, Gemmyo dispose de solides actifs :

  • Une notoriété importante sur ses marchés français, japonais, suisse et belge, et un accueil enthousiaste par ses clients
  • Une compétence rare dans le domaine du luxe digital
  • Une trésorerie très confortable

La Maison cherche à s’entourer d’un Facility Manager (H/F) pour accompagner sa croissance, garantir le bon fonctionnement de ses infrastructures et faire vivre au quotidien un environnement de travail à la hauteur de ses exigences.

Vos missions

La Maison recherche un Facility Manager (H/F) en charge de la maintenance, de la sécurité et du bon fonctionnement de l'ensemble des installations et infrastructures de la Maison. Garant de la qualité et de la sécurité des espaces, il veille au confort des collaborateurs et à la préservation des actifs immobiliers et mobiliers de Gemmyo.

Il est rattaché au Secrétariat Général et reporte directement au Responsable des Services Généraux.

Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec :

  • Les équipes boutique, dont il est le contact privilégié pour les besoins du quotidien.
  • L'Office Manager, pour l'ensemble des sujets liés au siège.
  • Les prestataires et fournisseurs externes (entreprises de maintenance, artisans, sociétés de sécurité, assureurs, etc.).

Missions :

Maintenance des équipements :

  • Assurer le suivi et la maintenance préventive et curative des équipements techniques (CVC, sécurité incendie…).
  • Piloter les vérifications électriques réglementaires et veiller à la mise en conformité des installations.
  • Coordonner les prestataires techniques et suivre la bonne exécution de leurs interventions.

Entretien et valorisation des actifs :

  • Veiller au bon état et à l'entretien des mobiliers et façades des boutiques et du siège.
  • Anticiper les besoins de remplacement ou de remise en état pour préserver l'image de la Maison.

Gestion de projets travaux

  • Piloter les projets de réparation et de rénovation, du cadrage du besoin jusqu'à la réception des travaux.
  • Sélectionner et coordonner les prestataires, suivre les budgets et les plannings.

Support sécurité

  • Assurer la gestion et le suivi des dispositifs de sécurité (coffres, alarmes, télésurveillance et clés).
  • Garantir le respect des procédures de sécurité et former les équipes aux bonnes pratiques.

Support aux collaborateurs boutique

  • Être le contact principal des boutiques pour l'ensemble des besoins liés aux locaux et aux équipements.
  • Assurer un traitement rapide et efficace des demandes du quotidien.

Vos compétences

  • Minimum 2 ans d'expérience sur des fonctions similaires (Facility management, services généraux, office management, maintenance ou gestion technique de sites).
  • Bon sens et sens pratique, capable de prioriser et de trouver des solutions rapides face aux imprévus du quotidien.
  • Grande rigueur et sens de l'organisation, à l'aise dans le suivi de plusieurs sujets et prestataires en parallèle.
  • Sens du détail, notamment sur la qualité de finition des installations, du mobilier et des espaces.
  • Bon négociateur, capable d'acheter au meilleur rapport qualité-prix et de challenger les devis des prestataires.
  • Aisance relationnelle et fermeté pour coordonner des prestataires exigeants ou parfois difficiles, tout en maintenant une relation de confiance.
  • Réactivité et disponibilité pour intervenir rapidement en cas d'urgence technique ou de sécurité.
  • Appétence pour l'univers de la joaillerie et sensibilité aux exigences d'une Maison de luxe en matière d'image et de qualité sont un plus.

Avantages

  • Un poste responsabilisant, au cœur d'une Maison en forte croissance, avec l'ouverture prochaine de nouvelles boutiques qui élargira le périmètre et les enjeux du poste.
  • Une réelle autonomie et la possibilité de construire et structurer la fonction Facility de A à Z, plutôt que d'hériter d'organisations figées.
  • L'opportunité de rejoindre une Maison de joaillerie française en pleine expansion, alliant exigence artisanale et culture d'entreprise forte.

CDI à partir du 01/10/2026

title: Responsable Partenariats (H/F)
description:
Réunir est un Groupe Associatif incontournable du transport routier de voyageurs, auquel adhèrent plus de 200 PME à travers la France.

Notre mission : accompagner nos adhérents, mutualiser les compétences et renforcer leur compétitivité, tout en préservant leur indépendance.

Quatre structures complémentaires forment l’écosystème de Réunir : Réunir Association, Syneo, Saybus et Réunir Assurances.

Notre feuille de route Performance 2027 fixe un cap clair : gagner en lisibilité, en cohérence et en efficacité collective. La relation partenaires y occupe une place déterminante, parce que la qualité des accords que nous négocions se lit directement dans les résultats de nos adhérents.

Le poste est rattaché à la Direction Performance et Transformation de Réunir Association, maison mère du Groupe.

Vos missions

Vous pilotez le portefeuille de partenaires de Réunir et animez le réseau d’ateliers et d’acheteur

Plus de 30 partenaires actifs : constructeurs, fournisseurs et prestataires de services.

Ce poste se joue autant chez nos adhérents, à écouter leurs besoins, qu'en face de nos partenaires, à défendre leurs intérêts.

VOS MISSIONS

Cinq responsabilités, un même fil conducteur

01 Piloter la relation partenaires

Interlocuteur de référence de nos partenaires, vous suivez la performance des accords, la qualité du service rendu aux adhérents et le respect des engagements pris de part et d'autre. Vous traitez les points de friction avant qu'ils ne deviennent des sujets.

02 Sécuriser et faire évoluer le cadre contractuel

Vous participez à la campagne annuelle de négociation et au renouvellement des accords : préparation des dossiers, argumentaires, arbitrages, conclusion. Vous rédigez et suivez les contrats en lien avec la Direction, nos conseils juridiques et veillez à l'application effective des conditions obtenues tout au long de l'année.

03 Aller au contact des adhérents

C'est le socle du poste. Vous vous rendez régulièrement chez nos adhérents partout en France pour comprendre leurs réalités d'exploitation et recueillir leurs attentes en matière de partenariats. Vous identifiez les postes de coûts sur lesquels la mutualisation peut réellement peser, et vous portez cette voix dans la négociation.

04 Animer et outiller le réseau

Vous donnez de la visibilité aux partenariats : réunions régionales, journées techniques, essais véhicules, congrès et salons professionnels. Vous administrez la plateforme dédiée — pilotage et actualisation des offres, lisibilité du contenu, suivi de l'usage — avec l'appui de notre support informatique. Vous contribuez au développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités et parallèlement vous travaillez avec notre développeur interne pour améliorer l’expérience utilisateur. Vous veillez, enfin à l’adoption de la plateforme auprès des adhérents.

05 Développer l'offre

Vous identifiez les besoins non couverts, sourcez de nouveaux partenaires et construisez les offres correspondantes. Vous êtes force de proposition sur l'élargissement du périmètre partenarial du Groupe.

Vos compétences

VOTRE PROFIL

Le terrain vous parle, les partenaires vous écoutent

Votre parcours

Au moins cinq années d'expérience en partenariats, achats, développement commercial ou animation de réseau, dans un environnement B2B où vous avez porté des négociations à enjeux.

Votre connaissance du secteur

La connaissance des PME du transport routier de voyageurs et des partenaires (fournisseurs et constructeurs) est fortement souhaitée : contraintes d'exploitation, cycles d'investissement véhicules, structure de coûts.

Toutefois, si vous venez d'un environnement proche — groupement d'achats, réseau d'adhérents ou de franchisés, distribution de véhicules industriels, BTP, agricole, logistique — et que vous êtes prêt ou prête à vous approprier rapidement ce métier, votre candidature nous intéresse.

Vos qualités

  • Sens du collectif et de l'intérêt général
  • Aisance relationnelle à tous les niveaux, du dirigeant de PME au directeur commercial d'un constructeur
  • Rigueur contractuelle et sens de la négociation
  • Autonomie et capacité à structurer son propre périmètre
  • Goût du terrain et capacité d'écoute
  • Aisance avec les outils numériques

Indispensables — permis B et réelle disponibilité pour les déplacements qu'implique la fonction.

Avantages

  • CDI, poste basé à Paris ou à Lyon
  • Rémuneration attractive, selon profil
  • Prime de 13ᵉ mois
  • Télétravail régulier
  • « Réunir Avantages » : offres exclusives et réductions
  • Déplacements à prévoir sur l'ensemble du territoire

POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE

Une autonomie réelle

Vous pilotez un périmètre complet, de la relation partenaire à la construction de l'offre

Une structure à taille humaine

Des circuits courts, un accès direct à la Direction,

Un impact mesurable

Chaque accord amélioré se traduit concrètement dans l'exploitation de plus de 200 entreprises adhérentes dont vous connaîtrez personnellement les dirigeants.

LE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT

Court, cadré, et sans zone d'ombre

  • Étape 1 — un premier échange téléphonique, pour valider les attentes réciproques.
  • Étape 2 — deux entretiens, dont un avec la Direction Performance et Transformation.

title: Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director
description:
Aritec New Materials Group AG is a Swiss-based company specialized in fiber composite solutions for demanding industrial applications.

We are experts in synthetic fibers, treatments & fiber sizing formulations and polymer matrices. We take pride in engineering and optimizing superior solutions to the most complex industrial challenges.

At Aritec, we drive tomorrow’s industrial frontiers by innovating cost-effective and robust solutions.

Tasks

We are seeking an accomplished Transmission Belt Reinforcement Business Development Director to lead commercial growth for advanced reinforcement solutions used in industrial transmission belts (timing, power transmission, etc..). This is a senior, customer-facing role for a commercially driven technical professional who understands belt construction, reinforcement architecture, manufacturing processes, end-user performance requirements, and the evolving challenges facing belt manufacturers and end-users worldwide.

The successful candidate will bring a strong track record and industry network from a leading belt manufacturer or closely related high-performance belting business. They will use their industry credibility, technical depth, and commercial judgment to build strategic customer relationships, identify new growth opportunities, and position our reinforcement portfolio as a performance-enabling solution for next-generation belt designs.

As Business Development Director, you will work at the intersection of materials engineering, belt design, manufacturing, and commercial strategy. You will engage with global belt manufacturers, technical centers, R&D teams, purchasing organizations, and senior business leaders to advance qualification projects and convert them into durable commercial programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and execute the global sales strategy for Aritec reinforcement portfolio in Transmission belts.
  • Build and manage senior-level relationships with major transmission-belt manufacturers, including engineering, R&D, purchasing, operations, quality, and executive leadership.
  • Manage and Expand existing customers account portfolio by identifying and prioritizing opportunities where Aritec Synthetic reinforcement technology can improve belt strength, fatigue performance, dimensional stability, heat resistance, flex life, adhesion, noise behavior, efficiency, or durability.
  • Translate customer performance requirements into clear technical and commercial value propositions.
  • Lead customer-development programs from initial technical discussion through sampling, testing, qualification, industrialization, and serial-production launch.
  • Coordinate closely with internal R&D, application engineering, operations, quality, product management, and supply-chain teams to ensure customer requirements are understood and delivered.
  • Provide informed market intelligence on belt technologies, competitive reinforcement materials, regional market dynamics, pricing trends, supply-chain risks, and emerging end-use requirements.
  • Support the development of account plans, commercial agreements, pricing strategies, forecasts, and long-term supply arrangements.
  • Represent the company at customer technical reviews, industry events, trade fairs, and relevant technical associations.
  • Establish disciplined sales reporting, opportunity qualification, forecasting, and business-review processes.
  • Mentor and develop regional sales or application-engineering colleagues as the business grows.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline.
  • At least 10 years of relevant commercial, technical-sales, business-development, product-management, application-engineering, or R&D experience in transmission belts, reinforced elastomer products, industrial belting, tire cord, technical textiles, fibers, or closely related applications.
  • Experience gained at a recognized transmission-belt manufacturer is strongly preferred. Candidates from leading global manufacturers of automotive and industrial transmission belts will be particularly well suited.
  • Demonstrated understanding of transmission-belt construction, including reinforcement cords or fabrics, rubber compounds, bonding systems, cover materials, belt geometry, and manufacturing processes.
  • Practical familiarity with belt types such as timing belts, synchronous belts, V-belts, multi-rib belts, variable-speed belts, flat belts, and industrial power-transmission belts.
  • Strong understanding of key reinforcement performance factors, including tensile properties, modulus, elongation, creep, fatigue, flex resistance, adhesion, thermal stability, moisture behavior, dimensional stability, and processability.
  • Established relationships within the global transmission-belt industry are highly desirable.
  • Proven ability to manage technically complex sales cycles involving testing, qualification, supply approval, and multi-site customer coordination.
  • Experience negotiating pricing, supply agreements, development agreements, technical specifications, and long-term customer programs.
  • Strong commercial acumen, including margin management, value-based selling, forecasting, market analysis, and strategic account planning.
  • Professional fluency in English; additional languages are an advantage.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Preferred Technical Background

The ideal candidate will have direct familiarity with one or more of the following:

  • Aramid, polyester, glass, carbon, hybrid, or other high-performance reinforcement materials.
  • Cord construction, twisting, cabling, dipping, coating, or adhesion-promotion systems.
  • Rubber-to-cord and polymer-to-cord adhesion technologies.
  • Belt fatigue testing, tensile testing, dynamic testing, flex testing, endurance testing, and field-performance validation.
  • Belt-manufacturing processes, including calendering, building, molding, curing, grinding, machining, and quality-control systems.
  • Customer qualification practices and industrial quality-assurance processes.

Personal Attributes

  • Credible technical expert who can communicate effectively with both R&D engineers and senior commercial leaders.
  • Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable building business in technically demanding markets.
  • Structured and disciplined in account management, forecasting, and opportunity prioritization.
  • Skilled listener who can uncover the underlying technical and commercial drivers behind customer needs.
  • Collaborative leader who works effectively across sales, operations, R&D, quality, and supply chain.
  • Resilient and patient in managing long qualification cycles while maintaining urgency and commercial focus.
  • High integrity, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and ethical business conduct.

Benefits

This role offers the opportunity to shape the commercial direction of a high-value reinforcement business serving a critical industrial market. You will have the autonomy to influence strategy, engage directly with leading belt manufacturers, and help develop materials that enable more efficient, durable, lightweight, and sustainable power-transmission systems.

If you combine deep transmission-belt expertise with strategic sales leadership and a passion for solving difficult customer challenges, we invite you to apply.

Einleitung

Als OT Applications Engineer bist du in unserem spannenden Projekt für die Konzeption, Spezifikation, Integration und Realisierung der OT-Applikationen der elektrischen Systeme verantwortlich. Dazu gehören insbesondere SCADA-, EMS-, Plant-Control- sowie weitere OT-Systeme zur Überwachung, Optimierung und Steuerung des Industrienetzes, der Batteriespeicher und der Energieversorgung des KI-Rechenzentrums. Du erarbeitest Lösungskonzepte, definierst funktionale und technische Anforderungen, koordinierst Lieferanten und Dienstleister und stellst die qualitätsgerechte Umsetzung sicher. Dabei verantwortest du die Gesamtarchitektur und Integration der OT-Systeme sowie deren Zusammenspiel mit den relevanten Umsystemen. Zudem verantwortest du die erfolgreiche Inbetriebnahme der Systeme sowie die Übergabe der erforderlichen Betriebsgrundlagen an den Betrieb.

Unser Versprechen:
Ein Arbeitsplatz, der Technologie und Innovation vereint. Werde Teil der FlexBase und unterstütze uns in Laufenburg, dem zukünftigen Zuhause des weltweit grössten Redox-Flow-Batteriespeichers und eines hochmodernen KI-Rechenzentrums. Gemeinsam treiben wir Innovationen für eine saubere, verlässliche Energiezukunft voran!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Verantwortung für die OT-Applikationen der elektrischen Systeme, insbesondere SCADA-, EMS-, Plant-Control- sowie weiterer Betriebs-, Engineering- und Konfigurationssysteme
  • Ansprechpartner gegenüber internen Stakeholdern, externen Planern, Lieferanten und Dienstleistern für sämtliche fachlichen, technischen und organisatorischen Belange der OT-Applikationen
  • Spezifikation, technische Bewertung und Qualitätssicherung der OT-Applikationen in der Rolle als Bauherrenvertreter
  • Definition der funktionalen Anforderungen, Systemarchitekturen, Datenmodelle und Schnittstellen zwischen OT-Applikationen, elektrischen Anlagen sowie internen und externen Systemen
  • Verantwortung für die Gesamtintegration der OT-Applikationen unter Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen aus Betrieb, Energieoptimierung, Netzbetrieb und Cybersicherheit
  • Mitwirkung beim Aufbau der Betriebs- und Instandhaltungsorganisation sowie Sicherstellung der geordneten Übergabe der OT-Applikationen an den Betrieb

Dein Profil

  • Studium der Elektrotechnik (BSc/MSc) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit OT-Applikationen (SCADA, EMS, Plant Controller) im Umfeld von Energieversorgungsanlagen, Umspannwerken, Kraftwerken oder Batteriespeichern
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in OT-Cybersicherheit, IT-/OT-Architekturen sowie relevanten Normen und Standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27019, IEC 62443)
  • Erfahrung in der Umsetzung technischer Sicherheitsmassnahmen wie Netzwerksegmentierung, Fernzugriffskonzepte, Zugriffskontrolle und Systemhärtung
  • Vertraut mit regulatorischen und normativen Anforderungen an kritische Infrastrukturen
  • Hohe Eigeninitiative sowie Freude am Aufbau neuer Organisationen, Prozesse und Systeme
  • Fliessende Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)

Benefits

  • Viel Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Spannendes Umfeld im Technologie- und Energiesektor (Batteriespeicher & KI-Rechenzentrum).
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit in einem kleinen, motivierten Team.
  • Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen, moderne Tools und Unterstützung bei Weiterbildungen.
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen.

title: AI Engineer
description:
sizeless is building the data layer for the infrastructure under our streets. A construction crew films an open trench with a phone, and our system turns that recording into a 3D model, recognises what is in the ground, and produces the documentation the industry needs - CAD, BIM, GIS and quantities - in a fraction of the time it takes today.

It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades. We are a small technical team, founded out of ETH Zürich and MIT, and we are looking for engineers who want to work on frontier AI in a domain where it has barely arrived.

Tasks

  • Build and improve the agents that turn captured reality into finished documentation
  • Work on the perception and semantic layer that recognises components and structures in 3D
  • Build the evaluation and verification that tells us when the system is right - and when it is not
  • Scale the pipelines behind it: video, point clouds, large documents, and a lot of compute

Requirements

  • Solid engineering fundamentals and strong Python
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, agents and the tooling around them
  • Real leverage from AI-assisted development, whatever your setup
  • Ownership: you take problems personally and see them through
  • Full working proficiency in English; German is a plus, not a requirement

title: Senior Information Security Officer (ISO)
description:
Wil jij zorgorganisaties helpen om informatiebeveiliging structureel en praktisch op orde te brengen? Werk je graag op het snijvlak van IT, processen en dagelijkse praktijk, en vind je het belangrijk dat informatiebeveiliging niet alleen een norm is, maar daadwerkelijk wordt toegepast? Dan is deze rol als Information Security Officer (ISO) iets voor jou.

 

Als ISO ben je verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel bewaken en verbeteren van informatiebeveiliging bij klanten van Beter Healthcare. Je vertaalt risico’s en beveiligingsmaatregelen naar concrete acties en zorgt ervoor dat deze effectief worden toegepast. Je werkt nauw samen met IT, privacy, management en de business om informatiebeveiliging integraal in de dagelijkse praktijk te verankeren.

 

Je beweegt je comfortabel tussen analyse en uitvoering: van risico-inventarisaties en beleid tot het ondersteunen bij audits en het vergroten van bewustwording binnen de organisatie. Je bent een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiliging en weet overzicht te houden in een dynamische omgeving.

 

Wat jij gaat doen

  • Uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en vertalen van risico’s naar passende beheersmaatregelen;

  • Ondersteunen bij audits en certificeringstrajecten (bijvoorbeeld ISO 27001 en/of NEN-normen);

  • Monitoren van de naleving van informatiebeveiligingsmaatregelen en hierover rapporteren aan de CISO;

  • Vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie, onder andere door voorlichting en kennisdeling;

  • Adviseren en ondersteunen van teams bij praktische informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken.

 

Elke opdracht is anders, dat vraagt om flexibiliteit en nieuwsgierigheid. Je werkt op verschillende locaties bij de klant door heel Nederland, soms vanuit huis, en soms op een van onze kantoorlocaties. Je krijgt de ruimte om je werk op een manier in te richten die past bij jou én de organisatie.


Wie jij bent

Je bent een informatiebeveiligingsprofessional met enkele jaren ervaring, die zijn of haar vak goed verstaat en dit graag verder wil verdiepen. Je werkt gestructureerd en zorgvuldig en hebt een duidelijke focus op kwaliteit. Je vindt het belangrijk dat beleid, procedures en maatregelen niet alleen correct zijn vastgelegd, maar ook praktisch toepasbaar zijn en aansluiten bij de organisatie.

 

Je hebt goed inzicht in processen en informatiestromen en begrijpt hoe risico’s ontstaan binnen een organisatie. Je analyseert deze risico’s zorgvuldig en weet ze, samen met collega’s en stakeholders, te vertalen naar passende en realistische maatregelen. Daarbij weet je hoofd- en bijzaken goed te scheiden en behoud je overzicht, ook wanneer meerdere onderwerpen tegelijkertijd spelen.

 

Je staat open voor vernieuwing en denkt actief mee over verbeteringen. Met jouw innoverend vermogen zoek je naar manieren om informatiebeveiliging slimmer, effectiever en toekomstbestendig in te richten, passend bij de context en volwassenheid van de organisatie.

Daarnaast haal je energie uit het delen van kennis. Je begrijpt dat informatiebeveiliging pas echt werkt wanneer collega’s weten wat er van hen wordt verwacht en waarom dat belangrijk is. Je weet complexe materie helder en begrijpelijk over te brengen en draagt actief bij aan het vergroten van security awareness binnen de organisatie.

 

In de samenwerking ben je toegankelijk en professioneel. Je communiceert duidelijk, onderbouwt je adviezen en weet wanneer je zelfstandig kunt handelen en wanneer afstemming of opschaling nodig is.

 

Ervaring & expertise

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in een rol op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging, bijvoorbeeld als Information Security Officer, security officer, adviseur of vergelijkbaar;

  • Ervaring binnen de zorg sector of binnen soortgelijke sectoren zoals (semi-)overheid en/of financial services

  • Ervaring met het opstellen, implementeren en onderhouden van informatiebeveiligingsbeleid en -procedures;

  • Basis tot goede kennis van relevante normen en kaders, zoals ISO 27001 en/of NEN 7510, 7512, 7513;

  • Ervaring met het uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en het ondersteunen bij audits en certificeringstrajecten;

  • Relevante opleidingen of certificeringen op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging zijn een pré.

 

Wat je van ons mag verwachten

Bij Beter Healthcare kom je terecht in een werkomgeving die draait om groei, vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een goed salaris dat we bepalen op basis van jouw kennis en ervaring;

  • Sterke secundaire voorwaarden, zoals een leaseauto, bonusregeling, pensioen, en vanzelfsprekend een laptop en telefoon;

  • Afwisselende opdrachten bij verschillende zorgorganisaties in Nederland;

  • Kennisgroepen, intervisies en ontwikkelmogelijkheden om continu te blijven leren;

  • Interactieve kwartaalbijeenkomsten met collega’s op inspirerende locaties waar betrokkenheid centraal staat;

  • Een deskundig team van healthcare consultants dat altijd klaarstaat om met je mee te denken;

  • Ruimte om te sparren met andere recent gestarte collega’s binnen het onboardingsteam;

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging voor wie het leuk vindt om samen dingen te ondernemen.

 

Over Beter Healthcare

Beter Healthcare is een consultancybureau welke actief is op het snijvlak van zorg en ICT. Wij ondersteunen bij de digitalisering van processen en dragen zo bij aan het toekomstbestendig maken van zorgorganisaties.

Sinds 2012 ondersteunen we diverse organisaties met adviesvraagstukken, projectmanagement en beheer. Zo begeleiden wij zorginstellingen bij het ontwikkelen van een visie op toekomstbestendige zorg, werken de daarbij behorende (digitale) strategie uit en vertalen deze naar een concrete roadmap en projectenkalender. Onze kracht is dat wij zowel adviseren als samen met onze klanten oplossingen succesvol implementeren en beheren. Op deze manier ondersteunen we organisaties op zowel strategisch, tactisch als operationeel niveau.

Met ons enthousiaste team werken wij met passie bij onze klanten en ondersteunen bij een groot aantal programma’s en projecten. Onze gedreven consultants kennen de zorg van binnenuit. Hun kennis en ervaring zetten ze in om met klanten én elkaar in verbinding te blijven. Bij ons krijgt iedereen daarom voldoende ruimte om zich zowel persoonlijk- als professioneel continu te ontwikkelen. Hierdoor blijven wij de werelden van zorg en ICT met elkaar verbinden.

Beter Healthcare is onderdeel van IG&H. IG&H is een toonaangevend adviesbureau dat verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor de resultaten van haar werk. Met een focus op digitale transformaties gebruiken zij hun eigen bewezen 'Make Strategy Work' methodologie voor succesvolle uitvoering.

title: Senior Industrialisation Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

We are a fast-growing, dynamic company where every engineer plays a direct, hands-on role in bringing our innovative, safety-critical products to life. If you thrive on ensuring product quality and solving complex, real-world problems, we want you on our team.

We are seeking a highly skilled, execution-driven and hands-on Senior Industrialisation Engineer to bridge the gap between R&D and mass manufacturing for our battery packs and charger product lines.

In this role, your primary focus will be the electro-mechanical process steps and optimizations required to transform a functional prototype into a robust, high-yield, and highly scalable series product. You will take ownership of the product lifecycle immediately following the initial prototype build phase. Collaborating closely with our external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), you will co-architect the manufacturing lines, advise on critical assembly fixtures, and pave the way for a production ramp-up from pre-series batches into stable mass production.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Review designs directly following R&D prototype runs to actively catch and eliminate mechanical tolerance stack-ups and assembly risks before tooling begins.

  • Optimise the design, sourcing, and validation of mechanical assembly jigs, cell-alignment fixtures, glueing fixtures, laser-welding beds to optimize line repeatability and operator safety.

  • Collaborate regularly with Contract Manufacturers to optimise and release assembly line setups, resolve technical build bottlenecks, and transition pilot runs into high-yield mass production.

  • Conduct hands-on Design of Experiments in the lab and factory floor to establish locked-in process windows for automated gluing, thermal interface material (TIM) dispensing, and torque specs.

  • Co-Own build failures together with the contract manufacturer to rapidly drive engineering adjustments and optimize first-pass yields. Page: 1/3

  • Oversee the EoL failures, analyse them and implement solutions to improve yield.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience as an Industrialization, Manufacturing, or NPI (New Product Introduction) Engineer, specifically driving the scale-up (upto 10-30k units) of battery modules/packs, power electronics enclosures, or high-reliability electromechanical systems.

  • Technical Skills: Highly skilled in (mechanical) production processes, experience with failure analysis and production methods in a semi-automised production environment.

  • Hands-on Workshop Mentality: A deeply practical engineer who thrives on the shop floor or in the prototype lab. You have no hesitation when it comes to standing at the line, personally assembling a battery module to understand a build bottleneck, or physically tearing down hardware to isolate a defect.

  • Design Review & CAD Interpretation: Strong ability to navigate, interpret, and evaluate 3D CAD models and engineering drawings.

  • Communication: Strong ability to translate technical failure data intoactionable engineering changes.

  • Project Management & CM Governance: Strong capability to coordinate complex technical tasks across internal engineering design teams and external contract manufacturers, with the technical confidence to regularly audit and challenge the work of the CM's internal industrialization teams

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.
