Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making as our Data Scientist (m/f/d)

At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond.

Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making.

How you’ll be hosting with heart:

  • Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability.

  • Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making.

  • Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making.

  • Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives.

  • Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience.

  • Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models.

  • Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.


What you need to shoot for the stars:

  • Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems.

  • Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling.

  • Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments.

  • Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets.

  • Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity.

  • Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations.

  • Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds.

We're designed to stay because:

  • Hybrid Office Model: We offer a flexible and empowering work environment - you can choose to work 100% from our office or partially from home and the office.

  • Visa & Language Support: We’ll support you during your visa process and with learning German on every language level after passing your probation period.

  • Relocation Support: We'll financially support your move to Munich if you live further away than 300km from our office.

  • Oneteam: We are #oneteam with a transparent company culture by staying up to date with each other through team stand-ups, regular All-Hands and suite events (Summer, Wiesn, Christmas).

  • Growth and Development: We make sure that you keep growing - through constant feedback, peer reviews and exchanges with focus on your development.

  • Limitless learning: We offer you the possibility to choose an external development format that will help you in reaching your full potential without any limits in budget.

  • Workation: You have the chance to work twice per year for a duration of up to 4 weeks from a different country in the European Union. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly.

  • Sabbatical: After your 1.5 years with Limehome we offer the possibility for a 3-month sabbatical. You can use it for whatever you want: may it be traveling, spending time with your besties or volunteering.

  • Everything for our Limehomies: We focus on your physical wellbeing (Urban Sports Club), to your mental wellbeing (Nilo.health), or even staycations in one of our beautiful Limehomes, and many more suite benefits. Join us and find out! 😉

Who we are:

Limehome is a leading tech-enabled operator in the hospitality industry offering functional, design accommodations across Europe. Using proprietary technology, Limehome delivers comfortable and convenient stays with a seamless digital guest experience for business and leisure travellers. Our vision is to be the first choice in travel for everyone, everywhere. By now, our portfolio consists of more than 10,000 apartments and hotel rooms under contract across 150 cities in 13 European countries.

title: Creative Strategist · Paid Social, KI-native (m/w/d)
description:
Warum es diese Stelle gibt

Infinos ist eine der größten Telemedizin-Plattformen für medizinische Abnehmtherapie in Deutschland. Wir machen einen mittleren 7-stelligen Jahresumsatz und haben bis heute kein Investorengeld genommen. Zwei Gründer, ein Team von rund 8 Leuten, tausende Patienten, die wir jeden Monat begleiten.

Ich bin Linus, einer der beiden Gründer und habe die Creatives für unsere Ads bisher zum großen Teil selbst gemacht. Das Marketing wächst schneller, als ich es neben allem anderen leisten kann. Deshalb suche ich die Person, die diesen Bereich übernimmt und mit uns ausbaut.

Was du machst

  • Den Markt beobachten: was die Konkurrenz in Deutschland und im Ausland schaltet und was im Abnehmmarkt außerhalb der Medizin funktioniert.

  • Daraus testbare Konzepte machen, jeweils mit klarer Hypothese und mehreren Hooks, und davon jede Woche neue an den Start bringen.

  • Creatives selbst bauen, vor allem mit KI: Statics, Animationen und Schnitte aus vorhandenem Material.

  • Drehs organisieren, mit uns Gründern, unserem Team und UGC-Creator, von Briefing und Skript bis zur Abnahme.

  • Auswerten, was läuft und daraus die nächste Runde ableiten.

  • Später dazu: unseren Newsletter und Shortform-Content für TikTok und Reels.

Deine ersten 90 Tage

  • Woche 1: deine erste eigene Ad ist live.

  • Monat 1: Marktbeobachtung und Ideenplanung laufen über dich und jede Woche gehen neue Tests von dir raus.

  • Monat 3: du gibst deine Ads selbst frei, kennst die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich sicher und hast einen Plan, wie wir organisch auf Shortform wachsen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast schon Creatives für Paid Social gebaut, die gelaufen sind und weißt, warum sie funktioniert haben. Wie groß das Budget dahinter war, ist zweitrangig.

  • Du baust selbst, statt nur zu briefen, und arbeitest dafür täglich mit KI-Tools für Bild, Video, Stimme und Text.

  • Du schreibst gute deutsche Hooks und Skripte. Sehr gute deutsche Sprachkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind deshalb Voraussetzung.

  • Du verstehst, warum jemand mit Übergewicht nach Hilfe sucht und warum er sie dann oft doch nicht annimmt und du schreibst darüber ohne Herablassung.

  • Du hast Lust, dich in die Regeln für Werbung im Gesundheitsbereich einzuarbeiten. Was wir zeigen dürfen und was nicht, bringen wir dir bei.

  • Du willst die Stelle in Vollzeit machen und nicht nebenbei.

Hilfreich, aber nicht nötig: Erfahrung in Health, Fitness oder Ernährung oder mit anderer regulierter Werbung, ein Netzwerk an UGC-Creator, Videoschnitt. Wenn du aus dem Performance-Marketing kommst und kreativer arbeiten willst, bewirb dich trotzdem.

Was wir bieten

  • €48.000–60.000 Fixgehalt, je nach Erfahrung.

  • Virtuelle Unternehmensanteile aus unserem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungspool (VSOP). Die Höhe besprechen wir im ersten Gespräch.

  • KI-Tooling ohne Budgetgrenze.

  • Remote mit regelmäßigen Teamtreffen vor Ort und freier Zeiteinteilung, solange die Arbeit stimmt.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit beiden Gründern und ehrliches Feedback in beide Richtungen.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub.

So bewirbst du dich

Kein Anschreiben. Im Bewerbungsformular hier auf join fragen wir dich zwei Dinge: warum du die richtige Person für diese Rolle bist, mit deiner Erfahrung und dem, was du bisher erreicht hast, gern mit Zahlen. Und welche unserer Ads aus der Meta Ad Library du anders machen würdest, mit einem Satz, wie.

Wir antworten innerhalb von 3 Tagen. Dann:

  1. 30 Minuten Videocall mit Jan und mir. Wir erzählen, wie wir arbeiten und warum es die Stelle gibt. Du erzählst uns, was du bisher gemacht hast und was du suchst.

  2. Eine Probeaufgabe von etwa 4 bis 5 Stunden: Markt anschauen, ein Testpaket entwickeln und ein Creative fertig bauen.

  3. 30 Minuten, in denen du uns die Probeaufgabe vorstellst und wir über die Erwartungen beider Seiten sprechen.

  4. Angebot, schriftlich. Vom ersten Gespräch bis hierhin brauchen wir in der Regel zwei bis drei Wochen.

title: Head of Growth Europa (m/w/d)
description:
10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler, und die Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben von 10ML in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml sind ein einfacher Weg, Designer- und Nischendüfte zu entdecken. Als Head of Growth verantwortest du die gesamte Wachstumsmaschine in Europa: Akquise, Conversion, Kundenbindung und Expansion in neue Länder und Kanäle.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Wachstumsstrategie und ihre Kennzahlen: Neukunden, Conversion Rate, durchschnittlicher Bestellwert, Wiederkaufrate und Payback in allen europäischen Märkten

  • Du führst die Verantwortlichen für Performance Marketing, SEO, CRM und Partnerschaften, setzt ihre Ziele und gibst ihnen das Budget, um zu gewinnen

  • Du steuerst ein konsequentes Testing-Programm für Website, Checkout, Angebote und Onboarding

  • Du planst Markteintritte und Lokalisierung in neuen EU-Ländern gemeinsam mit Content, Kundenservice und Operations

  • Du baust Forecasts und Reportings, mit denen die Geschäftsleitung entscheidet, wohin der nächste Euro fließt

  • Du machst Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zum selbstverständlichen Weg, einen Duft vor dem Flakonkauf zu testen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 8 Jahre in Growth oder Performance Marketing im D2C-E-Commerce, bei Marktplätzen oder Konsumgütermarken, davon mindestens 3 Jahre mit Führungsverantwortung

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim profitablen Skalieren bezahlter und organischer Kanäle in mehreren europäischen Ländern

  • Sicher im Umgang mit Unit Economics: CAC, LTV, Deckungsbeitrag, Kohortenbindung

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads und Analysen auf SQL-Niveau

  • Fließendes Englisch; Deutsch oder eine weitere EU-Sprache ist ein großes Plus

  • Bonus: Erfahrung in Beauty, Duft, Kosmetik oder Luxus-Retail

Über 10ML

10ML ist ein europäischer Parfum-Händler mit Hauptsitz in Dortmund. Seit der Gründung 2025 verkauft 10ML originale Designer- und Nischendüfte als Parfum-Abfüllungen und Proben in 3 ml, 10 ml und 30 ml. 10ML kauft bei autorisierten EU-Distributoren und direkt bei den Marken ein und füllt jedes Parfum selbst ab. Nach eigenen Angaben hat 10ML mehr als 100.000 Kundinnen und Kunden.

Der Jahresumsatz über alle Vertriebskanäle liegt 2026 bei knapp 21 Millionen Euro. Der ARR von 10ML liegt bei mehr als 10 Millionen Euro.

Was 10ML bietet

  • Ein Gehalt an der Spitze des Marktes plus einen jährlichen Leistungsbonus

  • Remote-Arbeit überall in der EU (sofern die Stelle nicht vor Ort ist) oder das Büro in Dortmund, wenn du lieber dort arbeitest

  • 30 Tage bezahlter Urlaub

  • 2.000 € persönliches Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr, dazu Konferenzen

  • Ein monatliches Duftbudget, um den Katalog an Parfum-Abfüllungen von 10ML zu entdecken

  • Ein erstklassiger Laptop und die Tools, die du brauchst

  • Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und in Dortmund ein voll bezahltes Deutschlandticket

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Verantwortung und Budgets, die zum Anspruch passen

So bewirbst du dich

Schick deinen Lebenslauf und alles, was deine Arbeit zeigt (Portfolio, Links, Ergebnisse), an ----- mit dem Stellentitel im Betreff. Arbeitssprache ist Englisch; Deutsch ist ein Plus, sofern die Stelle nichts anderes sagt.

title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
Your Role

As Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients (f/m/d) you own the complete growth loop for LIQID's digitally-led clients: from a newly created lead to the first investment, and from there to the next top-up, the second portfolio and the next product. Acquisition and expansion sit in one team with one mandate, so you build a single growth system instead of handing clients over at the funnel's end. LIQID is hybrid by design: for this segment the experience is digital-first, and you decide precisely where a human touch from our advisors accelerates conversion or growth – and where it doesn't.

What you'll do

  • End-to-End Segment Ownership: Own the digital client lifecycle from Lead → Signup → Checkout → First Investment → Activation → Expansion. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree across conversion and expansion – lead-to-funded conversion, time to fund, time to first top-up, multi-product rate, share of wallet – and you are accountable for net new money from the segment, not for a single funnel stage.

  • Lead Conversion & Onboarding Experience: Design and optimize the journeys that turn leads into funded clients – lead nurturing, signup, onboarding and checkout – together with Product Design, Marketing and Sales. You shape the first-product strategy – which entry offer converts which persona – and make sure the brand promise and premium positioning carry through every step that builds trust and drives conversion.

  • Digital Up- & Cross-Sell: Turn first-time investors into multi-product clients: top-ups and savings plans, second portfolios, additional account types and access to new asset classes such as private markets. You find natural product sequences through path and cohort analysis, build the in-product moments and lifecycle campaigns that convert them, and prove impact with causal measurement rather than correlation stories.

  • Hybrid Where It Pays Off: Define when a human touch turns a hesitant prospect into a client or a single-product client into a long-term relationship – callback offers at checkout drop-off, advisor triggers at wealth thresholds, and a clean handover to our Private Wealth team as clients grow. Every human touchpoint is designed, triggered and measured, not left to chance.

  • Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality: Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops, working closely with Marketing and Sales. Y ou build on shared onboarding and banking infrastructure owned by our platform teams, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for digital wealth growth at LIQID.

What you bring

  • Background: 7+ years in Product Management or Growth for digital consumer products, with ownership of both conversion and monetization or expansion outcomes. FinTech, WealthTech, banking or subscription businesses are a strong plus.

  • Growth & Analytical Depth: Hands-on with funnel, cohort and LTV analysis. You define metrics before you build, establish baselines, can query data yourself, and know the difference between a significant result and a lucky one.

  • Technical & AI Fluency: Experience working with product analytics and CRM data. You are comfortable discussing architecture and API trade-offs with engineers and use AI tooling to prototype, analyze and ship faster.

  • Domain Curiosity & Client Empathy: Genuine interest in investing and capital markets, and an understanding that converting someone to invest a significant share of their wealth is a trust decision, not an impulse purchase.

  • Communication & Language: Fluent in German and English, able to align Product, Design, Engineering, Marketing and Sales around one growth agenda and to represent your roadmap credibly toward leadership. Drive & Motivation: Comfortable in fast-paced, high-ownership scale-up environments. Y ou want to own outcomes, not backlogs, and you are excited to build the growth engine of a digital-first wealth manager in an AI-native product organization.

What we offer

  • Diversity: Flat hierarchies and cultural openness make you an integral part of our diverse team of international talents from day one.

  • Flexibility: We don’t complicate your life. You’ll find the right balance with flexible work models, working hours, and remote work options. 28 days of vacation and two additional days off on December 24 and 31 ensure you have ample time to unwind.

  • Appreciation: You’ll help shape the future of digital wealth management with us in an innovative, multi-award-winning company on a growth trajectory, with high market relevance and plenty of space for your ideas.

  • Development: We support your personal and professional growth with an annual development budget up to €1,500. Additionally, at the start of your tenure at LIQID, you’ll receive high-quality equipment, including a MacBook, headphones, and a display.

  • Smart Money: As a LIQIDian, you'll enjoy attractive terms for our investment strategies, a monthly lunch allowance, and exclusive discounts with various providers.

  • Well-being: Regional organic products keep you fit in the office, and our health initiatives or Health Assistance Program go far beyond that.

What happens next

An excellent candidate, experience and transparency are our top priorities in the interview process. The different stages help us understand how a potential collaboration could look.

  1. Initial Call with our Talent Partner: A casual introduction and discussion to align your expectations with the role.

  2. Video Call with Head of Product: You will learn more about the performance expectations and specific role requirements from our leadership team.

  3. Take-home Assessment with live Presentation round: A take home task, followed by a 90-minute live session with two team members.

  4. In-Person Meeting: You will meet some team members onsite, tour our office and sit down with our Head of Product to discuss final alignments.

 

About us

We are LIQID, one of the fastest-growing fintechs in Europe. Our purpose is to provide creators, entrepreneurs, and thinkers shaping our future with access to the same opportunities as the world’s most successful investors while balancing the demands of people, planet, and profit.

We offer our clients financial peace of mind through exceptional, curated investment solutions – ranging from the world’s best private equity and venture funds to award-winning wealth management solutions. All delivered via an intuitive digital experience with outstanding personal support. With over €4 billion in assets, we are backed by leading investors from the digital, private equity, and wealth management space, including LGT, Toscafund, HQ Trust, and Project A.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
Fastned is one of Europe's leading fast-charging networks. Active across nine countries, we have spent nearly 15 years building the infrastructure, expertise and brand that define premium fast charging in Europe. What sets us apart is our focus on reliability, sustainability and the energy transition. We have been awarded “Best Charging Network” in the UK, France, Switzerland and the Netherlands, further establishing Fastned as a leading player in the field. This is your opportunity to make a lasting impact and help us accelerate our operations in the DACH region to the next level! Join Fastned at the forefront of Europe’s electric vehicle and charging infrastructure revolution.

The role is based in our beautiful office in Cologne, where your over 50 future colleagues cannot wait to meet you!

Your role

As Senior Operations Manager DACH, you will initially focus on Germany and Switzerland while helping shape the future of operations across the wider DACH region, including Austria as the organisation expands. Germany is entering a major growth phase, with the network expected to expand significantly in the coming years. You will help design an operating model that can absorb this growth while keeping uptime above 99%, improving customer experience and managing costs and team growth responsibly.

You will have significant ownership of how operations are run in Germany and Switzerland. As the key operational point of contact for German, Swiss and future Austrian stations, you will work closely with country and central teams, as well as contractors and service providers. Your scope spans preventive maintenance of chargers and stations, station appearance and amenities, reactive maintenance, spare parts logistics, and the continuous improvement of our operations and processes. Within the broader direction set by Fastned, you will define priorities, improve the operating model and make pragmatic decisions that keep the region performing as the network grows.

Your responsibilities

Team leadership

Lead and grow the DACH field team.

  • Supervising, coaching and developing a team of five Field Engineers and a Station Manager, with a Maintenance Coordinator joining over time, ensuring they work safely, efficiently and as one strong team.

  • Managing team capacity, prioritising work and dispatching jobs in the most efficient way across the Swiss and German network.

  • Bringing structure to the team’s priorities and ways of working, helping ensure maintenance work is completed on time and the network remains safe, reliable and available for our customers.

  • Creating a strong safety culture by ensuring full compliance with Health & Safety standards and regulatory requirements, and providing a safe and caring work environment for colleagues on the road and on site.

Operational excellence

Ensure high uptime and a great station experience.

  • Being accountable for all day-to-day operations of Fastned stations in the DACH region, from chargers and systems to the overall look and feel of our sites.

  • Ensuring we maintain network uptime above 99% in your region through effective preventive maintenance plans and swift, high-quality reactive repairs.

  • Managing a network of partners responsible for maintaining and servicing our stations.

  • Supporting improvements to the customer experience and your team in the field by regularly visiting stations, performing site inspections and quality audits, with a strong focus on safety and customer experience.

  • Overseeing the handover of new stations in the DACH region from Construction to Field Operations, ensuring they meet our operational, safety and quality standards from day one.

  • Managing spare parts flows together with our Supply Chain team to optimise local stock levels, minimise downtime and ensure that engineers always have the right parts at the right time.

  • Leading and coordinating with external partners larger infrastructure works at your stations.

  • Continuously improving how we work by taking local initiatives, standardising best practices, simplifying processes and using data and insights to make better decisions.

Customer, stakeholder and partner management

  • Delivering a best-in-class customer experience by ensuring stations are always clean, safe and easy to use, with strong attention to detail across lighting, signage, landscaping, cleanliness and amenities.

  • Collaborating closely with Customer Operations and other internal teams to monitor performance, respond to incidents and ensure a smooth, end-to-end customer journey across the network.

  • Acting as the voice of DACH Operations within the leadership team and central organisations, representing operational priorities and insights.

  • Initiating, developing and maintaining strong relationships with external partners and contractors, such as electrical contractors, cleaning, landscaping and civil works providers. Providing operational input into new station designs, upgrades and local initiatives to ensure operational excellence is embedded from the outset.

You will report to our Director of Operations, based in Amsterdam. The role is based in Germany and involves regular travel across the DACH region to visit stations and team members, as well as occasional travel to our Amsterdam headquarters.

Who are we looking for?

You are a seasoned field operations leader who can both set direction and get things done on the ground. You combine a strategic mindset with strong operational experience, and you are excited to scale and professionalise Fastned’s German and Swiss operations. You think in terms of network performance, customer experience and long-term capabilities, while also being comfortable jumping into the details when needed to remove blockers for your team.

In addition, you meet most of the following criteria:

  • You have at least eight years of relevant experience in operations roles.

  • You have proven experience scaling or professionalising operations in a growing market, for example by building teams, introducing new ways of working, improving performance and enhancing customer experience.

  • You are a strong people leader who coaches and develops your team, communicates clearly and stands your ground when needed, leads by example in the field, and creates a safe, high-performance culture.

  • You combine a strategic mindset, including the ability to set a vision for DACH Operations, define priorities and align stakeholders, with hands-on senior operational experience. You are comfortable going on site, understanding technical issues and making pragmatic trade-offs.

  • You remain calm and organised under pressure, can manage multiple priorities at once and maintain a positive, can-do attitude.

  • You are a strong communicator and stakeholder manager, able to connect the needs of the German and Swiss operations with those of our central teams and influence decisions where needed.

  • You are fluent in English and German. Any additional European language is a plus.

Join us in building a better future

We work hard to change the world, but we do not forget to recognise and celebrate our successes, big and small. We value work-life balance, offer real work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We have an inclusive work environment and love authentic people, so do not try to fit in because we like you for who you are!

  • A fully electric company car, with all charging expenses covered.

  • 29 days of annual leave.

  • Two Mission Days each year to support a cause you care about or contribute to our mission.

  • A company bonus plan that recognises the impact you make.

  • A Deutschlandticket covered by Fastned.

  • An annual personal development budget of €3,000, because there is always more to learn and improve.

  • Mental wellbeing support through nilo health.

  • A subsidised Urban Sports Club membership.

  • Access to women’s health experts through our partnership with Flouria.

  • A laptop and phone of your choice, with an EU-wide mobile phone plan.

  • Daily vegetarian lunches, snacks and drinks at our office locations.

  • Team events throughout the year, an annual company trip and our legendary Christmas parties.

Interested? Apply today!

We would love to have a conversation with you! Apply now, send us your CV and explain in your cover letter why you are excited about joining our mission for freedom in sustainable transportation.

We are looking forward to your application!

title: Senior Consumer Duty Specialist
description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About the role

In this role, you will play a central part in assessing, questioning, and enhancing how customers experience Pleo. Drawing on deep regulatory knowledge, you will lead Consumer Duty initiatives, actively spot potential customer harm, examine what drives customer journeys, and ensure targeted remediation creates lasting, positive impact.

You'll need sharp analytical skills and the confidence to influence stakeholders, translating data and MI into decisive action. You will construct and manage dashboards and reporting mechanisms that illuminate emerging patterns, vulnerable customer risks, and key concerns, offering executive leadership clear visibility into operational gaps and necessary solutions.

Your contribution goes well beyond producing MI. You will conduct QA across complex complaint handling and sensitive customer interactions, manage Ombudsman cases, and speak up when evidence shows outcomes aren't meeting expectations. Collaborating across teams, you'll turn data-driven insights into practical improvements, drive projects to completion, and evaluate whether changes deliver real results for our users.

We're seeking someone who views Consumer Duty as a powerful driver of business improvement rather than a routine compliance exercise. You'll bring together technical understanding, rigorous analysis, and constructive challenge to investigate root causes, align key partners, deliver change, and prove that customer experiences are continuously getting better.

Who you’ll be working with and reporting to

You'll work closely with teams across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, Technology, and other business functions.

The role will have broad exposure across the organisation, particularly when customer outcome risks or Consumer Duty-related remediation require cross-functional action.

You'll also work closely with senior stakeholders through Consumer Duty governance and reporting, helping translate detailed analysis into clear insights, risks, recommendations, and actions.

What you’ll be doing

As a Consumer Duty Specialist, you will:

  • Turn data into customer outcome insight: Build and own MI, dashboards, KPIs, and reporting that give the business a clear view of customer outcomes, trends, risks, and emerging areas of concern.

  • Own Consumer Duty reporting: Produce monthly and quarterly Consumer Duty reporting, turning complex data into a clear story for senior leadership and Board-level audiences. You'll go beyond showing what happened to explain why it matters and what we should do about it.

  • Identify customer harm: Use complaints, QA findings, customer feedback, vulnerable customer data, Ombudsman cases, and MI to identify potential customer harm, emerging risks, and systemic issues.

  • Challenge the business: Where the evidence suggests customers aren't receiving good outcomes, you'll be expected to ask difficult questions, challenge assumptions, and ensure the issue is properly understood and addressed.

  • Drive remediation and change: Work with stakeholders across the business to agree remediation plans, establish clear owners and timelines, and help drive Consumer Duty-related projects and improvements through to completion.

  • Provide complaints QA: Conduct weekly quality reviews of complaints handled by the Complaints Manager, using findings to identify quality issues, customer risks, and wider trends.

  • Manage Ombudsman activity: Act as the primary operational contact with the UK Ombudsman, managing referred complaints, responses, remedies, compensation, invoices, and related communications.

  • Leverage AI and smart automation: Spot opportunities to apply automated tools and AI to scale and streamline Consumer Duty analytics, monitoring, and workflows. You will feel empowered to test emerging tech and eliminate repetitive manual work, maintaining proper critical evaluation and human governance whenever compliance risks or customer impacts are involved.

What you bring

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

  • Strong Consumer Duty knowledge: You understand the principles of Consumer Duty and how they translate into practical customer outcomes, particularly across complaints, customer support, vulnerable customers, and customer journeys.

  • Strong data and MI experience: You know how to take complex data, build meaningful dashboards and reporting, and identify the insights that actually matter. You're comfortable working with data rather than simply consuming reports created by others.

  • A customer outcome mindset: You're naturally curious about how customers are experiencing the business and are able to connect data, customer feedback, complaints, and operational activity to real customer outcomes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills: You can spot trends, anomalies, and patterns, investigate root causes, and determine whether an issue is isolated or potentially systemic.

  • The confidence to challenge: You're comfortable questioning decisions, processes, and assumptions when the evidence suggests customers may be experiencing poor outcomes. You can challenge constructively and build relationships at the same time.

  • A bias towards action: You don't believe reporting is the end of the process. You want to understand what needs to change, bring people together, and help make it happen.

  • Project and remediation experience: You're comfortable managing actions, timelines, dependencies, stakeholders, and risks across cross-functional projects, particularly where there is a regulatory, customer, or operational outcome to deliver.

  • An AI and automation mindset: You're naturally curious about how AI and automation can make processes more efficient, improve analysis, and free up time for higher-value work. You look for sensible opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and use AI to augment your thinking, while maintaining appropriate human oversight, critical judgement, and accountability — particularly where customer outcomes or regulatory decisions are involved.

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love using data to uncover things that others might not see.

  • You want your analysis to drive real change, rather than sit in a report or dashboard.

  • You enjoy asking "why?" and getting to the root cause of customer problems.

  • You're comfortable challenging the business when the evidence tells you something isn't working.

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer to produce reporting without being involved in what happens afterwards.

  • You're uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or having difficult conversations when customer outcomes aren't where they should be.

  • You prefer working within a narrow functional remit rather than across multiple teams.

How you’ll develop in this role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Build a deep understanding of our customer outcome data, existing Consumer Duty MI, complaints, vulnerable customer journeys, and current areas of risk.

  • Take ownership of key Consumer Duty dashboards and reporting, developing a clear view of the metrics and insights that matter most.

  • Establish strong relationships with stakeholders across Customer Support, Complaints, Compliance, Risk, Operations, Product, Data, and Technology.

  • Lead the analysis behind Consumer Duty reporting and help shape how customer outcomes are presented to senior stakeholders and the Board.

Over time, you'll have the opportunity to shape how Pleo measures, understands, and improves customer outcomes, helping move Consumer Duty from a regulatory obligation into a genuine driver of better customer experiences and better business decisions.

Show me the benefits!

  • Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)

  • Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office

  • Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis

  • We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays

  • For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options

  • Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice

  • We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far

  • Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.

  2. Meet the Hiring Manager: 1hr going through role in more depth.

  3. Pleo Challenge: A case study were you talk us through how you'd solve a work appropriate challenge.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we advertised this role, we received a really high volume of applications but could only select so many. Some of the key reasons why previous candidates didn’t make it past the application screening stage include:

  • CV writing and content: we receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background!

  • Application care: every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.

  • Profile to role fit: highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About your application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.

  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.

  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.

  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email ----- We’ll design a process that works for you.

  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.

  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.

  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Our founders spent over a decade at Google shaping the Android operating systems - building and shipping the software that now runs on billions of devices. They didn't just use Android; they led teams responsible for the Android Virtualization Framework, Security, and the Android Runtime (ART).

Through that journey, they saw a quiet but massive crisis: as device software grew in complexity, the tools used to build it remained stuck in the past. Today, a standard Android checkout exceeds 200GB of code, and builds can take hours. This "wait time" is the single biggest tax on innovation.

Source.dev was founded to reimagine software development workflows for device makers. We’re building a new generation of software tools that make building complex device software feel as simple as building a webpage - starting with SourceFS.

The Core Product: SourceFS

SourceFS is a high-performance virtual filesystem designed to turn multi-hour workflows into minutes.

  • 10x Faster Builds: Intelligent caching and virtualization that only materializes files when they are actually needed.

  • 10x Lower Costs: Enabling a standard 16-vCPU machine to outperform even a 128-vCPU machine.

  • True Engineering Productivity: Replaying hundreds of thousands of build steps instantly when inputs match.

The Cultural Anchor: Own It

"We own our work end-to-end, from spark to finish. It’s about more than just tasks; it’s the dedication to see things through, staying curious to solve problems, thinking from first principles and ensuring we fix our customer’s problems in the best possible way.”

The Role: Pushing the Speed Limits of Rust, Linux & I/O

We are looking for a Performance / Systems Engineer to join us at Source.dev. In this role, your primary metric of success is speed. You will dissect execution paths, eliminate kernel-space context-switching costs, optimize memory layouts, and ensure SourceFS runs as close to the hardware limits as physically possible.

What You’ll Work On

  • System Bottleneck Hunting: Profile, trace, and eliminate latency across CPU, memory, and disk I/O bottlenecks in Rust systems code using tools like perf, eBPF, valgrind, and custom microbenchmarks.

  • Kernel & File System Tuning: Deep dive into Linux kernel interactions, optimizing FUSE drivers, VFS caches, asynchronous I/O (io_uring), memory-mapped execution, and thread scheduling.

  • Memory & Cache Efficiency: Optimize data structures for cache locality, minimize allocation overhead, and eliminate unnecessary memory copies across boundary transitions.

  • Benchmarking Infrastructure: Design robust, reproducible benchmarking suites to measure micro- and macro-performance regression in high-concurrency environments.

  • Scaling Build Primitives: Squeeze peak performance out of massive build graphs (Android, Yocto, and more) running on high-core hardware configurations.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

  • The Performance Systems Mindset: You have a deep understanding of computer architecture (CPU caches, memory barriers, SIMD, system calls) and proven experience writing hyper-optimized code in Rust or C/C++.(or other). No prior experience with Rust required, just a willingness to learn is all we are looking for.

  • Scale-Obsessed: You have experience with (or a burning desire to fix) large-scale build systems and developer tooling.

Forecasting, Planning & Operating Rhythm

title: Senior Director, International Global Partnerships
description:
Monster Jam is the world’s premier monster truck entertainment property, delivering unforgettable live events, iconic trucks, and family experiences to millions of fans around the globe. As the brand continues to expand across Europe, we are seeking a dynamic Franchise Manager to lead integrated growth initiatives spanning marketing, consumer products, retail partnerships, and toy/category development. 

The Senior Director, International Global Partnerships, will lead the strategic growth of the Monster Jam brand across key European markets through integrated franchise marketing, retail activation, consumer products expansion, and cross-functional partnership management. This role is responsible for building cohesive programs that drive brand awareness, increase toy and merchandise penetration, strengthen retailer relationships, and ultimately accelerate event attendance and ticket sales.

The ideal candidate is a commercially minded brand builder with experience managing entertainment, toy, sports, family, or lifestyle franchises across multiple territories. This individual will work closely with the Monster Jam consumer products team, regional promoters, retail partners, regional licensees and the Spin Master toy organization to create coordinated campaigns that put Monster Jam products into the hands of consumers while amplifying engagement with the brand within all franchise touchpoints including the live event business.


Essential Functions

Franchise & Brand Marketing

  • Develop and execute the European franchise growth strategy for Monster Jam across key markets and retail channels.
  • Lead integrated marketing initiatives that increase awareness, fan engagement, and affinity for the Monster Jam brand.
  • Partner with regional event, marketing, and ticketing teams to align campaigns that drive attendance and revenue growth.
  • Create scalable promotional programs that connect consumer products, retail activations, digital marketing, and live events.
  • Identify market-specific opportunities to grow audience reach, including localized campaigns, partnerships, and experiential activations.
  • Serve as a steward of the Monster Jam brand across all consumer-facing touchpoints.

    • Consumer Products & Licensing

  • Support the expansion of the Monster Jam consumer products business throughout Europe.
  • Identify opportunities for new product categories, retail exclusives, promotions, and licensing partnerships.
  • Collaborate with internal licensing and consumer products stakeholders to maximize shelf presence and category performance.
  • Analyze market trends, retail performance, and consumer insights to inform product and franchise strategies.
  • Develop annual plans and commercial initiatives that support long-term franchise growth.

    • Retail Partnerships & Programs

  • Build and manage strategic relationships with major European retailers and distribution partners.
  • Develop retail marketing programs that elevate visibility, support product launches, and drive sell-through.
  • Partner with retailers on seasonal campaigns, in-store activations, sweepstakes, promotions, and event tie-ins.
  • Coordinate retailer-specific marketing assets, promotional calendars, and execution plans.
  • Monitor retail performance metrics and identify opportunities to optimize programs and increase market penetration.

    • Spin Master Partnership Management

  • Act as the primary liaison with the Spin Master toy team across Europe and North America for product development for regional needs.
  • Partner closely on go-to-market planning, product launches, marketing campaigns, and retail initiatives.
  • Communicate regional market insights, fan trends, and retailer feedback to support product development and commercial planning.
  • Drive initiatives that increase toy awareness, distribution, and consumer adoption across Europe.
  • Champion the shared vision of placing a Monster Jam toy in every child’s hands to fuel broader franchise engagement and live event attendance.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including marketing, events, ticketing, licensing, finance, and operations, to ensure alignment across all franchise initiatives.
  • Lead project timelines, campaign execution, and stakeholder communication across multiple markets and partners.
  • Present business updates, market insights, and growth opportunities to senior leadership.
  • Manage agency and external partner relationships where applicable.

    • Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Entertainment Management, or related field.
  • 5–8+ years of experience in franchise marketing, brand management, consumer products, licensing, retail marketing, or related fields.
  • Experience working with entertainment, toy, sports, gaming, family, or lifestyle brands preferred.
  • Strong understanding of European retail landscapes and consumer markets.
  • Proven ability to manage cross-functional partnerships and external stakeholders.
  • Experience collaborating with major retailers and consumer products organizations.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to translate brand strategy into measurable business growth.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects across international markets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to travel across Europe and internationally as needed.

    • Success Metrics

  • Growth in Monster Jam brand awareness across European markets.
  • Increased consumer products and toy sales performance.
  • Expansion and effectiveness of retail partnerships and promotional programs.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Quarzo Life construit une nouvelle génération de plateforme d’assurance vie combinant excellence opérationnelle, expérience utilisateur moderne et forte ambition technologique.

Après avoir construit notre MVP et posé les premiers standards engineering, nous renforçons aujourd’hui notre équipe technique interne autour de notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer.

Nous recherchons un Senior Full Stack Engineer capable de prendre rapidement l’ownership de domaines fonctionnels importants de notre plateforme, d’accélérer le delivery produit et de contribuer directement à sa fiabilité en production.

Vous rejoindrez l’aventure à un moment clé : la base technique est déjà posée, le MVP est proche de sa mise en production et l’enjeu est désormais de faire évoluer rapidement la plateforme tout en renforçant sa robustesse, son observabilité, sa sécurité et sa maintenabilité.

Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec notre Founding Engineer / Lead Developer, qui porte la cohérence technique globale, l’architecture et la structuration progressive de l’équipe engineering, ainsi qu’avec Ferréol Robert, fondateur CPTO.

Votre rôle sera avant tout celui d’un builder avec un ownership de production : comprendre des problématiques métier complexes, concevoir des solutions simples et robustes, les développer de bout en bout, les mettre en production, puis vous assurer qu’elles fonctionnent correctement dans la durée.

Chez Quarzo Life, le travail d’un ingénieur ne s’arrête pas au merge d’une pull request : you build it, you run it.

Les compétences clés attendues incluent une solide culture technique full-stack, avec une capacité à intervenir efficacement sur plusieurs dimensions du produit (front, back, données, infrastructure et production) sans nécessairement être expert sur chacune.

Nous recherchons surtout un profil capable de prendre l’ownership d’un problème plutôt que d’exécuter une liste de tickets : comprendre le besoin, challenger la solution, construire, livrer, observer et améliorer.

Le rôle pourra évoluer avec la croissance de Quarzo Life vers davantage de responsabilités techniques selon les compétences et aspirations du candidat.

Vos missions

Product engineering & delivery

  • Concevoir et développer des fonctionnalités produit de bout en bout sur notre stack TypeScript et React.
  • Prendre progressivement l’ownership technique de plusieurs domaines fonctionnels de la plateforme.
  • Participer activement à la discovery produit et à la conception fonctionnelle.
  • Challenger les spécifications lorsque cela permet d’améliorer le produit, de réduire la complexité ou d’accélérer le delivery.
  • Livrer régulièrement des fonctionnalités utilisables en production avec un haut niveau d’autonomie.

Production, run & observabilité

La plateforme Quarzo Life porte des opérations financières et assurantielles critiques. Son exploitation quotidienne fait donc pleinement partie du rôle de l’équipe engineering. Vous participerez directement au run de la production et serez progressivement autonome sur l’exploitation des services dont vous avez la responsabilité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • surveiller quotidiennement la santé des applications et services en production ;
  • analyser les logs, métriques, traces et alertes afin d’identifier rapidement les anomalies ;
  • construire et améliorer les dashboards permettant de suivre les principaux composants et flux de la plateforme ;
  • investiguer les incidents de production jusqu’à identification de leur cause racine ;
  • suivre le bon fonctionnement des principaux flux métier et techniques ;
  • participer aux déploiements et vérifier leur bon déroulement en production ;
  • contribuer aux procédures de rollback, reprise, sauvegarde et restauration ;
  • réaliser des root cause analyses et post-mortems lorsqu’un incident significatif survient ;
  • mettre en œuvre les actions correctrices permettant d’éviter la répétition des incidents ;
  • identifier les opérations manuelles fragiles ou répétitives et les automatiser ;
  • participer, à mesure que l’équipe grandit, à une organisation d’astreinte adaptée à la criticité du service.

L’objectif est que chaque Senior Engineer puisse progressivement opérer de manière autonome les services qu’il développe, sans faire du Lead Developer le point de passage systématique pour chaque incident.

Infrastructure, DevOps & reliability

Sans nécessairement être un spécialiste DevOps ou SRE, vous devez être à l’aise avec l’environnement dans lequel votre code fonctionne.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intervenir sur les pipelines CI/CD ;
  • contribuer aux pratiques Infrastructure as Code ;
  • comprendre les problématiques de networking applicatif, configuration, secrets et dépendances externes ;
  • suivre les bases de données ;
  • améliorer les procédures de déploiement et de recovery ;
  • contribuer aux sujets de continuité et reprise d’activité.

Le Founding Engineer / Lead Developer conserve la responsabilité de la cohérence globale de l’architecture et des standards de plateforme, mais chaque Senior Engineer porte la fiabilité opérationnelle de son périmètre.

Software craftsmanship & qualité

  • Adhérer et faire vivre aux valeurs de l'artisanat logiciel.
  • Produire un code lisible, testé, documenté et maintenable.
  • Contribuer à faire progresser collectivement la qualité du codebase.
  • Appliquer et enrichir les standards engineering : tests automatisés, CI/CD, documentation, observabilité et sécurité.
  • Identifier spontanément les zones de dette technique et proposer des améliorations proportionnées aux enjeux.
  • Utiliser les pratiques DDD, TDD et les principes de clean architecture, sans dogmatisme.
  • Concevoir les fonctionnalités en anticipant leur exploitation et leur diagnostic en production.
  • Considérer logs, métriques, alertes et gestion des erreurs comme faisant partie intégrante d’une fonctionnalité terminée.

Sécurité & conformité

En tant qu’assureur, Quarzo Life évolue dans un environnement particulièrement exigeant en matière de fiabilité, de sécurité et de traçabilité.

Vous contribuerez notamment à :

  • intégrer les principes de security et privacy by design dans les développements ;
  • renforcer la sécurité applicative et infrastructure ;
  • assurer la traçabilité des traitements et événements importants ;
  • participer aux chantiers techniques liés à notre trajectoire ISO 27001 ;
  • contribuer à la gestion des vulnérabilités et à la sécurisation des dépendances ;
  • prendre en compte les exigences de résilience et de continuité propres à une plateforme financière régulée.

AI-native engineering

Nous considérons les outils IA comme une nouvelle composante du métier de software engineer.

Nous attendons de nos développeurs qu’ils sachent utiliser intelligemment les assistants de développement et LLM pour accélérer leur travail tout en conservant une forte capacité de jugement sur l’architecture, le code produit et la sécurité.

Vous serez notamment amené à :

  • utiliser les outils d’AI-assisted development pour accélérer exploration, développement, tests, debugging et documentation ;
  • comprendre et challenger le code généré plutôt que de simplement l’accepter ;
  • identifier des usages IA pertinents dans notre produit et nos outils internes ;
  • contribuer à définir les bonnes pratiques de l’équipe autour de ces nouveaux outils.

Vos compétences

Expérience

  • Expérience significative en software engineering sur des produits réellement exploités en production.
  • Idéalement 5 années d’expérience ou plus, même si nous privilégions la profondeur technique et les réalisations concrètes au nombre d’années.

  • Capacité démontrée à prendre l’ownership d’un domaine fonctionnel ou d’une partie significative d’un produit.
  • Expérience sur des systèmes comportant des problématiques métier, des workflows ou des intégrations complexes.
  • Expérience concrète de diagnostic et résolution d’incidents en production.
  • Habitude de travailler avec logs, métriques, monitoring et outils d’observabilité.
  • Expérience de systèmes nécessitant un niveau élevé de fiabilité et de qualité appréciée.

Une expérience préalable dans l’assurance ou les services financiers constitue un plus, mais n’est pas requise.

Compétences techniques

  • Connaissance des approches DDD, Architecture Hexagonale et TDD.
  • Excellente maîtrise de TypeScript et expérience backend type NodeJS.
  • Bonne expérience React et développement frontend moderne.
  • Très bonne maîtrise des principes de conception logicielle et des APIs.
  • Maîtrise des bases de données relationnelles et de la modélisation de données.

  • Bonne culture CI/CD.

  • Bonne compréhension des environnements cloud et de l’infrastructure applicative.
  • Bonne compréhension des enjeux de performance, disponibilité, sauvegarde et reprise.
  • Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de sécurité applicative.
  • Bonne compréhension des usages IA / LLM appliqués au développement logiciel.

Nous recherchons un profil full-stack au sens produit et production : il n’est pas nécessaire d’être expert de chaque couche, mais vous devez être capable de comprendre une fonctionnalité depuis son interface utilisateur jusqu’à son fonctionnement en production et d’intervenir là où cela crée le plus de valeur.

Production mindset

  • mettre une fonctionnalité en production ne constitue pas la fin du travail ;
  • un développeur doit comprendre comment son code fonctionne réellement en production ;
  • consulter les logs ou investiguer une alerte fait partie du métier ;

title: Robotics Software Engineer
description:
Build the next generation of autonomous construction robotics

At MESH, we develop autonomous robotic systems that automate end-to-end rebar construction. Bridging digital design and physical automation, our multidisciplinary team transforms advanced robotics research into robust, production-ready industrial systems deployed globally.

Tasks

Role description

We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to develop and productize software across the full robotics stack from perception and motion planning to control and system integration. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working across subsystem boundaries. You will take ownership of the engineering work required to turn promising research and algorithms into robust and mature capabilities that can be deployed and maintained in real-world robotic systems.

What You Will Work On

You will contribute across the full robotics software stack, including:

  • Perception: 2D/3D sensing, point-cloud processing, object and feature detection, pose estimation, calibration.
  • Motion Planning: collision checking, trajectory generation and optimization, kinematics, robot/world modeling, and integration of planning algorithms.
  • Robot Control: integration with industrial robot controllers, HAL layers, trajectory execution, real-time or near-real-time control interfaces, state monitoring, and coordination of multi-robotic systems.
  • System Integration: connecting robotics SW, application logic, hardware, and external systems into reliable end-to-end robotic applications.
  • Robotics Infrastructure: reusable software components, interfaces, configuration, logging, diagnostics, testing, simulation, and deployment infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, test, and maintain robotics software primarily in C++ and Python.
  • Develop and integrate components across the full robotics SW stack.
  • Take algorithms and prototypes and mature them into reliable software components.
  • Build automated tests, simulation-based tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, and system-level validation where appropriate.
  • Work with industrial robots, sensors, cameras, external axes, and other automation hardware.
  • Develop clean interfaces between robotics algorithms, hardware drivers, application software, and higher-level systems.
  • Diagnose complex problems that span software, algorithms, networking, robot controllers, sensors, and hardware.
  • Improve observability through structured logging, diagnostics, error reporting, and system health monitoring.
  • Support deployment, commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of robotic systems.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Masters degree or higher in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
  • Strong software engineering skills in C++, with working knowledge of Python.
  • Experience developing software for robotic or other complex hardware systems.
  • Good understanding of several areas of robotics, such as, motion and trajectory planning, robot control, vision, sensor and robot calibration.
  • Experience with robotics middleware such as ROS/ROS2 or similar
  • Comfortable working with Linux and modern software development workflows using Git, code reviews, build systems, debugging tools, and automated testing.
  • Ability to debug problems across multiple layers of a robotic system rather than treating individual components in isolation.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture, modularity, interfaces, and maintainability.

Experience in one or more of the following would be an advantage:

  • 3D perception using point clouds, depth cameras, stereo systems.
  • Libraries such as Eigen, PCL, OpenCV, or similar.
  • Collision detection, robot/world modeling, trajectory optimization, or numerical optimization.
  • Real-time or high-performance robot communication and control.
  • Profiling, performance optimization, concurrency, and multithreaded C++.
  • Deploying and supporting robotic systems outside a controlled R&D environment.
  • CI/CD and automated testing for robotics software.
  • Experience working with industrial robotic arms such as ABB

We do not expect you to be an expert in every part of the robotics stack. We are looking for strong software engineering fundamentals, depth in one or more robotics areas, and the ability and interest to work across subsystem boundaries.

Eligibility

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Switzerland or be eligible to obtain the required Swiss work authorization without employer-sponsored visa support.

Why Join MESH?

At MESH, you will work on robotics problems where advanced R&D meets real-world industrial deployment. Our goal is not only to develop new robotics capabilities, but to turn them into systems that solve challenging problems in real world deployments.

  • You will have opportunities to work across the full robotics SW stack including system integration, and the software architecture connecting them rather than being restricted to a narrow subsystem.
  • You will work directly on the engineering challenges that take robotics from promising prototypes to robust, repeatable, and deployable solutions.
  • Solve challenging real-world robotics problems. Work with industrial robots, 3D vision systems, complex environments, and applications where conventional automation approaches reach their limits.
  • See your work operate on real hardware. Develop software that moves beyond simulation and demos and becomes part of robotic systems deployed in real production environments.
  • Have impact across the system. As part of a small, multidisciplinary engineering team, you will work closely across robotics, software, and hardware, with the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and how our robotics platform evolves.

Nice to Have

description:

You will also be strongly involved in troubleshooting and root cause analysis. When test results do not meet expectations, you will investigate the issue, identify its root cause and work with the relevant teams to implement appropriate solutions.

Accurate documentation and clear communication of your work and results will be an essential part of your role.

  • Analyze test results and identify deviations from expected performance.

  • Apply your knowledge of RF and microwave theory to practical engineering challenges.
  • Contribute to the design and testing of RF structures and building blocks.
  • Work with RF technologies across Ka, Ku, X, C and S bands.
  • Contribute to the development of RF structures and building blocks for phased array antenna systems.

🔹 Troubleshooting & Root Cause Analysis

  • Investigate technical issues encountered during development and testing.
  • Identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
  • Work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to resolve technical challenges.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement activities.

  • Work on both early-stage demonstrators and new industrialized designs.
  • Support the development of solutions intended for mass production.
  • Collaborate with different engineering disciplines throughout the product development lifecycle.

🔹 Documentation & Collaboration

  • Accurately document test activities, results and technical investigations.
  • Clearly communicate findings and recommendations to relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with external partners and laboratories when required.
  • Take ownership of assigned activities and deliver them autonomously.

Requirements

💼 Your profile

  • Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering or a similar field.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in RF, microwave or antenna engineering.
  • Proven experience in RF & Microwave or antenna development and research.

  • Experience working across different engineering disciplines and software workflows, including Altium.

  • Gemeinsame Entwicklung und Einführung des Security Strategy Boards zur Einordnung von Threat-/Tech-Radar-, Markt- und Regulatorik-Signalen sowie Architektur-Entscheiden
  • Etablierung einer KPI-basierten Steuerung mit automatisierten Dashboards und relevanten Kennzahlen sowie Mitgestaltung der KI-Agenda

Qualifikation

description:

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel beheer, de technische inrichting, continuïteit en doorontwikkeling van Relatics. Daarbij werk je dicht op de praktijk en begrijp je hoe projectleiders, werkvoorbereiders, uitvoerders, omgevingsmanagers en engineers de applicatie gebruiken. Hun wensen worden binnen onze DevOps-omgeving verzameld, georganiseerd en geprioriteerd. Jouw verantwoordelijkheid is om deze development-tickets te verfijnen en uit te voeren. Je test en implementeert de wijzigingen en bewaakt dat de inrichting stabiel, uniform en toekomstbestendig blijft.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Je ontwikkelt en configureert Relatics-modules voor onder andere eisenmanagement, contractmanagement en risicomanagement, inclusief de bijbehorende structuren, objecten, relaties en standaardbibliotheken;

  • Je richt schermen, tabellen, queries en views in en verbetert deze op basis van project- en gebruikersbehoeften. Daarbij bewaak je de uniformiteit, datakwaliteit en traceerbaarheid;

  • Het signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden in processen en systeeminrichting en het vertalen daarvan naar concrete oplossingen;

  • Je onderhoudt en verbetert de koppelingen en gegevensuitwisseling met interne systemen, zoals SharePoint Online, GIS, Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) en OPC;

Hier zit je op je plek

Je standplaats is ons moderne kantoor De Verbinding in Utrecht, waar je deel uitmaakt van de afdeling Informatiemanagement (IM): een groeiend team van informatiemanagers, applicatiespecialisten, BI-specialisten en product owners. De inrichting van de specialistische profielen voor applicaties en BI is nieuw. Dat doe je zowel in kleinere optimalisaties als in grotere projecten. Zo helpen we Dura Vermeer om een voorloper te blijven op het gebied van digitalisering in de infrasector.

title: Ontwerper
description:
Wil jij je ontwikkelen als ontwerper en meewerken aan toonaangevende civieltechnische projecten? Heb je een passie voor constructies en werk je graag samen aan slimme, duurzame oplossingen? Dan is dit jouw kans om bij Dura Vermeer impact te maken!

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als constructief ontwerper werk je aan het opzetten en uitwerken van 3D-modellen en tekeningen van civieltechnische constructies, zoals bruggen, dijken, viaducten en tunnels. Je maakt gebruik van Revit en leert (verder) werken met Dynamo om ontwerpen slimmer en efficiënter te maken.

Je staat er niet alleen voor: je werkt nauw samen met ervaren collega’s en krijgt de ruimte om je kennis verder te ontwikkelen. Stap voor stap groei je in je rol en leer je hoe je modellen optimaliseert en bijdraagt aan innovatieve oplossingen binnen BIM, digitalisering en automatisering.

Je bent nieuwsgierig en durft vragen te stellen. Je zoekt actief informatie op en deelt jouw inzichten met het team. Samen met constructeurs en werkvoorbereiders zorg je ervoor dat ontwerpen niet alleen kloppen, maar ook uitvoerbaar en veilig zijn. Zo draag je zichtbaar bij aan het succes van onze projecten.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je jezelf kunt ontwikkelen en jouw ideeën kunt inbrengen. Daarom moedigen we je aan om mee te denken over hoe we onze digitale werkwijzen blijven verbeteren.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.

Je gaat aan de slag op verschillende infraprojecten van Dura Vermeer door heel Nederland. Dit doe je samen met gedreven collega’s uit verschillende disciplines. Daarmee geven wij invulling aan onze ambitie als ontwerpende bouwer. Neem bijvoorbeeld de renovatie van de Heinenoordtunnel, de dijkversterking Wolferen Sprok, dijkversterking Tiel-Waardenburg, de aanleg van de A15 of projecten die bijdragen aan de energietransitie.

Bij gelijke geschiktheid kan, binnen ons voorkeursbeleid, de voorkeur uitgaan naar een vrouwelijke kandidaat.

title: Technisch ontwikkelaar werktuigbouwkunde
description:
Heb jij een frisse blik op installatietechniek en wil je innovatieve projecten realiseren die écht het verschil maken? Ontwerp jij graag onderscheidende installatieconcepten en weet je anderen te enthousiasmeren om samen deze ambities waar te maken? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou als technisch ontwikkelaar werktuigbouwkunde bij Dura Vermeer Techniek.

Dit wordt jouw baan

Als technisch ontwikkelaar werktuigbouwkunde binnen het tenderteam ben jij de spil in de technische uitwerking van complexe tenders en bouwteamontwikkelingen. Je vertaalt klantuitgangspunten naar slimme, realiseerbare installatieontwerpen op het gebied van klimaatinstallaties, sanitair en duurzame energiesystemen. Samen met de kostendeskundige en tendermanager zorg je voor een perfect ontwerp dat technisch én financieel klopt.

Met jouw natuurlijke overtuigingskracht neem je klanten mee in de technische mogelijkheden en adviseer je hen over de beste oplossingen. Je hebt een zelfstandige, sturende rol in het multidisciplinaire projectteam en bent de expert op het gebied van werktuigbouwkundige installaties. Naast het ontwikkelen van innovatieve en energie-efficiënte concepten zorg je ervoor dat je ontwerpen ook daadwerkelijk uitvoerbaar zijn in de praktijk.

 

Jouw werkweek bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Het meedraaien in tenders of bouw-/ontwerpteams samen met de opdrachtgever en andere Dura Vermeer werkmaatschappijen;

  • Je ontwerpt of toetst het meest onderscheidende werktuigbouwkundige installatieontwerp, waarbij je focus ligt op HVAC-installaties, sanitair, brandbeveiligingsinstallaties en duurzame energievoorzieningen;

  • Je elimineert technische risico's uit het project en draagt optimalisaties in het ontwerp aan om projecten haalbaar en maakbaar te maken;

  • Bij aanbestedingen de uitgangspunten en de inschrijfstrategie bepalen vanuit jouw vakdiscipline. Je ondersteunt hierbij de collega's van calculatie met het opstellen van de begroting;

  • Het zelfstandig opstellen van ramingen op basis van minimale projectinformatie om zodoende budgetgestuurd te ontwerpen;

  • Het adviseren over duurzame oplossingen zoals warmtepompen, warmte-terugwinning, WKO-systemen en hybride installatieconcepten.

Je werkt nauw en integraal samen met je collega technisch ontwikkelaar elektrotechniek, de tendermanager en de bouwkundige collega's. Wat de rol verder bijzonder maakt? Je draagt samen met enthousiaste collega's letterlijk en figuurlijk bij aan de uitbouw van Dura Vermeer Techniek. Wij zijn benieuwd naar jouw visie en ideeën om deze organisatie te laten groeien.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 2,1 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

 

Hier zit je op je plek

Je werkplek is op ons gloednieuwe, moderne kantoor in Utrecht, waar we dagelijks werken aan uitdagende installatieprojecten in de utiliteitsbouw. Je komt te werken in een enthousiast en gedreven team van specialisten dat gekenmerkt wordt door een enorme motivatie voor vernieuwing en verbetering. Binnen ons team heerst een prettige, informele werksfeer waarin collegialiteit, kennis delen en elkaar helpen vanzelfsprekend zijn.

We werken volgens de principes van integraal ontwerpen, waarbij korte lijnen, multidisciplinaire samenwerking en ondernemerschap centraal staan. Daarnaast investeren we in jouw ontwikkeling door middel van opleidingen, cursussen en kennissessies. We bieden ook een hybride werkmodel waarbij je de flexibiliteit hebt om een deel van de week vanuit huis te werken.


Dit breng jij mee

  • Een afgeronde opleiding werktuigbouwkunde of installatietechniek op minimaal hbo-niveau;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke functie;

  • Sterke engineeringsvaardigheden met aantoonbare kennis van HVAC-systemen, sanitaire installaties en duurzame energieoplossingen;

  • Tenderervaring aangevuld met voldoende technisch-inhoudelijke kennis van werktuigbouwkundige installaties;

  • Een initiatiefrijke persoonlijkheid met probleemoplossend vermogen en goede communicatieve vaardigheden;

 

Dit bieden wij jou

• 38 verlofdagen conform de CAO Metaal en Techniek;

• Uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals een standaardverzekering van alle werknemersrisico’s, pensioenregelingen, een extra aanvulling bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en een bijdrage voor het vakbondslidmaatschap;

• Een laptop en smartphone;

• Een gloednieuwe (elektrische) fiets dankzij ons lease-a-bike fietsplan;

• Veel aandacht voor jouw groei dankzij onze eigen Dura Vermeer Academie met volop opleiding- en trainingsmogelijkheden binnen je vakgebied, maar bijvoorbeeld ook op het gebied van vitaliteit;

• Bedrijfsfitnessregeling met keuze uit een sportaanbod van ruim 3.500

sportlocaties door heel Nederland;

description:

  • AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

Good to Have

  • Certifications*:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

  • Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.
